local U={model=nil,char=nil,links=nil,token=0,hidden={},grips={},attachAt=0,bound=false,status='off',corpses={},raggies={},isaCache={}};
function U.isA(Y,S)
    local y=U.isaCache[S];
    if not y then
        y={};
        U.isaCache[S]=y;
    end
;
local Q=Y.ClassName;
local E=y[Q];

    E=Y:IsA(S);

;
do
    local Y=game:GetService("Players");
    local S=game:GetService('RunService');
    local y=game:GetService("AssetService");
    local Q=Y.LocalPlayer;
    function U.joints(E)
        local I={};
        for C,C in ipairs(E:GetDescendants())do
            if C:IsA('Motor6D')and C.Part0 and C.Part1 then
                I[C.Part1.Name]={j=C,p0=C.Part0,p1=C.Part1,motor=true};
            elseif C:IsA("AnimationConstraint")and C.Attachment0 and C.Attachment1 and C.Attachment0.Parent and C.Attachment1.Parent then
                    I[C.Attachment1.Parent.Name]={j=C,p0=C.Attachment0.Parent,p1=C.Attachment1.Parent,a0=C.Attachment0,a1=C.Attachment1};
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    return I;
end
;
function U.frames(E)
    if E.motor then
        return E.j.C0,E.j.C1;
    end
;
return E.a0.CFrame,E.a1.CFrame;
end
;
function U.ground(E,I)
    local C=E:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
    local H=E:FindFirstChild('LeftFoot');
    if not C or not H then
        return nil;
    end
;
local E,n={},H;
while n and n~=C do
    local C=I[n.Name];
    if not C then
        return nil;
    end
;
table.insert(E,1,C);
n=C.p0;
end
;
local I=CFrame.new();
for C,C in ipairs(E)do
    local E,n=U.frames(C);
    I=I*E*n:Inverse();
end
;
return H.Size.Y/2-I.Position.Y;
end
;
function U.ghost(E)E.CanCollide,E.CanTouch,E.CanQuery,E.Massless=false,false,false,true;
    E.CastShadow=true;
    E:GetPropertyChangedSignal('CanCollide'):Connect(
        function()
            if E.CanCollide then
                E.CanCollide=false;
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
;
function U.solid()
    local E=U.model;
    if not E then
        return;
    end
;
for I,I in ipairs(E:GetDescendants())do
    if I:IsA('BasePart')and(I.CanCollide or I.CanTouch or I.CanQuery)then
        I.CanCollide,I.CanTouch,I.CanQuery=false,false,false;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
function U.prep(E)
    for I,I in ipairs(E:GetDescendants())do
        if I:IsA('BaseScript')then
            I:Destroy();
        elseif I:IsA('BasePart')then
                U.ghost(I);
            elseif I:IsA('AnimationConstraint')then
                    I.IsKinematic=true;
                elseif I:IsA("BallSocketConstraint")then
                        I.Enabled=false;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
        local I=E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
        if I then
            pcall(
                function()I.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None;
                    I.HealthDisplayType=Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff;
                    I.EvaluateStateMachine=false;
                    I.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;
                end
        );
end
;
local I=E:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
if I then
    I.Anchored=true;
    I.Transparency=1;
end
;
E.Name='PulseSkin';
E.DescendantAdded:Connect(
    function(I)
        if I:IsA("BasePart")then
            U.ghost(I);
        end
    ;
end
);
U.cj=U.joints(E);
U.cg=U.ground(E,U.cj);
U.modelParts={};
for I,I in ipairs(E:GetDescendants())do
    if I:IsA("BasePart")and I.Name~="HumanoidRootPart"then
        U.modelParts[#U.modelParts+1]=I;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
function U.attach(E)U.char,U.links=E,nil;
    local I=U.joints(E);
    local C=U.ground(E,I);
    if C==nil or U.cg==nil or C<=0 then
        return;
    end
;
local H,n={},{};
for O,N in pairs(I)do
    local I=U.cj[O];
    if I then
        local O,z=U.frames(N);
        local D,b=U.frames(I);
        H[#H+1]={g=N,c=I,root=N.p0.Name=="HumanoidRootPart",restG=O*z:Inverse(),restC=D*b:Inverse(),c0inv=D:Inverse(),c1=b,pivot0=CFrame.new(D.Position),pivot1=CFrame.new(b.Position):Inverse()};
        n[I.p1.Name]=#H;
    end
;
end
;
if#H==0 then
    return;
end
;
U.k=U.cg/C;
U.lift=U.cg-C;
U.chain={};
for I in pairs(n)do
    local C,O,N={},I,0;
    while O and n[O]and N<32 do
        N+=1;
        local N=n[O];
        table.insert(C,1,N);
        local n=H[N].c.p0;
        O=n.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'and n.Name or nil;
        if O==nil then
            U.chain[I]=C;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
U.feet={};
for I,I in ipairs({'LeftFoot',"RightFoot"})do
    local C,n=E:FindFirstChild(I),U.model:FindFirstChild(I);
    if U.chain[I]and C and n and C:IsA('BasePart')and n:IsA("BasePart")then
        U.feet[#U.feet+1]={list=U.chain[I],gh=C.Size.Y/2,ch=n.Size.Y/2};
    end
;
end
;
local E=U.model:FindFirstChild('RightHand');
local I=E and E:FindFirstChild('RightGripAttachment');
U.modelGrip=I and I:IsA("Attachment")and I.CFrame or CFrame.new(0,-E.Size.Y/2,0);
U.links=H;
U.notify(nil);
end

    local I=rawget(getgenv(),"__pulseSkinChanged");
    if type(I)=='function'then
            task.defer(
                function()pcall(I,E);
                end
        );

end

getgenv().__pulseSkinModel=
function()
    local E=U.model;
    if E and U.links and E.Parent then
        return E;
    end
;
return nil;
end
;
function U.drive(E)
    local I=U.links;
    local C=PulseFC(E,"HumanoidRootPart");
    local E=PulseFC(U.model,"HumanoidRootPart");
    if not(I and C and E)then
        return false;
    end
;
local H=U.k;
for n=1,#I do
    local O=I[n];
    local n=O.g;
    local N,z;
    if n.motor then
        N,z=n.j.C0,n.j.C1;
    else
        N,z=n.a0.CFrame,n.a1.CFrame;
    end
;
local D=N*n.j.Transform*z:Inverse();
local n;
if O.root then
    n=CFrame.new(O.restC.Position+(D.Position-O.restG.Position)*H)*D.Rotation;
else
    n=O.pivot0*D.Rotation*O.pivot1;
end
;
O.relG,O.relC=D,n;
O.c.j.Transform=O.c0inv*n*O.c1;
end
;
local H=U.lift;
if#U.feet>0 then
    local n,O=math.huge,math.huge;
    for N,N in ipairs(U.feet)do
        local z,D=CFrame.identity,CFrame.identity;
        for b,b in ipairs(N.list)do
            z=z*I[b].relG;
            D=D*I[b].relC;
        end
    ;
    n=math.min(n,z.Y-N.gh);
    O=math.min(O,D.Y-N.ch);
end
;
if n<math.huge and O<math.huge then
    H=n-O;
end
;
end
;
local I=C.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,H,0);
E.CFrame=I;
U.rootCF,U.hrpCF=I,C.CFrame;
return true;
end
;
function U.pose(E,I,C,H)
    if not(E and H)then
        return false;
    end
;
local n;
for O=1,#E do
    local N=E[O];
    local E;
    if N.root then
        E=N.restC;
        n=N;
    else
        local O,z=I(N.g.p0),I(N.g.p1);
        if O and z and O.Parent and z.Parent then
            E=N.pivot0*(O.CFrame:Inverse()*z.CFrame).Rotation*N.pivot1;
        else
            E=N.restC;
        end
    ;
end
;
local O=C and C[N.c.p1.Name]or N.c;
if O then
    O.j.Transform=N.c0inv*E*N.c1;
end
;
if not C then
    N.relC=E;
end
;
end
;
local E=n and I(n.g.p1);
if not(E and E.Parent)then
    return false;
end
;
H.CFrame=E.CFrame*n.restC:Inverse();
return true;
end
;
function U.fadeOf(E)
    local I=0;
    for C,C in ipairs(E)do
        if C.Parent and U.isA(C,'BasePart')and C.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'and C.Transparency>I then
            I=C.Transparency;
        end
    ;
end
;
return I;
end

function U.sig(E)
    local I=E:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso");
    local C=E:FindFirstChildOfClass('Shirt');
    local H=E:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants");
    return table.concat({I and I:IsA("MeshPart")and I.MeshId or"",C and C.ShirtTemplate or'',H and H.PantsTemplate or''},"|");
end

E.watch=nil;

if E.model then

            end

end
;
end

        U.corpses[E]=nil;
    end

function U.adopt(E)
    if U.corpses[E]or not U.model or not U.links then
        return;
    end
;
local I=U.model:Clone();
I.Name='PulseSkinCorpse';
local C={model=I,map={},hidden={},seen={},fade=-1.0,links=U.links,t0=os.clock()};
for H,H in ipairs(E:GetChildren())do
    if H:IsA('BasePart')then
        C.map[H.Name]=H;
    end
;
end
;
C.joints=U.joints(I);
C.parts={};
for H,H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants())do
    if H:IsA("BasePart")then
        U.ghost(H);
        if H.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'then
            C.parts[#C.parts+1]=H;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
C.root=I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
I.Parent=workspace.CurrentCamera;
for H,H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants())do
    if H:IsA("BasePart")then
        H.CanCollide,H.CanTouch,H.CanQuery=false,false,false;
    end
;
end
;
U.corpses[E]=C;
end

function U.corpseStep()
    for E,I in pairs(U.corpses)do
        if not E.Parent or not I.model.Parent then
            U.corpseFree(I);
            U.corpses[E]=nil;
        else
            local C=os.clock();
            if I.dirty~=false or C-(I.scanAt or 0)>1 then
                I.dirty,I.scanAt=false,C;
                if not I.watch then
                    I.watch=E.DescendantAdded:Connect(
                        function()I.dirty=true;
                        end
                );
        end
    ;
    for C,C in ipairs(E:GetDescendants())do
        if U.isA(C,"BasePart")or U.isA(C,'Decal')then
            if C.LocalTransparencyModifier~=1 then
                C.LocalTransparencyModifier=1;
            end
        ;
        if not I.seen[C]then
            I.seen[C]=true;
            I.hidden[#I.hidden+1]=C;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local E=I.map.LowerTorso;
if not I.done then
    U.pose(I.links,
        function(C)
            return I.map[C.Name];
        end
    ,I.joints,I.root);
if E and E.Anchored and os.clock()-I.t0>5 then
    I.done=true;
end
;
end
;
local E=U.fadeOf(I.hidden);
if E~=I.fade then
    I.fade=E;
    for C,C in ipairs(I.parts)do
        if C.Parent then
            C.LocalTransparencyModifier=E;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end

function U.watchRaggy(E)
    if E.Name=="Raggy"and E:IsA('Model')then
        local I,C=os.clock(),{};
        for H,H in ipairs(U.raggies)do
            if I-H.t<6 then
                C[#C+1]=H;
            end
        ;
    end
;
C[#C+1]={m=E,t=I};
U.raggies=C;
end
;
end

function U.matchDeath()
    local E=U.death;
    if not E or E.done then
        return;
    end
;
if os.clock()-E.t>4 then
    E.done=true;
    return;
end
;
local I={};
for C,C in ipairs(U.raggies)do
    if os.clock()-C.t<6 and C.m.Parent then
        I[#I+1]=C;
        local H=C.m:FindFirstChild('LowerTorso')or C.m:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
        local n,O=pcall(U.sig,C.m);
        if H and(H.Position-E.pos).Magnitude<12 and(E.sig=='||'or n and O==E.sig)then
            E.done=true;
            E.corpse=C.m;
            U.adopt(C.m);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
U.raggies=I;
end

    local C=U.chain and U.chain[I];
    if not C then
        return nil;
    end
;
local I=E=='model'and U.rootCF or U.hrpCF;
for H,H in ipairs(C)do
    I=I*(E=="model"and U.links[H].relC or U.links[H].relG);
end
;
return I;
end

function U.gripFollow(E)

    end

U.grips[I]=nil;

;
end

E.C0=n;

function U.mountScanOf(E,I)
    local C,H={},{};
    local n={LowerTorso=PulseFC(I,'LowerTorso'),UpperTorso=PulseFC(I,'UpperTorso')};
    local
    function O(N)
        if N==nil then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    for z,D in pairs(n)do
        if D==N then
            return z;
        end
    ;
end
;
return nil;
end
;
local n=workspace:FindFirstChild('WeaponDisplays');
if n then
    for N,N in ipairs(n:GetChildren())do
        local n=N:FindFirstChildOfClass("RigidConstraint");
        local z=n and n.Attachment0;
        local n=z and O(z.Parent);
        if n and not H[z]then
            H[z]=true;
            C[#C+1]={inst=z,prop='CFrame',part=n};
        end
    ;
    local n=N:FindFirstChild('PulseMount');
    local N=n and U.isA(n,'JointInstance')and O(n.Part0);
    if N and not H[n]then
        H[n]=true;
        C[#C+1]={inst=n,prop="C0",part=N,anchor=n:GetAttribute("PulseAnchor")};
    end
;
end
;
end
;
E.mountList,E.mountCh,E.mountAt=C,I,os.clock();
end

local
function E(I,C,H)
    local n=math.abs(I);
    local O=math.min(n,C);
    local N=(C>0.001 and O*H/C or 0)+math.max(n-C,0);
    return I<0 and-N or N;
end

function U.mountFollowOf(I,C,H,n)
    if I.mountCh~=C or os.clock()-(I.mountAt or 0)>0.5 then
        U.mountScanOf(I,C);
    end
;
local O=I.mountList;
if not(O and#O>0 and H)then
    return;
end
;
I.mounts=I.mounts or{};
local N={};
local
function z(D)
    local b=N[D];
    if b~=nil then
        return b;
    end
;
b=false;
local Z,P=PulseFC(C,D),PulseFC(H,D);
local C,H=n("real",D),n('model',D);
if Z and P and C and H then
    b={M=C:Inverse()*H,hr=Z.Size/2,hs=P.Size/2,part=Z};
end
;
N[D]=b;
return b;
end
;
for C,C in ipairs(O)do
    local H=C.inst;
    local n=H.Parent and z(C.part);
    if n then
        local O=H[C.prop];
        local N=U.mountReg[H];
        if not(N and N.applied and O:FuzzyEq(N.applied,0.0001))then
            N={orig=O,prop=C.prop};
            U.mountReg[H]=N;
        end
    ;
    I.mounts[H]=true;
    local I=N.orig.Position;
    if C.anchor then
        local z=n.part:FindFirstChild(C.anchor);
        if z and U.isA(z,'Attachment')then
            local D=U.mountOrig(z);
            I=(D or z.CFrame).Position;
        end
    ;
end
;
local z,D=n.hr,n.hs;
local b=Vector3.new(E(I.X,z.X,D.X),E(I.Y,z.Y,D.Y),E(I.Z,z.Z,D.Z));
local E=n.M*CFrame.new(b-I)*N.orig;
N.applied=E;
if not O:FuzzyEq(E,0.0001)then
    H[C.prop]=E;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end

function U.collectBody(E)

            if U.isA(C,'BasePart')or U.isA(C,"Decal")then
                I[#I+1]=C;
            end
        ;
        for H,H in ipairs(C:GetDescendants())do
            if(U.isA(H,'BasePart')or U.isA(H,'Decal'))and not H:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Tool')then
                I[#I+1]=H;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
U.body,U.bodyAt,U.bodyDirty=I,os.clock(),false;
if U.bodyChar~=E then
    if U.bodyConn then
        pcall(
            function()U.bodyConn:Disconnect();
            end
    );
end

U.bodyChar=E;
U.bodyConn=E.DescendantAdded:Connect(
    function()U.bodyDirty=true;
    end
);
end
;
end

        U.collectBody(E);
    end

        E.LocalTransparencyModifier=1;

    end

end

function U.firstPerson(E)
    local I=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local C=PulseFC(E,'Head');
    local E=I and C and(I.CFrame.Position-C.Position).Magnitude<1.4;
    local I=rawget(getgenv(),'__pulseInvis');
    local C=type(I)=="table"and I.active==true;
    local I=E and 1 or(C and 0.5 or 0);
    if I~=U.near then
        U.near=I;
        for E,E in ipairs(U.modelParts or{})do
            if E.Parent then
                E.LocalTransparencyModifier=I;
            end
        ;
    end

end

function U.step()
    local E=U.model;
    if not E then
        return;
    end
;
local I=Q.Character;
local Q=I and PulseFCC(I,'Humanoid');
local C=workspace.CurrentCamera;
pcall(U.matchDeath);
pcall(U.corpseStep);
local H=I~=nil and Q~=nil and I.Parent~=nil and Q.Health<=0 and U.char==I and U.links~=nil;
if H then
    if not U.death or U.death.ch~=I then
        local H=I:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")or I:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
        local n,O=pcall(U.sig,I);
        U.death={ch=I,t=os.clock(),pos=H and H.Position or Vector3.zero,sig=n and O or"||"};
        pcall(U.matchDeath);
    end
;
U.restoreGrips();
local H=U.death.corpse~=nil and U.corpses[U.death.corpse]~=nil;
if H or not U.pose(U.links,
    function(H)
        return H;
    end
,nil,E:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))then
if E.Parent then
    E.Parent=nil;
end
;
elseif E.Parent~=C then
        E.Parent=C;
        U.solid();
    end
;
U.hideBody(I);
local H=U.fadeOf(U.body or{});
if H~=U.deadFade then
    U.deadFade=H;
    for n,n in ipairs(U.modelParts or{})do
        if n.Parent then
            n.LocalTransparencyModifier=H;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
U.near=nil;
return;
end
;
if not(I and Q and Q.Health>0 and PulseFC(I,'HumanoidRootPart'))then
    if E.Parent then
        E.Parent=nil;
    end
;
U.showBody();
U.restoreGrips();
U.char,U.links=nil,nil;
return;
end
;
if U.deadFade then
    U.deadFade=nil;
    U.near=nil;
end
;
if U.char~=I or U.links==nil and os.clock()-U.attachAt>0.5 then
    U.attachAt=os.clock();
    U.showBody();
    U.restoreGrips();
    pcall(U.attach,I);
end
;
if not U.links then
    return;
end
;
if E.Parent~=C then
    E.Parent=C;
    U.solid();
end
;
if not U.drive(I)then
    return;
end
;
U.hideBody(I);
pcall(U.gripFollow,I);
pcall(U.mountFollow,I);
U.firstPerson(I);
end

function U.bind(Q)
    if Q and not U.bound then
        U.bound=true;
        S:BindToRenderStep('PulseSkinStep',Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+2,
            function()
                local E=pcall(U.step);
                if not E then
                    U.links=nil;
                end
            ;
        end
);
U.addConn=workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(U.watchRaggy);
elseif not Q and U.bound then
        U.bound=false;
        pcall(
            function()S:UnbindFromRenderStep('PulseSkinStep');
            end
    );
if U.addConn then
    U.addConn:Disconnect();
    U.addConn=nil;
end
;
end
;
end
;
function U.stop()U.token+=1;
    U.bind(false);
    U.showBody();
    U.restoreGrips();
    U.clearCorpses();
    U.death,U.raggies=nil,{};
    local S=U.model;
    U.model,U.char,U.links,U.cj,U.cg,U.near=nil,nil,nil,nil,nil,nil;
    U.baseDesc,U.kbOn,U.pub=nil,nil,nil;
    if S then
        pcall(
            function()S:Destroy();
            end
    );
end
;
if S and U.notify then
    U.notify(nil);
end
;
end
;
function U.wear(S)
    if U.dead then
        return false,"cancelled";
    end
;
U.token+=1;
local Q=U.token;
local E,I=pcall(
    function()
        return Y:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(S,Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15);
    end
);
if Q~=U.token or U.dead then
    if E and typeof(I)=="Instance"then
        I:Destroy();
    end
;
return false,"cancelled";
end
;
if not E or typeof(I)~="Instance"then
    return false,"Couldn't build: "..tostring(I);
end
;
local S,Q=pcall(U.prep,I);
if not S or U.cg==nil then
    I:Destroy();
    return false,"Couldn't rig: "..tostring(Q);
end
;
local S=U.model;
U.showBody();
U.restoreGrips();
U.model,U.char,U.links,U.near=I,nil,nil,nil;
if S then
    pcall(
        function()S:Destroy();
        end
);
end
;
U.bind(true);
return true;
end

U.KB_LEG=139607718;
function U.cosWant()
    local S=rawget(getgenv(),"__pulseCosMine");
    if type(S)~="function"then
            return false,false;
        end
    ;
    local Q,E,I=pcall(S);
    if not Q then
        return false,false;
    end
;
return E==true,I==true;
end

local S={'BodyTypeScale','DepthScale',"HeadScale","HeightScale",'ProportionScale',"WidthScale",'Face','Head','LeftArm','LeftLeg','RightArm','RightLeg','Torso','GraphicTShirt',"Pants","Shirt"};
local Q={"HeadColor","LeftArmColor",'LeftLegColor',"RightArmColor","RightLegColor","TorsoColor"};
function U.serial(E)
    local I,C=pcall(
        function()
            local H={p={},c={},acc={}};
            for n,n in ipairs(S)do
                H.p[n]=E[n];
            end
        ;
        for n,n in ipairs(Q)do
            local O=E[n];
            H.c[n]={math.floor(O.R*255+0.5),math.floor(O.G*255+0.5),math.floor(O.B*255+0.5)};
        end
    ;
    for n,n in ipairs(E:GetAccessories(true))do
        H.acc[#H.acc+1]={t=n.AccessoryType.Name,id=n.AssetId,l=n.IsLayered==true,o=n.Order,pf=n.Puffiness};
    end
;
return H;
end
);
return I and C or nil;
end
;
function U.deserial(E)
    if type(E)~='table'then
        return nil;
    end
;
local I,C=pcall(
    function()
        local H=Instance.new("HumanoidDescription");
        for n,n in ipairs(S)do
            local S=type(E.p)=="table"and E.p[n];
            if type(S)=="number"then
                pcall(
                    function()H[n]=S;
                    end
            );
    end
;
end
;
for S,S in ipairs(Q)do
    local Q=type(E.c)=='table'and E.c[S];
    if type(Q)=="table"then
        pcall(
            function()H[S]=Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(Q[1])or 0,tonumber(Q[2])or 0,tonumber(Q[3])or 0);
            end
    );
end
;
end
;
local S={};
for Q,Q in ipairs(type(E.acc)=="table"and E.acc or{})do
    local E,n=pcall(
        function()
            return Enum.AccessoryType[tostring(Q.t)];
        end
);
if E and n and tonumber(Q.id)then
    local E={AccessoryType=n,AssetId=tonumber(Q.id),IsLayered=Q.l==true};
    if tonumber(Q.o)then
        E.Order=tonumber(Q.o);
    end
;
if tonumber(Q.pf)then
    E.Puffiness=tonumber(Q.pf);
end
;
S[#S+1]=E;
end
;
end
;
H:SetAccessories(S,true);
return H;
end
);
return I and C or nil;
end

function U.refreshCos()
    if not(U.model and U.baseDesc)then
        return;
    end
;
local S,Q=U.cosWant();
if S~=(U.kbOn==true)then
    U.dress(U.baseDesc);
else
    U.headless(U.model,Q);
end
;
end

getgenv().__pulseSkinCos=
function()task.spawn(
        function()pcall(U.refreshCos);
        end
);
end

    local Q=y:GetBundleDetailsAsync(S);
    for S,S in ipairs(Q.Items or{})do
        if S.Type=="UserOutfit"then
            return Y:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromOutfitId(S.Id),Q.Name;
        end
    ;
end
;
error("bundle has no outfit");
end

function U.fromUser(S)
    local y=tonumber(S);
    if not y then
        y=Y:GetUserIdFromNameAsync(S);
    end
;
local Q=tostring(S);
pcall(
    function()Q=Y:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(y);
    end
);
return Y:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(y),Q,y;
end
;
end

function U.applyBundle(Y)
    local S=tonumber(Y);
    if not S then
        return false,"Bad bundle id";
    end
;
if not M.Character then
    return false,"No character";
end
;
local Y,y,Q=pcall(U.fromBundle,S);
if not Y or not y then
    y,Q=k(S);
end
;
if not y then
    return false,tostring(Q);
end
;
local Y,E=U.dress(y);
if not Y then
    return false,tostring(E);
end
;
U.pub={b=S};
K.skin={kind='bundle',id=tostring(S),name=Q,desc=U.serial(y)};
w();
return true,tostring(Q);
end

function U.applyUser(Y)Y=(tostring(Y or""):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub("%s+$",''));
    if Y==""then
        return false,'Enter a username';
    end
;
if not M.Character then
    return false,"No character";
end
;
local S,y,Q,E=pcall(U.fromUser,Y);
if not S or not y then
    return false,'Player not found';
end
;
local S,I=U.dress(y);
if not S then
    return false,tostring(I);
end
;
U.pub=tonumber(E)and{u=tonumber(E)}or nil;
K.skin={kind='user',id=Y,name=Q,uid=tonumber(E),desc=U.serial(y)};
w();
return true,tostring(Q);
end

function U.applySaved(Y)
    if type(Y)~="table"then
        return false;
    end
;
local S=U.deserial(Y.desc);
if S then
    local y=U.dress(S);
    if y then
        if Y.kind=="bundle"then
            U.pub=tonumber(Y.id)and{b=tonumber(Y.id)}or nil;
        else
            local S=tonumber(Y.uid)or tonumber(Y.id);
            U.pub=S and{u=S}or nil;
        end
    ;
    K.skin=Y;
    w();
    return true;
end
;
end
;
if Y.kind=="user"then
    return U.applyUser(Y.id);
end
;
if Y.id then
    return U.applyBundle(Y.id);
end
;
return false;
end

function U.reset()U.stop();
    K.skin=nil;
    w();
    return true,"Skin removed";
end

local Y={list={},raggies={},descs={},bound=false};
getgenv().__pulseRemoteSkin=Y;
do
    local S=game:GetService("Players");
    local y=game:GetService("RunService");
    function Y.prep(Q)
        for E,E in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants())do
            if E:IsA("BaseScript")then
                E:Destroy();
            elseif E:IsA('BasePart')then
                    U.ghost(E);
                elseif E:IsA('AnimationConstraint')then
                        E.IsKinematic=true;
                    elseif E:IsA('BallSocketConstraint')then
                            E.Enabled=false;
                        end
                    ;
                end
            ;
            local E=Q:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            if E then
                pcall(
                    function()E.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None;
                        E.HealthDisplayType=Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff;
                        E.EvaluateStateMachine=false;
                        E.BreakJointsOnDeath=false;
                    end
            );
    end
;
local E=Q:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
if E then
    E.Anchored=true;
    E.Transparency=1;
end
;
Q.Name="PulseRemoteSkin";
Q.DescendantAdded:Connect(
    function(E)
        if E:IsA("BasePart")then
            U.ghost(E);
        end
    ;
end
);
local E=U.joints(Q);
local I=U.ground(Q,E);
local C={};
for H,H in ipairs(Q:GetDescendants())do
    if H:IsA('BasePart')and H.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'then
        C[#C+1]=H;
    end
;
end
;
return E,I,C;
end
;
function Y.solid(Q)
    if not Q.model then
        return;
    end
;
for E,E in ipairs(Q.model:GetDescendants())do
    if E:IsA('BasePart')and(E.CanCollide or E.CanTouch or E.CanQuery)then
        E.CanCollide,E.CanTouch,E.CanQuery=false,false,false;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
function Y.attach(Q,E)Q.char,Q.links=E,nil;
    local I=U.joints(E);
    local C=U.ground(E,I);
    if C==nil or Q.cg==nil or C<=0 then
        return;
    end
;
local H,n={},{};
for O,N in pairs(I)do
    local I=Q.cj[O];
    if I then
        local O,z=U.frames(N);
        local D,b=U.frames(I);
        H[#H+1]={g=N,c=I,root=N.p0.Name=='HumanoidRootPart',restG=O*z:Inverse(),restC=D*b:Inverse(),c0inv=D:Inverse(),c1=b,pivot0=CFrame.new(D.Position),pivot1=CFrame.new(b.Position):Inverse()};
        n[I.p1.Name]=#H;
    end
;
end
;
if#H==0 then
    return;
end
;
Q.k=Q.cg/C;
Q.lift=Q.cg-C;
Q.chain={};
for I in pairs(n)do
    local C,O,N={},I,0;
    while O and n[O]and N<32 do
        N+=1;
        local N=n[O];
        table.insert(C,1,N);
        local n=H[N].c.p0;
        O=n.Name~="HumanoidRootPart"and n.Name or nil;
        if O==nil then
            Q.chain[I]=C;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
Q.feet={};
for I,I in ipairs({'LeftFoot','RightFoot'})do
    local C,n=E:FindFirstChild(I),Q.model:FindFirstChild(I);
    if Q.chain[I]and C and n and C:IsA('BasePart')and n:IsA("BasePart")then
        Q.feet[#Q.feet+1]={list=Q.chain[I],gh=C.Size.Y/2,ch=n.Size.Y/2};
    end
;
end
;
local E=Q.model:FindFirstChild("RightHand");
local I=E and E:FindFirstChild("RightGripAttachment");
Q.modelGrip=I and I:IsA('Attachment')and I.CFrame or(E and CFrame.new(0,-E.Size.Y/2,0)or CFrame.identity);
Q.links=H;
if Q.plr then
    U.notify(Q.plr);
end
;
end
;
function Y.drive(Q,E)
    local I=Q.links;
    local C=PulseFC(E,"HumanoidRootPart");
    local E=PulseFC(Q.model,'HumanoidRootPart');
    if not(I and C and E)then
        return false;
    end
;
local H=Q.k;
local n=os.clock();
local O=n-(Q.framesAt or 0)>1;
if O then
    Q.framesAt=n;
end
;
for n=1,#I do
    local N=I[n];
    local n=N.g;
    if O or not N.g0 then
        local O,z;
        if n.motor then
            O,z=n.j.C0,n.j.C1;
        else
            O,z=n.a0.CFrame,n.a1.CFrame;
        end
    ;
    N.g0,N.g1inv=O,z:Inverse();
end
;
local O=N.g0*n.j.Transform*N.g1inv;
local n;
if N.root then
    n=CFrame.new(N.restC.Position+(O.Position-N.restG.Position)*H)*O.Rotation;
else
    n=N.pivot0*O.Rotation*N.pivot1;
end
;
N.relG,N.relC=O,n;
N.c.j.Transform=N.c0inv*n*N.c1;
end
;
local H=Q.lift;
if#Q.feet>0 then
    local n,O=math.huge,math.huge;
    for N,N in ipairs(Q.feet)do
        local z,D=CFrame.identity,CFrame.identity;
        for b,b in ipairs(N.list)do
            z=z*I[b].relG;
            D=D*I[b].relC;
        end
    ;
    n=math.min(n,z.Y-N.gh);
    O=math.min(O,D.Y-N.ch);
end
;
if n<math.huge and O<math.huge then
    H=n-O;
end
;
end
;
local I=C.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,H,0);
E.CFrame=I;
Q.rootCF,Q.hrpCF=I,C.CFrame;
return true;
end
;
function Y.world(Q,E,I)
    local C=Q.chain and Q.chain[I];
    if not C then
        return nil;
    end
;
local I=E=="model"and Q.rootCF or Q.hrpCF;
if not I then
    return nil;
end
;
for H,H in ipairs(C)do
    I=I*(E=="model"and Q.links[H].relC or Q.links[H].relG);
end
;
return I;
end
;
function Y.gripFollow(Q,E)
    local I=PulseFC(E,'RightHand');
    local E=I and PulseFC(I,"RightGrip");
    for I,C in pairs(Q.grips)do
        if I~=E then
            if I.Parent and C.applied and I.C0:FuzzyEq(C.applied,0.001)then
                pcall(
                    function()I.C0=C.c0;
                    end
            );
    end
;
Q.grips[I]=nil;
end
;
end
;
if not(E and E:IsA("JointInstance"))then
    return;
end
;
local I=Q.grips[E];
if not I or not(I.applied and E.C0:FuzzyEq(I.applied,0.001))then
    I={c0=E.C0};
    Q.grips[E]=I;
end
;
local C=Y.world(Q,'real','RightHand');
local H=Y.world(Q,"model",'RightHand');
if not(C and H)then
    return;
end
;
local n=C:Inverse()*H*Q.modelGrip;
I.applied=n;
E.C0=n;
end
;
function Y.restoreGrips(Q)
    for E,I in pairs(Q.grips)do
        if E.Parent and I.applied and E.C0:FuzzyEq(I.applied,0.001)then
            pcall(
                function()E.C0=I.c0;
                end
        );
end
;
end
;
Q.grips={};
U.restoreMountsOf(Q);
end
;
function Y.collectBody(Q,E)
    local I={};
    for C,C in ipairs(E:GetChildren())do
        if not U.isA(C,"Tool")and not C:GetAttribute('PulseVFX')then
            if U.isA(C,'BasePart')or U.isA(C,'Decal')then
                I[#I+1]=C;
            end
        ;
        for H,H in ipairs(C:GetDescendants())do
            if(U.isA(H,'BasePart')or U.isA(H,'Decal'))and not H:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Tool')then
                I[#I+1]=H;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
Q.body,Q.bodyAt,Q.bodyDirty=I,os.clock(),false;
if Q.bodyChar~=E then
    if Q.bodyConn then
        pcall(
            function()Q.bodyConn:Disconnect();
            end
    );
end
;
Q.bodyChar=E;
Q.bodyConn=E.DescendantAdded:Connect(
    function()Q.bodyDirty=true;
    end
);
end
;
end
;
function Y.hideBody(Q,E)
    local I=os.clock();
    local C=I-(Q.bodyAt or 0);
    if Q.char~=E or Q.bodyChar~=E or not Q.body or Q.bodyDirty and C>0.2 or C>3 then
        Y.collectBody(Q,E);
    elseif I-(Q.hideAt or 0)<0.25 then
            return;
        end
    ;
    Q.hideAt=I;
    for E,E in ipairs(Q.body)do
        if E.Parent and E.LocalTransparencyModifier~=1 then
            E.LocalTransparencyModifier=1;
            Q.hidden[E]=true;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
function Y.showBody(Q)
    for E in pairs(Q.hidden)do
        if E.Parent then
            pcall(
                function()E.LocalTransparencyModifier=0;
                end
        );
end
;
end
;
Q.hidden={};
Q.body=nil;
end
;
function Y.corpseFree(Q)
    if Q.watch then
        pcall(
            function()Q.watch:Disconnect();
            end
    );
Q.watch=nil;
end
;
if Q.model then
    pcall(
        function()Q.model:Destroy();
        end
);
end
;
for E,E in ipairs(Q.hidden or{})do
    if E.Parent then
        pcall(
            function()E.LocalTransparencyModifier=0;
            end
    );
end
;
end
;
end
;
function Y.adopt(Q,E)
    if Q.corpses[E]or not Q.model or not Q.links then
        return;
    end
;
local I=Q.model:Clone();
I.Name='PulseRemoteSkinCorpse';
local C={model=I,map={},hidden={},seen={},fade=-1.0,links=Q.links,t0=os.clock()};
for H,H in ipairs(E:GetChildren())do
    if H:IsA("BasePart")then
        C.map[H.Name]=H;
    end
;
end
;
C.joints=U.joints(I);
C.parts={};
for H,H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants())do
    if H:IsA('BasePart')then
        U.ghost(H);
        if H.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'then
            C.parts[#C.parts+1]=H;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
C.root=I:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
I.Parent=workspace.CurrentCamera;
for H,H in ipairs(I:GetDescendants())do
    if H:IsA('BasePart')then
        H.CanCollide,H.CanTouch,H.CanQuery=false,false,false;
    end
;
end
;
Q.corpses[E]=C;
end
;
function Y.corpseStep(Q)
    for E,I in pairs(Q.corpses)do
        if not E.Parent or not I.model.Parent then
            Y.corpseFree(I);
            Q.corpses[E]=nil;
        else
            local Q=os.clock();
            if I.dirty~=false or Q-(I.scanAt or 0)>1 then
                I.dirty,I.scanAt=false,Q;
                if not I.watch then
                    I.watch=E.DescendantAdded:Connect(
                        function()I.dirty=true;
                        end
                );
        end
    ;
    for Q,Q in ipairs(E:GetDescendants())do
        if U.isA(Q,'BasePart')or U.isA(Q,"Decal")then
            if Q.LocalTransparencyModifier~=1 then
                Q.LocalTransparencyModifier=1;
            end
        ;
        if not I.seen[Q]then
            I.seen[Q]=true;
            I.hidden[#I.hidden+1]=Q;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local Q=I.map.LowerTorso;
if not I.done then
    U.pose(I.links,
        function(E)
            return I.map[E.Name];
        end
    ,I.joints,I.root);
if Q and Q.Anchored and os.clock()-I.t0>5 then
    I.done=true;
end
;
end
;
local Q=U.fadeOf(I.hidden);
if Q~=I.fade then
    I.fade=Q;
    for E,E in ipairs(I.parts)do
        if E.Parent then
            E.LocalTransparencyModifier=Q;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
function Y.matchDeath(Q)
    local E=Q.death;
    if not E or E.done then
        return;
    end
;
if os.clock()-E.t>4 then
    E.done=true;
    return;
end
;
for I,I in ipairs(Y.raggies)do
    if os.clock()-I.t<6 and I.m.Parent and not I.taken then
        local C=I.m:FindFirstChild('LowerTorso')or I.m:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
        local H,n=pcall(U.sig,I.m);
        if C and(C.Position-E.pos).Magnitude<12 and(E.sig=="||"or H and n==E.sig)then
            E.done=true;
            E.corpse=I.m;
            I.taken=true;
            Y.adopt(Q,I.m);
            return;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
function Y.watchRaggy(Q)
    if Q.Name=='Raggy'and Q:IsA('Model')then
        local E,I=os.clock(),{};
        for C,C in ipairs(Y.raggies)do
            if E-C.t<6 then
                I[#I+1]=C;
            end
        ;
    end
;
I[#I+1]={m=Q,t=E};
Y.raggies=I;
end
;
end
;
function Y.stepOne(Q)
    local E=Q.plr;
    pcall(Y.corpseStep,Q);
    local I=Q.model;
    if not I then
        return;
    end
;
local C=E.Character;
local E=C and PulseFCC(C,"Humanoid");
local H=workspace.CurrentCamera;
pcall(Y.matchDeath,Q);
local n=C~=nil and E~=nil and C.Parent~=nil and E.Health<=0 and Q.char==C and Q.links~=nil;
if n then
    if not Q.death or Q.death.ch~=C then
        local n=C:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")or C:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
        local O,N=pcall(U.sig,C);
        Q.death={ch=C,t=os.clock(),pos=n and n.Position or Vector3.zero,sig=O and N or'||'};
        pcall(Y.matchDeath,Q);
    end
;
Y.restoreGrips(Q);
local n=Q.death.corpse~=nil and Q.corpses[Q.death.corpse]~=nil;
if n or not U.pose(Q.links,
    function(n)
        return n;
    end
,nil,I:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))then
if I.Parent then
    I.Parent=nil;
end
;
elseif I.Parent~=H then
        I.Parent=H;
        Y.solid(Q);
    end
;
Y.hideBody(Q,C);
local n=U.fadeOf(Q.body or{});
if n~=Q.deadFade then
    Q.deadFade=n;
    for O,O in ipairs(Q.parts or{})do
        if O.Parent then
            O.LocalTransparencyModifier=n;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
return;
end
;
if not(C and E and E.Health>0 and PulseFC(C,'HumanoidRootPart'))then
    if I.Parent then
        I.Parent=nil;
    end
;
Y.showBody(Q);
Y.restoreGrips(Q);
Q.char,Q.links=nil,nil;
return;
end
;
if Q.deadFade then
    Q.deadFade=nil;
    for E,E in ipairs(Q.parts or{})do
        if E.Parent then
            E.LocalTransparencyModifier=0;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
if Q.char~=C or Q.links==nil and os.clock()-(Q.attachAt or 0)>0.5 then
    Q.attachAt=os.clock();
    Q.driven=nil;
    Y.showBody(Q);
    Y.restoreGrips(Q);
    pcall(Y.attach,Q,C);
end
;
if not Q.links then
    return;
end
;
if I.Parent~=H then
    I.Parent=H;
    Q.driven=nil;
    Y.solid(Q);
end
;
local E=Y.view;
if Q.driven and E.cam then
    local H=PulseFC(C,'HumanoidRootPart').Position;
    local n=(H-E.eye).Magnitude;
    if n>12 then
        local O=E.cam:WorldToViewportPoint(H);
        if O.Z<-6.0 or O.X<-E.mx or O.X>E.w+E.mx or O.Y<-E.my or O.Y>E.h+E.my then
            return;
        end
    ;
    if n>100 then
        Q.tick=(Q.tick or 0)+1;
        if Q.tick%(n>250 and 3 or 2)~=0 then
            return;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
if not Y.drive(Q,C)then
    return;
end
;
Q.driven=true;
Y.hideBody(Q,C);
pcall(Y.gripFollow,Q,C);
Q.worldFn=Q.worldFn or
function(E,H)
    return Y.world(Q,E,H);
end
;
pcall(U.mountFollowOf,Q,C,I,Q.worldFn);
end
;
Y.view={};
function Y.step()
    local Q,E=Y.view,workspace.CurrentCamera;
    Q.cam=E;
    if E then
        local I=E.ViewportSize;
        Q.eye,Q.w,Q.h,Q.mx,Q.my=E.CFrame.Position,I.X,I.Y,I.X*0.35,I.Y*0.35;
    end
;
for Q,Q in pairs(Y.list)do
    local E=pcall(Y.stepOne,Q);
    if not E then
        Q.links=nil;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
function Y.bind()
    local Q=next(Y.list)~=nil;
    if Q and not Y.bound then
        Y.bound=true;
        y:BindToRenderStep('PulseRSkinStep',Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+3,
            function()pcall(Y.step);
            end
    );

function Y.descOf(y)
    local Q;
    if y.u then
        Q='u'..tostring(y.u);
    elseif y.b then
            Q='b'..tostring(y.b);
        else
            return nil;
        end

    if E then
        return E;
    end

        end

    E=C;
end

        E=C;

    end

end

    Y.descs[Q]=E;
end
;
return E;
end

function Y.build(k,y,Q,E)y.token=(y.token or 0)+1;

function Y.set(k,y,Q,E)
    if typeof(k)~="Instance"or k==M then
        return;
    end
;
local I=type(y)=="table"and tonumber(y.u)or nil;
local C=type(y)=='table'and tonumber(y.b)or nil;
if I and(I<1 or I>=10000000000000)then
    I=nil;
end
;
if C and(C<1 or C>=10000000000000)then
    C=nil;
end
;
if not I and not C then
    Y.clear(k);
    return;
end
;
local y=I and{u=math.floor(I)}or{b=math.floor(C)};
local C=(I and'u'..y.u or'b'..y.b)..(Q and'|k'or'');
local I=Y.list[k];
if I and I.key==C then
    I.hl=E==true;
    if I.model and I.hlOn~=I.hl then
        U.headless(I.model,I.hl);
        I.hlOn=I.hl;
    end
;
if I.model or I.busy or os.clock()-(I.failAt or 0)<30 then
    return;
end
;
end
;
if not I then
    I={plr=k,hidden={},grips={},corpses={}};
    Y.list[k]=I;
else
    Y.drop(I);
end
;
I.key,I.hl,I.failAt=C,E==true,nil;
Y.bind();
I.gen=(I.gen or 0)+1;
local E=I.gen;
I.busy=true;
task.spawn(
    function()pcall(Y.build,k,I,y,Q);
        if I.gen==E then
            I.busy=false;
        end
    ;
end
);
end

do
    local L=game:GetService('RunService');
    local W={rtt=0.1,jit=0.01,interp=0.08,wire=0,up=0.05,n=0,lastL=0,hbias=0,hn=0,tHist={},mHist={},rawHist={},char=nil,pend=nil};
    local
    function V(r,_,q)

    end

    end

    q=q and math.max(q,s/1000)or s/1000;

end

local K={};
function K.leadT()
    return math.clamp(r()+W.interp+math.clamp(W.hbias,-0.08,0.2)+(tonumber(X.sheriff.predEx)or 0),0.02,0.6);
end
;
function K.jitter()
    return W.jit;
end
;
function K.uplink()
    return W.up;
end
;
function K.stats()
    return{rtt=W.rtt,wire=W.wire,jit=W.jit,interp=W.interp,up=W.up,n=W.n,hbias=W.hbias,hn=W.hn,lead=K.leadT()};
end
;
function K.note(q,u,s,h)
    local Y=u-q;
    if Y.Magnitude<0.5 then
        W.pend=nil;
        return;
    end
;
W.pend={t=os.clock(),o=q,u=Y.Unit,char=s,v=h or Vector3.new(0,0,0),rh=W.rawHist,base=r()+W.interp};
end
;
function K.onFired(q,u,s)
    local h=W.pend;
    if not h then
        return;
    end
;
if typeof(q)=='Vector3'then
    h.startP=q;
end
;
if typeof(u)=="Vector3"and typeof(s)=="Instance"and h.char and s:IsDescendantOf(h.char)then
    h.endP=u;
    local q=0.5;
    pcall(
        function()
            local u,Y=s.CFrame,s.Size;
            q=0.5*(math.abs(u.RightVector:Dot(h.u))*Y.X+math.abs(u.UpVector:Dot(h.u))*Y.Y+math.abs(u.LookVector:Dot(h.u))*Y.Z);
        end
);
h.hw=math.clamp(q,0.2,1.2);
end
;
local q=os.clock()-h.t;
if q>0.005 and q<1.2 then
    if W.wire>0 then
        W.jit=V(W.jit,math.abs(q-W.wire),0.2);
    end
;
W.wire=W.wire>0 and V(W.wire,q,0.25)or q;
end
;
end
;
local
function q(u,s,h,Y)
    local l,x;
    for S=s,1,-1.0 do
        if not l and u[s].t-u[S].t>=h then
            l=u[S];
        end
    ;
    if l and l.t-u[S].t>=Y then
        x=u[S];
        break;
    end
;
end
;
if not(x and l)then
    return nil;
end
;
local u=l.t-x.t;
if u<0.03 then
    return nil;
end
;
local s=(l.p-x.p)/u;
return Vector3.new(s.X,0,s.Z),(l.t+x.t)*0.5;
end
;
function K.turnRate()
    local u=W.tHist;
    local s=#u;
    if s<5 then
        return 0;
    end
;
local h,Y=q(u,s,0,0.12);
local l,x=q(u,s,0.12,0.12);
if not(h and l and Y and x)then
    return 0;
end
;
if h.Magnitude<4 or l.Magnitude<4 then
    return 0;
end
;
local q,u=l.Unit,h.Unit;
local s=Vector3.new(-q.Z,0,q.X);
local h=math.atan2(s:Dot(u),q:Dot(u));
local q=Y-x;
if q<0.03 then
    return 0;
end
;
local u=h/q;
if u~=u then
    return 0;
end
;
return math.clamp(u,-6.0,6);
end
;
function K.arcLead(q,u)
    local s=q.Magnitude;
    if s<0.001 or u<=0 then
        return Vector3.new(0,0,0),q;
    end
;
local h=q.Unit;
local Y=K.turnRate();
if math.abs(Y)<0.35 then
    return q*u,q;
end
;
local q=Vector3.new(-h.Z,0,h.X);
local l,x=s/Y,math.clamp(Y*u,-1.0,1);
local u=h*(l*math.sin(x))+q*(l*(1-math.cos(x)));
local Y=(h*math.cos(x)+q*math.sin(x))*s;
return u,Y;
end
;
local q={HumanoidRootPart=true,UpperTorso=true,LowerTorso=true,Torso=true,Head=true};
function K.bestPart(u,s)
    if not u or typeof(s)~='Vector3'or s.Magnitude<0.001 then
        return nil,0;
    end
;
local h=s.Unit;
local s=math.abs(h.Y)>0.9 and Vector3.new(1,0,0)or Vector3.new(0,1,0);
local Y=h:Cross(s);
if Y.Magnitude<0.001 then
    return nil,0;
end
;
Y=Y.Unit;
local s=h:Cross(Y).Unit;
local h,l;
for x,x in ipairs(u:GetChildren())do
    if x:IsA("BasePart")and q[x.Name]and x.Transparency<1 then
        local q,u=x.CFrame,x.Size;
        local S,k,y=u.X*0.5,u.Y*0.5,u.Z*0.5;
        local u,Q,E=q.RightVector,q.UpVector,q.LookVector;
        local q=S*math.abs(u:Dot(Y))+k*math.abs(Q:Dot(Y))+y*math.abs(E:Dot(Y));
        local Y=S*math.abs(u:Dot(s))+k*math.abs(Q:Dot(s))+y*math.abs(E:Dot(s));
        local u=math.min(q,Y);
        if not l or u>l then
            h,l=x,u;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
return h,l or 0;
end
;
function K.bestAxis(q,u)
    local s=q and(q:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or q:FindFirstChild("Torso"));
    if not s then
        return nil,nil,0;
    end
;
local h=s.CFrame;
local s={Vector3.new(h.LookVector.X,0,h.LookVector.Z),Vector3.new(h.RightVector.X,0,h.RightVector.Z)};
if u and u.Magnitude>0.1 then
    s[#s+1]=Vector3.new(u.X,0,u.Z);
end
;
local u,h,Y;
for l,l in ipairs(s)do
    if l.Magnitude>0.1 then
        local s=l.Unit;
        local l,x=K.bestPart(q,s);
        if l and(not Y or x>Y)then
            u,h,Y=s,l,x;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
return u,h,Y or 0;
end
;
local
function q(u,s,h)
    local Y,l,x={},{},{};
    for S=s,h do
        local s=u[S].p;
        Y[#Y+1]=s.X;
        l[#l+1]=s.Y;
        x[#x+1]=s.Z;
    end
;
if#Y==0 then
    return nil;
end
;
table.sort(Y);
table.sort(l);
table.sort(x);
local u=math.floor(#Y/2)+1;
return Vector3.new(Y[u],l[u],x[u]);
end
;
function K.jumpCycle()
    local u=W.rawHist;
    local s=#u;
    if s<8 then
        return false,0;
    end
;
local h=u[s].t;
local Y=1;
for l=s,1,-1.0 do
    if h-u[l].t>0.6 then
        Y=l+1;
        break;
    end
;
end
;
if s-Y+1<8 then
    return false,0;
end
;
local h,l=math.huge,-math.huge;
local x,S=0,0;
for k=Y+1,s do
    local s=u[k].p.Y;
    if s<h then
        h=s;
    end
;
if s>l then
    l=s;
end
;
local Y=s-u[k-1].p.Y;
if math.abs(Y)>0.05 then
    local u=Y>0 and 1 or-1.0;
    if S~=0 and u~=S then
        x=x+1;
    end
;
S=u;
end
;
end
;
local u=l-h;
return u>4 and x>=2,u;
end
;
function K.resolve()
    local u=W.rawHist;
    local s=#u;
    if s<6 then
        return nil,'none';
    end
;
local h=u[s].t;
local Y=1;
for l=s,1,-1.0 do
    if h-u[l].t>0.35 then
        Y=l+1;
        break;
    end
;
end
;
if s-Y+1<5 then
    return nil,"none";
end
;
local h=q(u,Y,s);
if not h then
    return nil,'none';
end
;
local l,x,S,k=0,0,0,0;
for y=Y,s do
    local Q=(u[y].p-h).Magnitude;
    x=x+Q;
    S=S+1;
    if Q>k then
        k=Q;
    end
;
if Q>50 then
    l=l+1;
end
;
end
;
local y=S>0 and x/S or 0;
if l>0 and k>100 then
    local l={};
    for x=Y,s do
        if(u[x].p-h).Magnitude<=25 then
            l[#l+1]=u[x];
        end
    ;
end
;
if#l>=3 then
    return q(l,1,#l),'blink';
end
;
return nil,'none';
end
;
local q=(u[s].p-u[Y].p).Magnitude;
if y>3 and q<y*1.5 then
    return h,'jitter';
end
;
return nil,"clean";
end

V.loadState=
function()pcall(
        function()
            if not(isfile and isfile(V.file))then
                return;
            end
        ;
        local I=Q:JSONDecode(readfile(V.file));
        if type(I)~='table'then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local C=tonumber(I.pingCal)~=nil;
    if C and tonumber(I.L)then
        V.L=math.clamp(tonumber(I.L),-0.1,0.45);
    end
;
if C and tonumber(I.Lsd)then
    V.Lsd=math.clamp(tonumber(I.Lsd),0.035,0.12);
end
;
if tonumber(I.D)then
    V.D=math.clamp(tonumber(I.D),0.06,0.32);
end
;
if tonumber(I.vsLock)==1 or tonumber(I.vsLock)==-1.0 then
    V.vsLock=tonumber(I.vsLock);
end
;
if tonumber(I.cooldown)then
    V.cooldown=math.min(math.clamp(tonumber(I.cooldown),V.cdFloor,6),3.2);
end
;
if C and tonumber(I.hits)then
    V.calib=tonumber(I.hits);
end
;
if tonumber(I.Lnr)then
    V.Lnr=math.clamp(tonumber(I.Lnr),0,0.5);
end
;
if tonumber(I.Lnrsd)then
    V.Lnrsd=math.clamp(tonumber(I.Lnrsd),0.03,0.12);
end
;
if tonumber(I.nrHits)then
    V.nrCalib=tonumber(I.nrHits);
end
;
if type(I.skipT)=='boolean'then
    V.skipTransparent=I.skipT;
end
;
if type(I.backpack)=="boolean"then
    V.backpackOk=I.backpack;
end

if tonumber(I.pingCal)then

end

);

V.watchLag=PULSE_NV(
    function(y,Q,I,C,H)
        local n=V.lagDB[y.UserId];
        if not n then
            n={js={}};
            V.lagDB[y.UserId]=n;
        end
    ;
    if n.c~=Q then
        n.c,n.py,n.ev=Q,nil,nil;
    end
;
local y=C:GetState();

    local I=n.ev;
    if I then
        if Q<=I.ymin+0.05 then
            if Q<I.ymin then
                I.ymin=Q;
            end
        ;
        I.tmin=H;
    end
;
if Q>I.ymin+0.3 and Q-n.py>0.25 then
    local C=I.tmin-I.t0+0.008;
    if C>0.04 and C<0.5 then
        local O,N=n.js,V.lagPool;
        O[#O+1]=C;
        if#O>7 then
            table.remove(O,1);
        end
    ;
    N[#N+1]=C;
    if#N>40 then
        table.remove(N,1);
    end
;
V.lagVer=(V.lagVer or 0)+1;
V.lagCount=(V.lagCount or 0)+1;
if V.lagCount%8==0 and#N>=8 then
    V.lagPrior=V.median(N);
    V.saveState();
end
;
end
;
n.ev=nil;
elseif H-I.t0>0.6 then
        n.ev=nil;
    end
;
elseif y==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping and n.pst~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
        n.ev={t0=H,ymin=Q,tmin=H};
    end
;
end
;
n.py,n.pst=Q,y;
end
);
V.lagOf=
function(y)
    local Q;
    if y then
        local I=V.lagCP;
        if I and V.lagCC==y and I.Character==y and I.Parent then
            Q=I;
        else
            Q=r:GetPlayerFromCharacter(y);
            V.lagCC,V.lagCP=y,Q;
        end
    ;
end
;
local y=Q and V.lagDB[Q.UserId];
local Q=V.lagVer or 0;
local I;
if y and#y.js>0 then
    if y.medVer~=Q or y.medN~=#y.js then
        y.medVer,y.medN,y.med=Q,#y.js,V.median(y.js);
    end
;
I=y.med;
elseif y then
        I=false;
    end
;
local C;
if#V.lagPool>=4 then
    if V.poolMedVer~=Q or V.poolMedN~=#V.lagPool or V.poolMedT~=V.lagPool then
        V.poolMedVer,V.poolMedN,V.poolMedT,V.poolMed=Q,#V.lagPool,V.lagPool,V.median(V.lagPool);
    end
;
C=V.poolMed;
end
;
C=C or V.lagPrior;
local Q;
if I and C then
    local H=#y.js;
    Q=(I*H+C*3)/(H+3);
else
    Q=C or I and#y.js>=2 and I or nil;
end
;
if not Q then
    return 0;
end
;
return math.clamp(Q-V.lagRef,-0.07,0.25);
end

V.track=PULSE_NV(
    function()do
            local y=getgenv and getgenv();
            local Q=y and rawget(y,"__pulseWorldBase");
            V.G=type(Q)=='table'and tonumber(Q.Gravity)or workspace.Gravity;
        end
    ;
    local y=V.roles();
    local Q,Q=V.murderer(y);
    if V.forced and V.forced.Parent then
        Q=V.forced;
    end
;
local I=V.queued;
if I and I.c and I.c.Parent then
    Q=I.c;
end
;
if Q~=V.target then
    V.target,V.hist=Q,{};
end
;
local I=os.clock();
for C,C in ipairs(h())do
    if C~=E then
        local H=C.Character;
        local n=H and _(H,"HumanoidRootPart");
        local O=H and q(H,'Humanoid');
        if n and O then
            V.watchLag(C,H,n,O,I);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
V.shift=Q and V.lagOf(Q)or 0;
if Q then
    local I=V.sample(Q);
    if I and V.dsFarP(I.p)then
        local C=V.ds;
        if not C or C.c~=Q then
            C={c=Q};
            V.ds=C;
        end
    ;
    if not C.farAt or C.backAt then
        table.clear(V.hist);
        V.hcut=os.clock();
        C.since=I.t;
    end
;
C.farAt,C.backAt=I.t,nil;
I=nil;
elseif I and V.ds and V.ds.c==Q and V.ds.farAt and not V.ds.backAt then
        V.ds.backAt=I.t;
        table.clear(V.hist);
        V.say(string.format('DESYNC back %s after %.2fs',Q.Name,I.t-(V.ds.since or V.ds.farAt)));
    end
;
if I then
    local C=V.hist;
    local H=C[#C];
    if not H or I.t-H.t>=0.004166666666666667 then
        if H and(I.p-H.p).Magnitude>8 then
            V.jumps=(V.jumps or 0)+1;
        end
    ;
    if H and(I.p-H.p).Magnitude>60 and V.spikeOn~=true then
        table.clear(C);
        V.hcut=os.clock();
    end
;
C[#C+1]=I;
if V.spoofOn~=false and typeof(I.v)=='Vector3'and H and I.v.Magnitude>=(V.spoofMin or 400)then
    local n,O=pcall(V.kinVel,C,I.t,0.1);
    O=n and typeof(O)=="Vector3"and O or(I.p-H.p)/math.max(I.t-H.t,0.004166666666666667);
    if O.Magnitude<I.v.Magnitude*(V.spoofK or 0.25)then
        I.vr=I.v;
        I.v=O;
    end
;
end
;
while#C>2 and I.t-C[1].t>3 do
    table.remove(C,1);
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
V.othersC,V.othersData,V.othersDirty=Q,y,true;
end
);
V.getOthers=
function()
    if not V.othersDirty then
        return V.others or{};
    end
;
V.othersDirty=false;
local y,Q=V.othersC,V.othersData or{};
local I={};
local C=V.duel();
for H,H in ipairs(h())do
    if H~=E and H.Character~=y and not(C and C.foes[H.Name])then
        local h=Q[H.Name];
        local y=H.Character;
        local Q=y and _(y,'HumanoidRootPart');
        local _=y and q(y,"Humanoid");
        if Q and _ and _.Health>0 and not(h and(h.Dead or h.Killed))then
            I[#I+1]={c=y,p=Q.Position,md=_.MoveDirection,ws=_.WalkSpeed};
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
V.others=I;
return I;
end
;
V.dsFarP=
function(_)
    return _.X~=_.X or _.Y~=_.Y or _.Z~=_.Z or _.Magnitude>(V.dsFar or 1000000);
end
;
V.dsHot=
function(_)
    local q=V.ds;
    if not q or not q.backAt or _ and q.c~=_ then
        return false;
    end
;
return os.clock()-q.backAt<(V.dsWinT or 0.9);
end
;
V.spShots=false;
V.sp={c=nil,on=false,since=0,endAt=nil};
V.spTick=
function(_)
    local q=V.target;
    local h=V.sp;
    if h.c~=q then
        h.c,h.on,h.since,h.endAt=q,false,0,nil;
    end
;
if not q then
    return;
end
;
local y,Q=pcall(V.spoofVel,q);
local I=y and typeof(Q)=='Vector3';
if I and not h.on then
    h.on,h.since=true,_;
    V.say(string.format('SPOOF on %s |v|=%.0f, waiting for a window',q.Name,Q.Magnitude));
elseif not I and h.on then
        h.on,h.endAt=false,_;
        V.say(string.format("SPOOF off %s after %.2fs",q.Name,_-h.since));
    end
;
end
;
V.spActive=
function(_)
    local q=V.sp;
    return q.on and q.c==_;
end
;
V.spHot=
function(_)
    local q=V.sp;
    return not q.on and q.c==_ and q.endAt~=nil and os.clock()-q.endAt<(V.spWinT or 0.9);
end

V.at=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        local h=#_;
        if h==0 then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    if q>=_[h].t then
        return _[h],h;
    end
;
if q<=_[1].t then
    return _[1],1;
end
;
local y,Q=1,h;
while y<Q do
    local h=math.floor((y+Q+1)/2);
    if _[h].t<=q then
        y=h;
    else
        Q=h-1;
    end
;
end
;
return _[y],y;
end
);
V.posAt=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        local h,y=V.at(_,q);
        if not h then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    local Q=_[y+1];
    if not Q or q<=h.t then
        return h.p;
    end
;
return h.p:Lerp(Q.p,math.clamp((q-h.t)/math.max(0.0001,Q.t-h.t),0,1));
end
);
V.kinVel=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h)h=h or 0.1;
        if#_<2 or q-h<_[1].t then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    local y,Q=V.posAt(_,q),V.posAt(_,q-h);
    if not(Q and y)then
        return nil;
    end
;
local I=(y-Q)/h;
local Q=V.posAt(_,q-h*0.5);
local C=Q and(y-Q)/(h*0.5)or I;
if(I-C).Magnitude<0.35*math.max(I.Magnitude,C.Magnitude)+3 then
    return C.Magnitude<400 and C or Vector3.zero;
end
;
local h=V.posAt(_,q-0.025);
local _=h and(y-h)/0.025 or Vector3.zero;
if _.Magnitude>300 then
    return Vector3.zero;
end
;
return _;
end
);
V.speedFactor=PULSE_NV(
    function(_)
        local q=#_;
        if q<10 then
            return 1;
        end
    ;
    local h=_[q].t;
    local y={};
    local Q=q;
    while Q>1 and h-_[Q].t<1.5 do
        local q=_[Q];
        local I=q.t-0.2>=_[1].t and V.posAt(_,q.t-0.2)or nil;
        local C=V.at(_,q.t-V.D);
        local H=V.at(_,q.t-V.D-0.2);
        if I and C and H and C.md.Magnitude>0.9 and H.md.Magnitude>0.9 and C.md:Dot(H.md)>0.95 and not q.air then
            local H=(q.p-I)/0.2;
            local q=Vector3.new(H.X,0,H.Z).Magnitude;
            local I=C.ws*C.md.Magnitude;
            if I>4 and q>2 then
                y[#y+1]=q/I;
            end
        ;
    end
;
Q-=3;
end
;
local q=#y>=5 and math.clamp(V.median(y),0.4,8)or 1;
if V.kFit==true then
    local y,Q=V.velMdFit(_,h);
    if y and Q and y<(V.velFitDeg or 25)and Q>math.max(V.kFitMin or 1.6,q*1.4)then
        q=math.clamp(Q,0.4,8);
    end
;
end
;
return q;
end
);
V.kNow=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h)
        local y=V.kLocW or 0;
        if y<=0 then
            return h;
        end
    ;
    local Q=V.kLocWin or 0.25;
    local I,C=V.posAt(_,q),V.posAt(_,q-Q);
    if not(I and C)then
        return h;
    end
;
local H,n=0,0;
for O=0,4 do
    local N=V.at(_,q-Q+(O+0.5)*Q/5-V.D);
    if not N or N.air then
        return h;
    end
;
H+=N.md.X*N.ws*Q/5;
n+=N.md.Z*N.ws*Q/5;
end
;
local _=math.sqrt(H*H+n*n);
if _<(V.kLocMin or 1.5)then
    return h;
end
;
local q=I-C;
local Q=math.sqrt(q.X*q.X+q.Z*q.Z)/_;
if Q>=h*(V.kLocThr or 0.6)then
    return h;
end
;
return h+(math.max(Q,0.15)-h)*y;
end
);
V.jumpTau=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        local h=#_;
        local y=h;
        local h=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping;
        local Q=V.jFlagLead or 0;
        local I;
        while y>1 and q-_[y].t<0.4+V.shiftJ()do
            local C,H=_[y],_[y-1];
            if I and I-C.t>(V.jFlagWin or 0.15)then
                break;
            end
        ;
        if C.t<=q then
            if C.jump and not H.jump and not I then
                if Q<=0 then
                    return C.t+V.J+V.shiftJ()-q;
                end
            ;
            I=C.t;
        end
    ;
    if C.st==h and H.st~=h and not H.air then
        return C.t+V.J+V.shiftJ()-q;
    end
;
if C.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and C.jump and not H.air and H.st~=h and H.st~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
    return C.t+V.J+V.shiftJ()-q;
end
;
if V.ffJump==true and C.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and not C.air and not H.air and(H.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running or H.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics or H.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)then
    return C.t+V.J+V.shiftJ()-q;
end
;
end
;
y-=1;
end
;
if I then
    return I+V.J+V.shiftJ()-Q-q;
end
;
return nil;
end
);
V.mdAvg=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h)
        local y,Q,I=0,0,0;
        for C=#_,1,-1.0 do
            local H=_[C];
            if H.t<=q then
                if q-H.t>h then
                    break;
                end
            ;
            y+=H.md.X;
            Q+=H.md.Z;
            I+=1;
        end
    ;
end
;
if I==0 then
    return nil;
end
;
return Vector3.new(y/I,0,Q/I);
end
);
V.clampTraj=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        if V.kinClamp~=true or not _ or#_<3 or not q then
            return _;
        end
    ;
    local h;
    local y=1;
    while y<#_ do
        local Q=math.min(y+2,#_);
        local I,C=_[y].p,_[Q].p;
        local H=C-I;
        local C=H.Magnitude;
        if C>0.001 then
            local n=workspace:Raycast(I,H,q);
            if n then
                h=n.Position-H/C*(V.kinStandoff or 0.6);
                for q=y+1,#_ do
                    _[q].p=h;
                end
            ;
            break;
        end
    ;
end
;
y=Q;
end
;
return _;
end
);
V.fastRecent=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h)
        local y=0;
        for Q=#_,2,-1.0 do
            local I=_[Q];
            if q-I.t>h then
                break;
            end
        ;
        if I.t<=q+0.000001 then
            local q;
            if typeof(I.v)=='Vector3'then
                q=Vector3.new(I.v.X,0,I.v.Z).Magnitude;
            elseif I.t-0.1>=_[1].t then
                    local h=V.posAt(_,I.t-0.1);
                    if h then
                        q=Vector3.new(I.p.X-h.X,0,I.p.Z-h.Z).Magnitude/0.1;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
        if q and q<400 and q>y then
            y=q;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
return y;
end
);
V.velMdFit=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        local h=V.vfCache;
        if h and h.h==_ and h.t==q and h.n==#_ then
            return h.deg,h.mag;
        end
    ;
    local h=V.velLagFit or 0.16;
    local y=V.velFitWin or 0.6;
    local Q,I={},{};
    local C=#_;
    while C>=2 do
        local H=_[C];
        if q-H.t>y then
            break;
        end
    ;
    if H.t<=q+0.000001 and typeof(H.v)=='Vector3'then
        local y,n=H.v.X,H.v.Z;
        local O=math.sqrt(y*y+n*n);
        if O>(V.velFitMinV or 30)and O<400 then
            local N=V.at(_,H.t-h);
            local h=N and N.md;
            if h and h.X*h.X+h.Z*h.Z>0.25 then
                local H=(math.atan2(n,y)-math.atan2(h.Z,h.X)+3.141592653589793)%6.283185307179586-3.141592653589793;
                Q[#Q+1]=math.abs(H);
                I[#I+1]=O/math.max(1,N.ws or 16);
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
C-=2;
end
;
local h,y;
if#Q>=(V.velFitNeed or 8)then
    h=math.deg(V.median(Q));
    y=V.median(I);
end
;
V.vfCache={h=_,t=q,n=#_,deg=h,mag=y};
return h,y;
end
);
V.velTraj=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h,y,Q)
        local I=V.at(_,q)or _[#_];
        local C=V.posAt(_,q)or I.p;
        local H=typeof(I.v)=="Vector3"and I.v or V.kinVel(_,q,0.08)or Vector3.zero;
        local n,O,N=H.X,H.Y,H.Z;
        local H=math.sqrt(n*n+N*N);
        local z,D,b=V.velOm or 1.2,V.velLag or 0.17,V.velAcc or 0.5;
        if Q then
            z,D,b=V.velOmFit or 20,V.velLagFit or 0.16,V.velAccFit or 0;
            if V.velKinScale==true and H>1 then
                local Z=V.velKinWin or 0.3;
                local P,P=V.at(_,q);
                P=P or#_;
                local i,d=0,0;
                local g=P;
                while g>1 and q-_[g-1].t<=Z do
                    local Z,P=_[g-1],_[g];
                    local o,p=P.p.X-Z.p.X,P.p.Z-Z.p.Z;
                    i+=math.sqrt(o*o+p*p);
                    local o=typeof(Z.v)=='Vector3'and Z.v or nil;
                    if o then
                        d+=math.sqrt(o.X*o.X+o.Z*o.Z)*(P.t-Z.t);
                    end
                ;
                g-=1;
            end
        ;
        if d>5 then
            local Z=math.clamp(i/d,V.velKinLo or 0.6,V.velKinHi or 1.15);
            n,N=n*Z,N*Z;
            H=H*Z;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local Z=0;
local P=V.at(_,q-0.05);
if b~=0 and P and P~=I and I.t>P.t+0.01 then
    local i=typeof(P.v)=="Vector3"and P.v or V.kinVel(_,P.t,0.08);
    if i then
        Z=math.clamp((H-Vector3.new(i.X,0,i.Z).Magnitude)/(I.t-P.t),-300.0,300)*b;
    end
;
end
;
local b=V.mode(_)=='nr'or V.flightLike(_,q);
local P=I.st;
local i=not b and(P==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or P==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or I.air or math.abs(O)>8);
local P;
local
function d()
    local g=workspace:Raycast(C,Vector3.new(0,-60.0,0),y);
    P=g and g.Position.Y+(I.hh or 2)+1 or nil;
end
;
if i then
    d();
end
;
local g;
if V.velHop~=false and not b and typeof(I.v)=='Vector3'then
    local I=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed;
    local o,o=V.at(_,q);
    o=o or#_;
    for p=o,2,-1.0 do
        local m=_[p];
        if q-m.t>(V.velHopWin or 0.35)then
            break;
        end
    ;
    if m.st==I and _[p-1].st~=I then
        local I,j=false,V.velHopFlag==false;
        for e=p,o do
            local p=_[e].v;
            if typeof(p)=='Vector3'and p.Y>20 then
                I=true;
                break;
            end
        ;
    end
;
if not j then
    for p=o,1,-1.0 do
        local o=_[p];
        if o.t<m.t-0.3 then
            break;
        end
    ;
    if o.jump then
        j=true;
        break;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
if not I and j then
    g=m.t+(V.velHopLag or 0.2)-q;
end
;
break;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local I=V.G or workspace.Gravity;
local o,p=0,nil;
if Q and(V.velExtK or 0)>0 then
    local Q=V.velExtWin or 0.1;
    local m,j=V.at(_,q),V.at(_,q-Q);
    if m and j and m.md.X*m.md.X+m.md.Z*m.md.Z>0.25 and j.md.X*j.md.X+j.md.Z*j.md.Z>0.25 then
        p=math.atan2(m.md.Z,m.md.X);
        local m=(p-math.atan2(j.md.Z,j.md.X)+3.141592653589793)%6.283185307179586-3.141592653589793;
        o=math.clamp(m/Q,-(V.velExtMax or 15),V.velExtMax or 15)*V.velExtK;
    end
;
end
;
local Q={{tau=0,p=C}};
local m,j,e=C.X,C.Y,C.Z;
local C=0;
while C<h do
    C+=0.016666666666666666;
    if z>0 and H>1 then
        local h=V.at(_,math.min(q+C-D,q));
        local _=h and h.md;
        if _ and _.X*_.X+_.Z*_.Z>0.01 then
            local q=math.atan2(N,n);
            local h=math.atan2(_.Z,_.X);
            if p and C>D then
                h=p+o*(C-D);
            end
        ;
        local _=(h-q+3.141592653589793)%6.283185307179586-3.141592653589793;
        q+=math.clamp(_,-z*0.016666666666666666,z*0.016666666666666666);
        n,N=math.cos(q)*H,math.sin(q)*H;
    end
;
end
;
if Z~=0 and H>1 then
    local _=math.max(0,H+Z*0.016666666666666666);
    n,N=n/H*_,N/H*_;
    H=_;
end
;
if g and C>=g then
    g=nil;
    O=V.velHopV or 46;
    if not i then
        i=true;
        d();
    end
;
end
;
if i then
    O-=I*0.016666666666666666;
end
;
m+=n*0.016666666666666666;
j+=O*0.016666666666666666;
e+=N*0.016666666666666666;
if P and j<P then
    j,O=P,0;
end
;
Q[#Q+1]={tau=C,p=Vector3.new(m,j,e)};
end
;
if b then
    return Q;
end
;
return V.clampTraj(Q,y);
end
);
V.simulate=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h,y,Q,I,C,H)
        if y=='vel'then
            return V.velTraj(_,q,Q,C);
        end
    ;
    if y=='velf'then
        return V.velTraj(_,q,Q,C,true);
    end
;
local n=V.at(_,q)or _[#_];
local O=V.posAt(_,q)or n.p;
local N=V.kinVel(_,q,0.08)or Vector3.zero;
if y=="fly"then
    local z={{tau=0,p=O}};
    local D=0;
    while D<Q do
        D+=0.016666666666666666;
        z[#z+1]={tau=D,p=O+N*D};
    end
;
if V.mode(_)=="nr"then
    return z;
end
;
return V.clampTraj(z,C);
end
;
if y=="mdv"or y=="arc"then
    local z={{tau=0,p=O}};
    local D=Vector3.new(N.X,0,N.Z);
    local b=D.Magnitude;
    local Z=0;
    local P;
    if y=="arc"then
        local i,d,g=V.posAt(_,q-0.07),V.posAt(_,q-0.035),O;
        if i and d and q-0.07>=_[1].t then
            local o,p,m,j,e,v=i.X,i.Z,d.X,d.Z,g.X,g.Z;
            local i=2*(o*(j-v)+m*(v-p)+e*(p-j));
            if math.abs(i)>0.0001 then
                local d=((o*o+p*p)*(j-v)+(m*m+j*j)*(v-p)+(e*e+v*v)*(p-j))/i;
                local g=((o*o+p*p)*(e-m)+(m*m+j*j)*(o-e)+(e*e+v*v)*(m-o))/i;
                local i=math.sqrt((e-d)^2+(v-g)^2);
                if i>0.5 and i<150 then
                    local i=math.atan2(j-g,m-d);
                    local o=math.atan2(v-g,e-d);
                    local p=o-i;
                    if p>3.141592653589793 then
                        p-=6.283185307179586;
                    elseif p<-3.141592653589793 then
                            p+=6.283185307179586;
                        end
                    ;
                    Z=math.clamp(p/0.035,-40.0,40);
                    P=Vector3.new(d,0,g);
                    local P=Vector3.new(e-d,0,v-g);
                    D=Vector3.new(-P.Z,0,P.X)*Z;
                    b=D.Magnitude;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local P=O;
local i=0;
while i<Q do

V.innocentRisk=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h,y)
        for Q,Q in ipairs(V.getOthers())do
            if Q.c==y then
                continue;
            end
        ;
        local y=Q.p+Vector3.new(Q.md.X,0,Q.md.Z)*(Q.ws*math.max(V.L,0.15));
        for I,I in ipairs({Q.p,y,(Q.p+y)*0.5})do
            local y=math.clamp((I-_):Dot(q),0,h);
            local h=_+q*y;
            local _=I.Y-h.Y;
            if Vector3.new(I.X-h.X,0,I.Z-h.Z).Magnitude<(V.innocentMargin or 3.5)and _>-3.8 and _<4.8 then
                return true;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
return false;
end

V.selfShift=
function()
    local _=rawget(getgenv(),'__pulseInvis');
    if type(_)~='table'or not _.active or typeof(_.real)~='CFrame'then
        return Vector3.zero;
    end
;
if os.clock()-(tonumber(_.realAt)or 0)>(V.shiftFresh or 0.3)then
    return Vector3.zero;
end
;
local q=E.Character and E.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
if not q then
    return Vector3.zero;
end
;
local h=_.real.Position-q.Position;
local _=h.Magnitude;
if _<190000 or _>210000 then
    return Vector3.zero;
end
;
return h;
end
;
V.visible=PULSE_NV(
    function(_)
        local q=E.Character;
        local h=q and q:FindFirstChild('Head');
        if not h then
            return false;
        end
    ;
    local q=h.Position+V.selfShift();
    for h,h in ipairs({"HumanoidRootPart","Head","UpperTorso","Torso"})do
        local y=_:FindFirstChild(h);
        if y then
            local h=y.Position-q;
            if not V.serverRay(q,h,{_})then
                return true;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
return false;
end

V.anomaly=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        if V.anomDetect==false then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    local h=#_;
    local y=h;
    while y>1 and q-_[y-1].t<=0.6 do
        y-=1;
    end
;
if h-y+1<12 then
    return nil;
end
;
local Q,I=0,0;
local C,H=0,0;
for n=y+1,h do
    local O=_[n].t-_[n-1].t;
    if O>0 then
        local N=_[n].p-_[n-1].p;
        local n=N.Magnitude;
        I+=1;
        if n<0.001 then
            H+=O;
        else
            if H>=0.04 and n>math.max(0.5,H*8)and n<H*60+3 then
                C+=H;
            end
        ;
        H=0;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
do
    local I=_[y].t;
    local H,n;
    while I<=q do
        local q=V.posAt(_,I);
        if H then
            local O=(q-n-(n-H)).Magnitude;
            if O>1.3 and O<25 then
                Q+=1;
            end
        ;
    end
;
H,n=n,q;
I+=0.016666666666666666;
end
;
end
;
local q=_[h].t-_[y].t;
if q<=0.2 then
    return nil;
end
;
local I=(_[h].p-_[y].p).Magnitude/q;
local _=C/q;
if Q>=5 or I>4 and _>0.35 then
    return{jumps=Q,holdFrac=_,avg=I};
end
;
return nil;
end

V.mdTrust=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        local h,y=0,0;
        local Q=#_;
        while Q>1 do
            local I=_[Q];
            if q-I.t>0.6 then
                break;
            end
        ;
        local q,C=V.posAt(_,I.t-0.3),V.posAt(_,I.t);
        local H=q and C and I.t-0.3>=_[1].t and(C-q)/0.3 or nil;
        local q=V.at(_,I.t-V.D);
        if H and q then
            local _=Vector3.new(H.X,0,H.Z);
            local C=Vector3.new(q.md.X,0,q.md.Z);
            if _.Magnitude>6 and C.Magnitude>0.5 then
                h+=_.Unit:Dot(C.Unit);
                y+=1;
            elseif _.Magnitude>6 and C.Magnitude<=0.1 and not I.air then
                    h+=-0.3;
                    y+=1;
                elseif _.Magnitude>6 and C.Magnitude<=0.1 and I.air and(I.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding or I.st==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)then
                        h+=-0.5;
                        y+=1;
                    elseif _.Magnitude<1 and C.Magnitude>0.5 and not I.air then
                            h+=-0.3;
                            y+=1;
                        elseif _.Magnitude<1 and C.Magnitude<=0.5 then
                                h+=1;
                                y+=1;
                            end
                        ;
                    end
                ;
                Q-=3;
            end
        ;
        if y<6 then
            return 1;
        end
    ;
    return math.clamp((h/y-0.15)/0.6,0,1);
end
);
V.resolverHyps=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h,y,Q)
        local I=#_;
        local
        function C(H)
            local n=I;
            while n>1 and q-_[n-1].t<=H do
                n-=1;
            end
        ;
        local H={};
        for O=n,I do
            H[#H+1]=O;
        end
    ;
    return H;
end

local
function H(n)
    local O=#n;
    local N,z=0,0;
    local D,b=Vector3.zero,Vector3.zero;
    for Z,Z in ipairs(n)do
        local n=_[Z].t-q;
        N+=n;
        z+=n*n;
        D+=_[Z].p;
        b+=_[Z].p*n;
    end
;
local n=O*z-N*N;
local z=n>1e-9 and(b*O-D*N)/n or Vector3.zero;
return(D-z*N)/O,z;
end
;
local
function n(O)
    if#O<6 then
        return nil;
    end
;
local N,z=H(O);
local D={};
for b,b in ipairs(O)do
    D[#D+1]=(_[b].p-(N+z*(_[b].t-q))).Magnitude;
end
;
local b=V.median(D)or 0;
local Z={};
for P,i in ipairs(O)do
    if D[P]<=b*3+3 then
        Z[#Z+1]=i;
    end
;
end
;
if#Z>=6 then
    N,z=H(Z);
else
    Z=O;
end
;
return N,z,Z;
end
;
local H=C(Q.jumps>=6 and 1 or 0.7);
local O,N,z=n(H);
if not O then
    return y;
end
;
local H=Vector3.new(N.X,0,N.Z);
if H.Magnitude>150 then
    H=H.Unit*150;
end
;
local n=_[I].air and math.clamp(N.Y,-60.0,60)or 0;
local I=Vector3.new(H.X,n,H.Z);
local H=C(0.6);
local C={};
for n,n in ipairs(H)do
    local H=_[n].p-(O+N*(_[n].t-q));
    if H.Magnitude<=25 then
        C[#C+1]=H;
    end
;
end
;
if#C==0 then
    C[1]=Vector3.zero;
end
;
local _={};
local q=V.lastTrust or 1;
local H;
for n,n in ipairs(y)do
    if n.kind=="md"then
        H=n;
    end
;
end
;
if H and q>=0.6 and Q.holdFrac>0.2 and V.resMd~=false then
    local q=V.trajAt(H.traj,0);
    _[#_+1]={w=0.6,at=
        function(n)
            return V.trajAt(H.traj,n)-q+O;
        end
};
_[#_+1]={w=0.4,at=
    function(q)
        return O+I*q;
    end

else
    _[#_+1]={w=1,at=
        function(q)
            return O+I*q;
        end
};
end
;
local q={};
for H,H in ipairs(y)do
    H.w=H.w*0.25;
    q[#q+1]=H;
end

        n[#n+1]={tau=z,p=H.at(z)};

;
for _=1,y do

        _[#_+1]={tau=C.tau,p=C.p+h};

q[#q+1]={kind="res",w=0.75*H.w/y,traj=_};

Q.vel=I;
Q.base=O;

V.arc3=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h)
        local y=V.kinVel(_,q,0.06);
        local Q=V.kinVel(_,q-0.07,0.06);
        if not(Q and y)or Q.Magnitude<8 or y.Magnitude<8 then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    local I=Q:Cross(y);
    local C=I.Magnitude/(Q.Magnitude*y.Magnitude);
    local H=Q.Unit:Dot(y.Unit);
    local Q=math.atan2(C,H);
    local C=math.clamp(Q/0.07,-8.0,8);
    local Q=V.posAt(_,q)or _[#_].p;
    local _={{tau=0,p=Q}};
    local q=y.Magnitude;
    local H=y.Unit;
    local y=I.Magnitude>0.000001 and I.Unit or Vector3.yAxis;
    local I=0;
    local n,O=math.cos(C*0.016666666666666666),math.sin(C*0.016666666666666666);
    while I<h do
        I+=0.016666666666666666;
        H=H*n+y:Cross(H)*O+y*y:Dot(H)*(1-n);
        H=H.Unit;
        Q=Q+H*q*0.016666666666666666;
        _[#_+1]={tau=I,p=Q};
    end
;
return _;
end

V.caFit=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q,h)
        local y,Q,I,C,H,n=0,0,0,0,0,0;
        local O,N,z={0,0,0},{0,0,0},{0,0,0};
        local D=0;
        for b=#_,1,-1.0 do
            local Z=_[b];
            if Z.t<=q then
                local _=Z.t-q;
                if _<-h then
                    break;
                end
            ;
            local q,h=_,0.5*_*_;
            y+=1;
            Q+=q;
            I+=h;
            C+=q*q;
            H+=q*h;
            n+=h*h;
            local _=Z.p;
            O[1]+=_.X;
            O[2]+=_.X*q;
            O[3]+=_.X*h;
            N[1]+=_.Y;
            N[2]+=_.Y*q;
            N[3]+=_.Y*h;
            z[1]+=_.Z;
            z[2]+=_.Z*q;
            z[3]+=_.Z*h;
            D+=1;
        end
    ;
end
;
if D<(V.caMinN or 6)then
    return nil;
end
;
local _,q,h,D,b,Z=y,Q,I,C,H,n;
local y=_*(D*Z-b*b)-q*(q*Z-b*h)+h*(q*b-D*h);
if math.abs(y)<1e-12 then
    return nil;
end
;
local
function Q(I)
    local C=I[1]*(D*Z-b*b)-q*(I[2]*Z-b*I[3])+h*(I[2]*b-D*I[3]);
    local H=_*(I[2]*Z-b*I[3])-I[1]*(q*Z-b*h)+h*(q*I[3]-I[2]*h);
    local n=_*(D*I[3]-I[2]*b)-q*(q*I[3]-I[2]*h)+I[1]*(q*b-D*h);
    return C/y,H/y,n/y;
end
;
local _,q,h=Q(O);
local y,I,C=Q(N);
local H,n,O=Q(z);
local Q=Vector3.new(h,C,O);
local h=V.caAmax or 900;
if Q.Magnitude>h then
    Q=Q.Unit*h;
end
;
return Vector3.new(_,y,H),Vector3.new(q,I,n),Q;
end

V.flightLike=PULSE_NV(
    function(_,q)
        local h=_[#_];
        if not h then
            return false;
        end
    ;
    local y=Enum.HumanoidStateType;
    local Q=h.st;
    if Q==y.Climbing or Q==y.Swimming then
        return false;
    end
;
local h=Q==y.Freefall or Q==y.Jumping or Q==y.Flying or Q==y.PlatformStanding or Q==y.Physics;
if not h then
    return false;
end
;
local h=0;
for Q=#_,1,-1.0 do
    local I=_[Q];
    if not(I.st==y.Freefall or I.st==y.Jumping or I.st==y.Flying or I.st==y.PlatformStanding or I.st==y.Physics)then
        break;
    end
;
h=q-I.t;
end
;
if h<(V.caAirT or 0.6)then
    return false;
end
;
local y,Q=V.posAt(_,q-0.3),V.posAt(_,q);
if not(y and Q)or(Q-y).Magnitude/0.3<(V.caMinSpd or 28)then
    return false;
end
;
local y=V.G or workspace.Gravity;
local Q,I=0,0;
for C=0,10 do
    local H=q-0.05-C*0.05;
    if H-0.05<q-h then
        break;
    end
;
local q,h,C=V.posAt(_,H-0.05),V.posAt(_,H),V.posAt(_,H+0.05);
if q and h and C then
    local _=(C.Y-2*h.Y+q.Y)/0.0025000000000000005;
    I+=1;
    if math.abs(_+y)<y*(V.caBallTol or 0.35)then
        Q+=1;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
if I<6 then
    return false;

V.shotTraj=
function(r)
    local _={};
    for q,q in ipairs(r.pre or{})do
        _[#_+1]=q;
    end
;
local q=_[#_]and _[#_].t or-math.huge;
for h,h in ipairs(r.post or{})do
    if h.t>q then
        _[#_+1]=h;
        q=h.t;
    end
;
end
;
return _;
end

V.tauGridMin,V.tauGridStep,V.tauGridN=-0.05,0.01,51;
V.tauInit=
function()
    if type(V.tauLog)=='table'and#V.tauLog==V.tauGridN then
        return;
    end
;
V.tauLog={};
local r,_=V.L,math.max(V.Lsd*1.5,0.05);
for q=1,V.tauGridN do
    local h=V.tauGridMin+(q-1)*V.tauGridStep;
    V.tauLog[q]=-0.5*((h-r)/_)^2;
end
;
end
;
V.tauApply=
function()
    local r=0.12+(V.pingCal or 0.05);
    local _={};
    local q=-math.huge;
    for h,y in ipairs(V.tauLog)do
        local Q=V.tauGridMin+(h-1)*V.tauGridStep;
        _[h]=y-0.5*((Q-r)/0.05)^2;
        if _[h]>q then
            q=_[h];
        end
    ;
end
;
local r,h={},0;
for y,Q in ipairs(_)do
    r[y]=math.exp(Q-q);
    h+=r[y];
end
;
local _,q=0,nil;
local y=0;
for Q=1,V.tauGridN do
    local I=V.tauGridMin+(Q-1)*V.tauGridStep;
    y+=I*r[Q]/h;
    _+=r[Q]/h;
    if not q and _>=0.5 then
        q=I;
    end
;
end
;
local _=0;
for Q=1,V.tauGridN do
    local I=V.tauGridMin+(Q-1)*V.tauGridStep;
    _+=(I-y)^2*r[Q]/h;
end
;
V.L=math.clamp(q or y,-0.05,0.45);
V.Lsd=math.clamp(math.sqrt(_),0.035,0.09);
end
;
V.tauEvidence=PULSE_NV(
    function(r,_,q,h)
        if r.mode=="nr"or not r.body or r.offLine then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    local h=V.shotTraj(r);
    if#h<6 then
        return nil;
    end
;
