local y=r.e-r.o;
local Q=y.Unit;
local I=y.Magnitude+400;
local y=math.huge;
if not _ and typeof(q)=='Vector3'then
    y=(q-r.o).Magnitude+0.5;
end
;
local q,C=h[1].t,h[#h].t;
local H=(r.pingS or 0)+(r.shift or 0);
local n,O;
for N=1,V.tauGridN do
    local z=V.tauGridMin+(N-1)*V.tauGridStep;
    local D=r.t+z+H;
    local H;
    if D<q or D>C then
        H=_ and 0.6 or 1;
    else
        local q=V.posAt(h,D);
        local h,C=V.hitsBody(r.body,q,r.o,Q,I);
        local r=h~=nil and h<y;
        if _ then
            H=r and 1 or 0.1;
        else
            H=C and C<y and(V.missCoreLike or 0.3)or(r and(V.missLike or 0.7)or 1);
        end
    ;
    if r then
        if not n then
            n=z;
        end
    ;
    O=z;
end
;
end
;
V.tauLog[N]=V.tauLog[N]*0.97+math.log(H);
end
;
V.tauApply();
V.tauShots=(V.tauShots or 0)+1;
return n,O;
end

local
function T(R)F.log[#F.log+1]=string.format("%.2f %s",os.clock(),R);
    if#F.log>30 then
        table.remove(F.log,1);
    end
;
end
;
local
function R(B)
    if not(B or X.sheriff.autoGun)or t()then
        return false;
    end
;
local B=A.Character;
local c=B and B:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');
if not c or c.Health<=0 then
    return false;
end
;
local c,w=pcall(M);
local M=c and type(w)=="table"and w[A.Name];
if type(M)=='table'then
    if M.Dead==true or M.Killed==true then
        return false;
    end
;
local W=M.Role and tostring(M.Role):lower()or"";
if W=='murderer'or W=="sheriff"then
    return false;
end
;
return true;
end
;
if c and type(w)=="table"and next(w)~=nil then
    return false;
end
;
if B:FindFirstChild('Knife')then
    return false;
end
;
local B=A:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack");
return not(B and B:FindFirstChild("Knife"));
end

local
function B()
    local M=V();
    if M then
        return M,M;
    end
;
K();
if f and J and J.Parent then
    return f,J;
end
;
return nil,nil;
end

local
function f(J,M)firetouchinterest(J,M,0);
    firetouchinterest(J,M,1);
end
;
local
function J(M,c,K)
    local w=U();
    if not(w and c and c.Parent and firetouchinterest)then
        return false;
    end
;
pcall(f,w,c);
if K then
    local K=A.Character;
    if K then
        for A,A in ipairs(K:GetChildren())do
            if A:IsA('BasePart')and A~=w then
                pcall(f,A,c);
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
if M and M~=c then
    for A,A in ipairs(M:GetDescendants())do
        if A:IsA("BasePart")and A~=c then
            pcall(f,w,A);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
return true;
end

local
function A(f)
    local M=getgenv().__pulseInvis;
    if not(M and M.active)then
        return;
    end
;
local M=getgenv();
local c=os.clock();
if M.__pulseInvisPauseDrop~=f then
    M.__pulseInvisPauseDrop,M.__pulseInvisPauseN=f,0;
end
;
if(tonumber(M.__pulseInvisPause)or 0)<c and(M.__pulseInvisPauseN or 0)<4 then
    M.__pulseInvisPauseN=(M.__pulseInvisPauseN or 0)+1;
    M.__pulseInvisPause=c+0.6;
end
;
end

local
function f(M)
    if not R(M)then
        return false;
    end
;
local R,c=B();
if not c then
    return false;
end
;
if not M then
    local B=tonumber(X.sheriff.agDist)or 1000;
    local M=U();
    if B<1000 and M and(M.Position-c.Position).Magnitude>B then
        return false;
    end
;
end
;
local B=os.clock();
if F.drop~=c then
    F.drop,F.t0,F.n,F.fullT,F.goneT=c,B,0,0,nil;
    T("DROP d="..(U()and math.floor((U().Position-c.Position).Magnitude)or-1.0));
end
;
A(R);
local A=B-F.fullT>0.12;
if A then
    F.fullT=B;
end
;
if J(R,c,A)then
    F.n+=1;
end
;
return true;
end

function()
    if A or t()then
        return false;
    end
;
A=true;

    function()
        local J,R=os.clock(),false;
        T("BIND");
        while a[1][a[3]]()and os.clock()-J<2 and not t()do
            local B,U=pcall(f,true);
            if B and U then
                R=true;
            elseif not R and os.clock()-J>0.25 then
                    break;
                end
            ;
            G.Heartbeat:Wait();
        end
    ;
    A=false;
end
);
return true;
end

function(A)
    if not X.sheriff.autoGun then
        return;
    end

    G.Heartbeat:Wait();

    pcall(f);

    function()
        local G=game:GetService('RunService');
        pcall(V);
        local A=false;
        while a[1][a[3]]()do
            G.Heartbeat:Wait();
            local G=t()~=nil;
            local a=F.drop;
            if a then
                local J=os.clock();
                if G and not A then
                    T('GOT n='..F.n.." dt="..string.format("%.2f",J-F.t0));
                    F.drop=nil;
                elseif not a.Parent then
                        F.goneT=F.goneT or J;
                        if G or J-F.goneT>0.6 then
                            T((G and'GOT'or"GONE").." n="..F.n..' dt='..string.format('%.2f',F.goneT-F.t0));
                            F.drop,F.goneT=nil,nil;
                        end
                    ;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    A=G;
    if X.sheriff.autoGun then
        pcall(f);
    end
;
end
;
end
);
end

end

function(G)
    local a=G[0];
    local A=G[1];
    local F=G[5];
    local T=G[3];
    local f=G[4];
    local J=G[2];
    return
    function()
        local G={on={inno=false,sheriff=false,murder=false,exp=false},state="Off",role=nil,log={},drops={},hooked=false,holding=false,acted=false,wins=0,kills=0,seen={},flung=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'}),flingWait=0,lastTp=0,conns={}};
        getgenv().__pulseRoleFarm=G;
        G.Players=game:GetService('Players');
        G.Run=game:GetService("RunService");
        G.KPARTS={'HumanoidRootPart',"UpperTorso",'Torso',"LowerTorso","Head"};
        function G.say(X)G.log[#G.log+1]=string.format('%s %s',os.date("%H:%M:%S"),tostring(X));
            if#G.log>40 then
                table.remove(G.log,1);
            end
        ;
    end
;
function G.mine()
    local X,t=pcall(F[1][F[3]]);
    if not X or type(t)~="table"then
        return nil,{};
    end
;
local F=t[A.Name];
if type(F)~="table"or not F.Role or F.Dead==true or F.Killed==true then
    return nil,t;
end
;
return tostring(F.Role),t;
end
;
function G.hrp()
    local F=A.Character;
    return F and F:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
end
;
function G.hum()
    local F=A.Character;
    return F and F:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
end
;
function G.alive()
    local F=G.hum();
    return F~=nil and F.Health>0;
end
;
function G.lobbyCF()
    local F=workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")or workspace:FindFirstChild("Lobby");
    local X;
    if F then
        local t=F:FindFirstChild("Spawns");
        if t then
            X=t:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart');
        end
    ;
    X=X or F:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation",true);
end
;
return X and X.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,4,0)or nil;
end
;
function G.inLobby()
    local F,X=G.hrp(),G.lobbyCF();
    return F~=nil and X~=nil and(F.Position-X.Position).Magnitude<300;
end
;
function G.toLobby()
    if G.inLobby()then
        return true;
    end
;
local F,X=G.hrp(),G.lobbyCF();
if not(F and X)then
    return false;
end
;
pcall(
    function()F.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;
        F.AssemblyAngularVelocity=Vector3.zero;
        F.CFrame=X;
    end
);
G.lastTp=os.clock();
G.say('TP lobby');
return true;
end
;
function G.who(F,X)
    for t,R in pairs(F)do
        if type(R)=='table'and R.Role and R.Dead~=true and R.Killed~=true and tostring(R.Role):lower():find(X)then
            local F=G.Players:FindFirstChild(t);
            local X=F and F~=A and F.Character;
            local t=X and X:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            if t and t.Health>0 then
                return F,X;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
return nil,nil;
end
;
function G.gun()
    local F=A.Character;
    local X=F and F:FindFirstChild('Gun');
    if X then
        return X,true;
    end
;
local F=A:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack");
X=F and F:FindFirstChild('Gun');
return X,false;
end
;
function G.shoot(F)
    local X,X=G.who(F,"murder");
    if not X then
        return false;
    end
;
local F,t=G.gun();
if not F then
    return false;
end
;
if not t then
    local t=G.hum();
    if t then
        pcall(
            function()t:EquipTool(F);
            end
    );
end
;
return true;
end
;
G.target=X.Name;
local F=rawget(getgenv(),'__pulseAimX');
if type(F)=='table'and F.alive and type(F.fireFor)=='function'then
        local t,R=pcall(F.fireFor,X,false,false);
        if t and R then
            G.say("SHOT "..X.Name);
        end
    ;
    return true;
end
;
local F=rawget(getgenv(),'__pulseShotMurder');
if type(F)=="function"then
        pcall(F);
    end
;
return true;
end
;
function G.knife()
    local F=A.Character;
    local X=F and F:FindFirstChild('Knife');
    if X then
        return X;
    end
;
local t=A:FindFirstChildOfClass('Backpack');
X=t and t:FindFirstChild("Knife");
local t=G.hum();
if X and X:IsA('Tool')and t then
    pcall(
        function()t:EquipTool(X);
        end
);
end
;
return F and F:FindFirstChild("Knife");
end
;
function G.stabAll(F)
    local X=G.knife();
    if not(X and firetouchinterest)then
        return 0;
    end
;
local t=X:FindFirstChild('Handle')or X:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
if not t then
    return 0;
end
;
local R=0;
for B,B in ipairs(G.Players:GetPlayers())do
    local U=B~=A and F[B.Name];
    if type(U)=='table'and U.Dead~=true and U.Killed~=true then
        local F=B.Character;
        local B=F and F:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid');
        if B and B.Health>0 then
            R+=1;
            for B,B in ipairs(G.KPARTS)do
                local U=F:FindFirstChild(B);
                if U then
                    pcall(
                        function()firetouchinterest(t,U,0);
                            firetouchinterest(t,U,1);
                            firetouchinterest(U,t,0);
                            firetouchinterest(U,t,1);
                        end
                );
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
if R>0 then
    pcall(
        function()X:Activate();
        end
);
end
;
return R;
end
;
function G.hook()
    if G.hooked then
        return;
    end
;
G.hooked=true;
T(workspace.DescendantAdded,
    function(F)
        if F.Name=="GunDrop"and F:IsA('BasePart')then
            table.insert(G.drops,F);
        end
    ;
end
);
for F,F in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants())do
    if F.Name=="GunDrop"and F:IsA("BasePart")then
        table.insert(G.drops,F);
    end
;
end
;
end
;
function G.drop()
    for F=#G.drops,1,-1.0 do
        local T=G.drops[F];
        if T.Parent and T:IsDescendantOf(workspace)then
            return T;
        end
    ;
    table.remove(G.drops,F);
end
;
return nil;
end
;
function G.touch(F)
    local T=A.Character;
    if not(T and F and firetouchinterest)then
        return;
    end
;
for X,X in ipairs(T:GetChildren())do
    if X:IsA('BasePart')then
        pcall(
            function()firetouchinterest(X,F,0);
                firetouchinterest(X,F,1);
            end
    );
end
;
end
;
end
;
function G.grab()
    local F=G.drop();
    if not F then
        return false;
    end
;
local T=os.clock();
while os.clock()-T<0.6 and F.Parent and not G.gun()and G.alive()do
    G.touch(F);
    G.Run.Heartbeat:Wait();
end
;
if G.gun()then
    G.say('GUN remote');
    return true;
end
;
if not F.Parent then
    return false;
end
;
local X=G.hrp();
if not X then
    return false;
end
;
T=os.clock();
while os.clock()-T<1.2 and F.Parent and not G.gun()and G.alive()do
    pcall(
        function()X.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero;
            X.CFrame=CFrame.new(F.Position+Vector3.new(0,2.5,0));
        end
);
G.touch(F);
G.Run.Heartbeat:Wait();
end
;
local F=G.gun()~=nil;
G.say(F and'GUN near'or"GUN miss");
G.toLobby();
return F;
end
;
function G.fling(F)
    local T=rawget(getgenv(),'__pulseFlingDown');
    if type(T)~="function"then
            return false;
        end
    ;
    local X,t,R=pcall(T,F,0.8,{home=G.lobbyCF()});
    G.say('FLING '..tostring(F.Name)..' '..tostring(X and R or t));
    return X and t==true;
end
;
function G.hold(F)F=F and true or false;
    if F then
        G.acted=true;
    end
;
if G.holding~=F then
    G.holding=F;
    getgenv().__pulseRoleFarmHold=F or nil;
end
;
end
;
function G.count(F)
    for T,X in pairs(F)do
        if T~=A.Name and type(X)=="table"then
            local A=X.Dead==true or X.Killed==true;
            if not A then
                G.seen[T]=true;
            elseif G.seen[T]then
                    G.seen[T]=nil;
                    if G.state=='Killing'or G.state=='Shooting'and G.target==T then
                        G.kills+=1;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
function G.expInnocent(A)
    if G.gun()then
        G.toLobby();
        G.state='Shooting';
        G.shoot(A);
        return;
    end
;
local F,T=G.who(A,'sheriff');
if not T then
    F,T=G.who(A,'hero');
end
;
local A=os.clock();
if T and A>=G.flingWait and(G.flung[T]or 0)<4 then
    G.flung[T]=(G.flung[T]or 0)+1;
    G.state="Flinging";
    local A=G.fling(T);
    G.flingWait=os.clock()+(A and 2.5 or 0.5);
    G.toLobby();
    return;
end
;
if G.drop()then
    G.state="Picking Gun";
    G.grab();
    return;
end
;
G.toLobby();
G.state="Surviving";
end
;
function G.step()
    local A=G.on;
    if not(A.inno or A.sheriff or A.murder or A.exp)then
        G.state,G.role="Off",nil;
        G.hold(false);
        return;
    end
;
G.hook();
local F,T=G.mine();
G.role=F;
if not F or not G.alive()then
    G.state='Waiting';
    G.hold(false);
    if not F then
        table.clear(G.seen);
    end
;
return;
end
;
G.count(T);
local X=F:lower();
if X:find("murder")then
    if A.murder or A.exp then
        G.hold(true);
        G.state="Killing";
        G.stabAll(T);
        return;
    end
;
elseif X=='sheriff'then
        if A.sheriff or A.exp then
            G.hold(true);
            G.toLobby();
            G.state='Shooting';
            G.shoot(T);
            return;
        end
    ;
elseif X=="hero"then
        if A.exp then
            G.hold(true);
            G.toLobby();
            G.state='Shooting';
            G.shoot(T);
            return;
        elseif A.inno then
                G.hold(true);
                G.toLobby();
                G.state='Surviving';
                return;
            end
        ;
    else
        if A.exp then
            G.hold(true);
            G.expInnocent(T);
            return;
        elseif A.inno then
                G.hold(true);
                G.toLobby();
                G.state="Surviving";
                return;
            end
        ;
    end
;
G.hold(false);
G.state='Waiting';
end
;

    function()
        while J[1][J[3]]()do
            task.wait(0.1);
            local A,F=pcall(G.step);
            if not A then
                G.say('ERR '..tostring(F));
                task.wait(1);
            end
        ;
    end
;
G.hold(false);
end

function fM()
    if TM then
        return;
    end
;
TM=true;
task.spawn(
    function()
        local JM=os.clock();
        while#FM>0 do
            local XM=os.clock();
            local tM=XM-JM;
            JM=XM;
            for JM=#FM,1,-1.0 do
                local XM=FM[JM];
                if not XM.Parent or not XM:GetAttribute('spin')then
                    table.remove(FM,JM);
                else
                    XM.Rotation=(XM.Rotation+tM*300)%360;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    task.wait();
end
;
TM=false;
end
);
end

,oE=
function(G,a,A,F)
    for T=59,0X55,26 do
        if T==0X3b then
            if A~=55 then
                a=G:XE(F,a);
            else
                a=F[0x3__8]();
            end
        ;
        continue;
    else
        G:NE();
    end
;
end
;
return a;
end
,QE=
function(G,a,A,F,T)
    if A==0B101_00011 then
        T=G:RE(T,F);
        return a,23399,T;
    else
        if A==77 then
            a=G:xE(a);
        end
    ;
end
;
return a,nil,T;
end

end

T=(0x2b);

,vE=
function(G,a,A,F)
    local T;
    if a<0x6e then
        T=G:JE(F);
        if T==-1 then
            return-0B1;
        end
    ;
else
    if not(a>0x0060__)then
    else
        G:_E(A);
        return 0Xbc67;
    end
;
end
;
return nil;
end
,_C=
function(G,G,a)a=(G[0xf55]);
    return a;
end
,mr=
function(G,a)(a)[55]=(
        function()
            return(G:Xr(a));
        end
);
(a)[0X38]=nil;
(a)[57]=nil;
end
,KE=
function(G,G)
    return G[0B100011];
end
,sr=
function(G,a,A,F,T,f,J,X,t,R)
    if T>385 then
        (a)[0B110]=X;
    elseif T>0xB3 and T<385 then
            (a)[0X8_]=(R);
            (a)[0XB]=(J);
            return 0x7279,R;
        elseif T<282 and T>0X4c then
                G:Vr(t,a);
                return 0x7279,R;
            elseif T>282 and T<0X1__e8 then
                    G:dr(A,a);
                else
                    if not(T<0Xb3)then
                    else
                        R=F[44](f);
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
        return nil,R;
    end
,wC=
function(G,G,a)a=G[25489];
    return a;
end
,SE=
function(G,G)G[49][0b100]=G[28];
end
,rC=bit32.band,nr=
function(G,a,A,F,T)
    local f;
    for J=0B111100,0Xb8,0B111110 do
        if J==122 then
            T[0B100110][f+0X2]=(a);
            continue;
        else
            if J==0XB8 then
                G:Cr(A,f,T);
            else
                if J~=0B111100 then
                else
                    f=(#T[0B00100110]);
                    T[38][f+1]=(F);
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end

local G={n=0,leaks=0,strict=false};

getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin=false;
local t=game:GetService('Workspace');
local R=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});
local B=setmetatable({},{__mode='k'});
local U=false;
local
function M(c)
    if not c:IsA("BasePart")then
        return;
    end
;
if R[c]==nil then
    R[c]=c.CanTouch;
end
;
if c.CanTouch then
    c.CanTouch=false;
    G.n+=1;
end
;
end
;
local
function c()
    for K,K in ipairs(t:GetChildren())do
        local w=K:FindFirstChild('CoinContainer');
        if w then
            for K,K in ipairs(w:GetChildren())do
                pcall(M,K);
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
local
function K()
    local w=T.Character;
    if not w then
        return;
    end
;
for L,L in ipairs(w:GetChildren())do
    if L:IsA('BasePart')then
        if B[L]==nil then
            B[L]=L.CanTouch;
        end
    ;
    if L.CanTouch then
        pcall(
            function()L.CanTouch=false;
            end
    );
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local
function w()
    for L,W in pairs(R)do
        if L.Parent then
            pcall(
                function()L.CanTouch=W;
                end
        );
end
;
R[L]=nil;
end
;
for R,L in pairs(B)do
    if R.Parent then
        pcall(
            function()R.CanTouch=L;
            end
    );
end
;
B[R]=nil;
end
;
G.strict=false;
end
;
a(
    function()U=false;
        getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin=false;
        w();
    end
);
A(t.DescendantAdded,
    function(a)
        if not U then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local t=a.Parent;
    if t and t.Name=='CoinContainer'then
        pcall(M,a);
    end
;
end
);
A(T.CharacterAdded,
    function()
        if not(U and G.strict)then
            return;
        end
    ;
    task.wait(0.5);
    pcall(K);
end
);
task.spawn(
    function()
        local a;
        while X[1][X[3]]()and not a do
            local T=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Remotes");
            a=T and T:FindFirstChild('Gameplay');
            if not a then
                task.wait(1);
            end
        ;
    end
;
local T=a and a:FindFirstChild("CoinCollected");
if not T then
    return;
end
;
A(T.OnClientEvent,
    function()
        if not U then
            return;
        end
    ;
    G.leaks+=1;
    if not G.strict then
        G.strict=true;
        pcall(K);
        pcall(
            function()J.W:Notify({Title=f.tr("Anti Coin"),Text=f.tr('Coin leaked, strict mode on'),Kind="error",Duration=3});
            end
    );
end
;
end
);
end
);
task.spawn(
    function()
        while X[1][X[3]]()do
            task.wait(0.5);
            if U then
                pcall(c);
                if G.strict then
                    pcall(K);
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
);
local
function a(A)U=A and true or false;
    getgenv().__pulseAntiCoin=U;
    if U then
        pcall(c);
    else
        w();
    end
;
end
;
G.set=a;
F:Toggle({Text='Anti Coin',Default=false,Callback=a});
end
;
end

V.drawLineXY=
function(a,x,S,k,y,Q,E,I,C)
    local H,n=k-x,y-S;
    local O=a.frame;
    local N=math.sqrt(H*H+n*n);
    local z=N<60 and 1 or 4;
    l(O,"Position",math.floor((x+k)*0.5+0.5),math.floor((S+y)*0.5+0.5));
    l(O,'Size',math.max(math.floor(N+0.5),1),math.max(1,math.floor(E+0.5)));
    h(O,'Rotation',math.floor(math.deg(math.atan2(n,H))*z+0.5)/z);
    h(O,"BackgroundColor3",Q);
    h(O,"BackgroundTransparency",s(1-I));
    local x=a.stroke;
    if C then
        h(x,'Enabled',true);
        h(x,'Color',V.outlineCol or q);
        h(x,'Transparency',s(1-math.min(I*1.15*math.clamp((V.outlineAlpha or 65)/65,0,1.5),1)));
    else
        h(x,"Enabled",false);
        h(x,"Transparency",1);
    end
;
h(O,"Visible",true);
end
;

V.poolKey=
function(a)
    local x=a.Size;
    local S=a.Name.."|"..a.ClassName.."|"..string.format('%.3f,%.3f,%.3f',x.X,x.Y,x.Z);
    if a.ClassName=='MeshPart'then
        S=S.."|"..tostring(a.MeshId);
    else
        local x=a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh");
        if x then
            local a=x.Scale;
            S=S.."|"..tostring(x.MeshId)..'|'..x.MeshType.Name..'|'..string.format('%.3f,%.3f,%.3f',a.X,a.Y,a.Z);
        end
    ;
end
;
return S;
end
;
V.poolPurge=
function(a)
    if not r.pool then
        return;
    end
;
for x,x in pairs(r.pool)do
    for S,k in pairs(x)do
        if a==nil or S==a then
            for a,a in pairs(k.items)do
                for k,k in ipairs(a)do
                    pcall(
                        function()k:Destroy();
                        end
                );
        end
    ;
end
;
x[S]=nil;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
V.poolSweep=
function()
    if not r.pool then
        return;
    end
;
local a=os.clock();
for x,x in pairs(r.pool)do
    for S,k in pairs(x)do
        local y=type(S)~="table"and S.Parent==nil;
        if y or a-k.at>45 then
            for a,a in pairs(k.items)do
                for k,k in ipairs(a)do
                    pcall(
                        function()k:Destroy();
                        end
                );
        end
    ;
end
;
x[S]=nil;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
V.modelDropIn=
function(a,x)
    local S=a[x];
    if S then
        for k,k in ipairs(S.conns or{})do
            pcall(
                function()k:Disconnect();
                end
        );
end
;
local k=S.kind~="Wireframe"and S.keys and V.poolFor(a,x)or nil;
for y,Q in ipairs(S.clones)do
    local E=k and S.keys[y];
    if E and Q.Parent~=nil then
        pcall(
            function()Q.Transparency=1;
            end
    );
local S=k.items[E];
if not S then
    S={};
    k.items[E]=S;
end
;
S[#S+1]=Q;
else
    pcall(
        function()Q:Destroy();
        end
);
end
;
end
;
if k then
    k.at=os.clock();
end
;
end
;
a[x]=nil;
end
;
V.modelDrop=
function(a)V.modelDropIn(r.models,a);
    V.modelDropIn(r.halos,a);
end
;
V.cloneable=
function(a)
    local x=r.partKinds;
    local S=a.ClassName;
    local k=x[S];
    if k==nil then
        k=a:IsA('BasePart');
        x[S]=k;
    end
;
if not k or a.Name=='HumanoidRootPart'then
    return false;
end
;
if a.Transparency>=0.95 or a.LocalTransparencyModifier>=0.95 then
    return false;
end
;
if a:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('WrapLayer')then
    return false;
end
;
local x=a:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accessory");
if x and x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WrapLayer",true)then
    return false;
end
;
return true;
end
;
V.modelBroken=
function(a)
    return a.char.Parent==nil;
end
;
V.modelBuild=
function(a,x,S,k,y)
    local Q=tostring(x):match("^[^@]+");
    local E={material=x,kind=Q,spec=S,char=a,root=a:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')or a:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or a:FindFirstChild("Torso"),sources={},clones={},sizes={},meshes={},scales={},cfs={},boxes={},keys={},shown=nil,scale=1,conns={}};
    if Q=="Wireframe"then
        y=nil;
    end
;
for x,x in ipairs(a:GetDescendants())do
    if V.cloneable(x)then
        local I=y and V.poolKey(x)or nil;
        local C=I and y.items[I];
        local y=C and table.remove(C);
        while y and y.Parent~=k do
            pcall(
                function()y:Destroy();
                end
        );
    y=table.remove(C);
end
;
local C,H;
if y then
    C=y:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpecialMesh');
    if C then
        local n=x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpecialMesh');
        H=n and n.Scale or C.Scale;
    end
;
else
    local n=x.Archivable;
    x.Archivable=true;
    local O,N=pcall(
        function()
            return x:Clone();
        end
);
x.Archivable=n;
if O and N then
    y=N;
    if y:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('SpecialMesh')then
        for n,n in ipairs(y:GetChildren())do
            if n:IsA('SpecialMesh')then
                C=n;
                n.TextureId='';
            else
                n:Destroy();
            end
        ;
    end
;
else
    y:ClearAllChildren();
end
;
if C then
    H=C.Scale;
end
;
if y:IsA('MeshPart')then
    pcall(
        function()y.TextureID="";
        end
);
end
;
y.Name='M';
end
;
end
;
if y then
    local n=#E.clones+1;
    if C and C.MeshType==Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then
        E.meshes[n],E.scales[n]=C,H*S[2];
        C.Scale=E.scales[n];
    else
        E.sizes[n]=x.Size*S[2];
        y.Size=E.sizes[n];
    end
;
y.Anchored,y.CanCollide,y.CanQuery,y.CanTouch,y.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false;
y.Material,y.Reflectance,y.Transparency=S[1],S[4],1;
if Q=='Wireframe'and x.Parent==a and x.Name~='HumanoidRootPart'then
    E.boxes[n]=V.make("SelectionBox",{Adornee=y,LineThickness=0.02,SurfaceTransparency=1,Transparency=1},y);
end
;
if y.Parent~=k then
    y.Parent=k;
end
;
E.sources[n],E.clones[n],E.keys[n]=x,y,I;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local
function x(S)
    if S:IsA('BasePart')or S:IsA('Accessory')or S:IsA("WrapLayer")or S:IsA('SpecialMesh')then
        if not E.dirty then
            E.dirty=os.clock();
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
E.conns[1]=a.DescendantAdded:Connect(x);
E.conns[2]=a.DescendantRemoving:Connect(x);
return E;
end
;
V.modelResize=
function(a,x)a.scale=x;
    for S,k in ipairs(a.clones)do
        local y=a.meshes[S];
        if y then
            y.Scale=a.scales[S]*x;
        else
            k.Size=a.sizes[S]*x;
        end
    ;
end
;
for S,S in pairs(a.boxes)do
    S.LineThickness=0.02*x;
end
;
end
;
V.modelPaint=
function(a,x,S,k)
    local y,Q=a.clones,a.sources;
    local E=a.kind or a.material;
    local I=V.chamsSpeed or 1;
    local C=a.root;
    local a=C and C.Parent and C.Position.Y or 0;
    local C,H;
    if E=="Gradient"then
        C,H=V.chamTone(V.tone(V.chamsGradA)),V.chamTone(V.tone(V.chamsGradB));
    end
;
for n=1,#y do
    local O=y[n];
    local y=x;
    if E=="Iridescent"then
        y=Color3.fromHSV((k*0.12*I+n*0.012)%1,0.38,1);
    elseif E=='Gradient'then
            local x=Q[n];
            local Q=0.5;
            if x and x.Parent then
                Q=math.clamp((x.Position.Y-(a-3))/5.6,0,1);
            end
        ;
        if V.chamsGradScroll then
            Q=math.abs((Q+k*0.2*I)%1*2-1);
        end
    ;
    y=H:Lerp(C,Q);
end
;
O.Color=y;
O.Transparency=S;
end
;
end
;
V.modelShow=
function(a,x,S,k)
    if not x then
        if a.shown~=false then
            for x,x in ipairs(a.clones)do
                x.Transparency=1;
            end
        ;
        for x,x in pairs(a.boxes)do
            x.Transparency=1;
        end
    ;
    a.shown=false;
end
;
return;
end
;
local x=os.clock();
local y=a.shown==true;
if y and x-(a.propsAt or 0)<0.03333333333333333 then
    return;
end
;
local Q=1-math.clamp(a.spec[3]*k,0,1);
local k=a.kind or a.material;
a.propsAt=x;
if k=='Wireframe'then
    a.shown=true;
    if not y or a.lastTint~=S or math.abs((a.lastTr or-1.0)-Q)>=0.01 then
        a.lastTint,a.lastTr=S,Q;
        for E,E in pairs(a.boxes)do
            E.Color3=S;
            E.Transparency=Q;
        end
    ;
end
;
return;
end
;
if k=='Iridescent'or k=="Gradient"then
    a.shown=true;
    a.lastTint,a.lastTr=nil,nil;
    V.modelPaint(a,S,Q,x);
    return;
end
;
local x=not y or a.lastTint~=S;
local k=not y or math.abs((a.lastTr or-1.0)-Q)>=0.01;
if not(x or k)then
    return;
end
;
a.shown=true;
local y=a.clones;
if x then
    a.lastTint=S;
    for x=1,#y do
        y[x].Color=S;
    end
;
end
;
if k then
    a.lastTr=Q;
    for a=1,#y do
        y[a].Transparency=Q;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
V.modelPlaceStore=
function(a,x,S,k)
    for y,y in pairs(a)do
        local a=y.root;
        local Q=not(a and a.Parent);
        if y.shown and S and a and a.Parent then
            if y.view~=nil then
                Q=y.view==false;
            else
                local E=a.Position;
                if(E-x).Magnitude>12 then
                    local I=S:WorldToViewportPoint(E);
                    local S,E=k.X*0.35,k.Y*0.35;
                    Q=I.Z<-6.0 or I.X<-S or I.X>k.X+S or I.Y<-E or I.Y>k.Y+E;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
;
if y.shown and Q then
    if not y.parked then
        y.parked=true;
        local S,k=CFrame.new(0,30000,0),{};
        for E=1,#y.clones do
            k[E]=S;
        end
    ;
    pcall(
        function()L:BulkMoveTo(y.clones,k,Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged);
        end
);
end
;
end
;
if y.shown and not Q then
    y.parked=nil;
    if V.chamsThrough and a and a.Parent then
        local S=math.max((a.Position-x).Magnitude,0.01);
        local a=math.min(1,r.modelDepth/S);
        local k=y.scale;
        if a>=1 then
            if k<1 then
                V.modelResize(y,1);
            end
        ;
    elseif k>=1 then
            V.modelResize(y,a);
        else
            local Q=S*k;
            if Q<r.modelDepth*0.76 or Q>r.modelDepth*1.3 then
                V.modelResize(y,a);
            end
        ;
    end
;
elseif y.scale~=1 then
        V.modelResize(y,1);
    end
;
local a=y.scale;
local S,k=y.cfs,y.sources;
if a<1 then
    local Q=x*(1-a);
    for x=1,#k do
        local E=k[x].CFrame;
        S[x]=E.Rotation+(E.Position*a+Q);
    end
;
else
    for a=1,#k do
        S[a]=k[a].CFrame;
    end
;
end
;
pcall(L.BulkMoveTo,L,y.clones,S,Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged);
end
;
end
;
end
;
V.modelPlace=
function()
    local a=L.CurrentCamera;
    if not a then
        return;
    end
;
local x=a.CFrame.Position;
local S=a.ViewportSize;
V.modelPlaceStore(r.models,x,a,S);
V.modelPlaceStore(r.halos,x,a,S);
end

V.placeBind=
function()
    if r.placeBound then
        return;
    end
;
r.placeBound="PulseESP2ModelPlace";
pcall(
    function()G:UnbindFromRenderStep(r.placeBound);
    end
);
G:BindToRenderStep(r.placeBound,Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,
    function()pcall(V.modelPlace);
    end
);
end
;
V.placeUnbind=
function()
    if not r.placeBound then
        return;
    end
;
pcall(
    function()G:UnbindFromRenderStep(r.placeBound);
    end
);
r.placeBound=nil;
end
;
V.modelStep=
function(a,x,S,k,y,Q,E,I,C)
    local H=os.clock();
    local n=a[x];
    local O=n==nil or n.char~=S or n.material~=E or V.modelBroken(n)or n.dirty~=nil and H-n.dirty>0.35;
    if O then
        if not k then
            if n then
                V.modelDropIn(a,x);
            end
        ;
        return;
    end
;
if(r.budget or 0)<=0 then
    if n and n.char==S then
        n.view=C;
        V.modelShow(n,k,y,Q);
    end
;
return;
end
;
r.budget-=1;
V.modelDropIn(a,x);
local H=V.modelRoot();
if not(H and E and I)then
    return;
end
;
n=V.modelBuild(S,E,I,H,V.poolFor(a,x));
a[x]=n;
V.placeBind();
end
;
n.view=C;
V.modelShow(n,k,y,Q);
end

V.SPARKS={Sparkles={tex='rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds',size=0.35,life=NumberRange.new(0.8,1.4),speed=NumberRange.new(0.6,1.6),acc=Vector3.new(0,1.8,0),spread=180},Embers={tex="rbxasset://textures/particles/fire_main.dds",size=0.55,life=NumberRange.new(0.6,1.1),speed=NumberRange.new(1.2,2.6),acc=Vector3.new(0,3.5,0),spread=25},Stardust={tex="rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds",size=0.18,life=NumberRange.new(1.4,2.4),speed=NumberRange.new(0.2,0.6),acc=Vector3.new(0,0.4,0),spread=180}};
V.fxStep=
function(a,x,S,k,y,Q)
    local E=V.murderBeam and k=="Murderer";
    if not(V.sparkles or V.skyBeam or E or V.trail)or not V.fxWanted(k)then
        V.fxDrop(a);
        return;
    end
;
local k=r.fx[a];
if k and k.char~=x then
    V.fxDrop(a);
    k=nil;
end
;
local I=os.clock();
if k and k.still and k.colour==y and I-k.at<0.2 then
    return;
end
;
if not k then
    k={char=x,objs={}};
    r.fx[a]=k;
end
;
local x=k.objs;
local C=a.UserId%97*0.13;
local
function a(...)
    for H,H in ipairs({...})do
        if x[H]then
            pcall(
                function()x[H]:Destroy();
                end
        );
    x[H]=nil;
end
;
end
;
end
;
if V.sparkles then
    local H=V.SPARKS[V.sparkleStyle]or V.SPARKS.Sparkles;
    if not(x.att and x.att.Parent==S and x.pe and x.pe.Parent==x.att)or x.peStyle~=V.sparkleStyle then
        a('att','pe');
        x.att=V.make('Attachment',{Name="PulseESPSparkAtt"},S);
        x.pe=V.make("ParticleEmitter",{Name="PulseESPSparks",Texture=H.tex,LightEmission=1,LightInfluence=0,Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,H.size),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)}),Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)}),Lifetime=H.life,Speed=H.speed,SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(H.spread,H.spread),Acceleration=H.acc,Shape=Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,ShapeStyle=Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.Volume},x.att);
        x.peStyle=V.sparkleStyle;
        x.peColour=nil;
    end
;
if x.peColour~=y then
    x.pe.Color=ColorSequence.new(y:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.4),y);
    x.peColour=y;
end
;
if x.pe.Rate~=V.sparkleRate then
    x.pe.Rate=V.sparkleRate;
end
;
else
    a("att","pe");
end
;
if V.skyBeam then
    if not(x.sky and x.sky.Parent and x.sa0 and x.sa0.Parent==S and x.sa1 and x.sa1.Parent==S)then
        a('sky',"sa0",'sa1');
        x.sa0=V.make("Attachment",{Name="PulseESPSky0"},S);
        x.sa1=V.make("Attachment",{Name='PulseESPSky1',Position=Vector3.new(0,70,0)},S);
        x.sky=V.make('Beam',{Name='PulseESPSkyBeam',Attachment0=x.sa0,Attachment1=x.sa1,FaceCamera=true,LightEmission=1,LightInfluence=0,Segments=1,Width0=1.1,Width1=0.25},S);
    end
;
x.sky.Color=ColorSequence.new(y);
local H=1-0.55*Q*(0.8+0.2*math.sin(I*2+C));
x.sky.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,H),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)});
else
    a("sky","sa0","sa1");
end
;
if E then
    local C=U.Character and U.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
    if C then
        if not(x.mb and x.mb.Parent and x.ma0 and x.ma0.Parent==C and x.ma1 and x.ma1.Parent==S)then
            a("mb",'ma0',"ma1");
            x.ma0=V.make('Attachment',{Name="PulseESPBeamFrom"},C);
            x.ma1=V.make("Attachment",{Name='PulseESPBeamTo'},S);
            x.mb=V.make('Beam',{Name='PulseESPMurderBeam',Attachment0=x.ma0,Attachment1=x.ma1,FaceCamera=true,LightEmission=1,LightInfluence=0,Segments=1,Width0=0.08,Width1=0.18},S);
        end
    ;
    x.mb.Color=ColorSequence.new(y:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.3),y);
    local C=1-0.8*Q*(0.75+0.25*math.sin(I*5));
    x.mb.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15,C),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,C*0.7)});
else
    a("mb","ma0","ma1");
end
;
else
    a("mb",'ma0','ma1');
end
;
if V.trail then
    local Q=math.clamp(V.trailWidth or 1.2,0.1,4)*0.5;
    if not(x.trl and x.trl.Parent==S and x.ta0 and x.ta0.Parent==S and x.ta1 and x.ta1.Parent==S)or x.trlStyle~=V.trailStyle or x.trlW~=Q then
        a("trl","ta0",'ta1');
        x.ta0=V.make("Attachment",{Name='PulseESPTrail0',Position=Vector3.new(0,Q,0)},S);
        x.ta1=V.make("Attachment",{Name="PulseESPTrail1",Position=Vector3.new(0,-Q,0)},S);
        local C=V.trailStyle=="Neon";
        local H=V.trailStyle=='Ribbon';
        x.trl=V.make('Trail',{Name='PulseESPTrail',Attachment0=x.ta0,Attachment1=x.ta1,FaceCamera=true,LightEmission=C and 1 or 0.35,LightInfluence=0,MinLength=0.05,WidthScale=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,H and 0.85 or 0.15)}),Transparency=H and NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.35),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8,0.5),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})or NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,C and 0.05 or 0.25),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})},S);
        x.trlStyle,x.trlW,x.trlColour=V.trailStyle,Q,nil;
    end
;
if x.trl.Lifetime~=V.trailLife then
    x.trl.Lifetime=V.trailLife;
end
;
if x.trlColour~=y then
    x.trl.Color=V.trailStyle=='Neon'and ColorSequence.new(y:Lerp(_,0.45),y)or ColorSequence.new(y);
    x.trlColour=y;
end
;
else
    a('trl',"ta0","ta1");
end
;
k.at,k.colour,k.still=I,y,not(V.skyBeam or E);
end

function()
    if r.labelGui then
        pcall(
            function()r.labelGui:Destroy();
            end
    );
end
;
r.labelGui=nil;
r.labels={};
end
;
V.release=
function(a)
    local x=r.objects[a];
    if x then
        pcall(
            function()x.layer:Destroy();
            end
    );
end
;
r.objects[a]=nil;
r.retryAt[a]=nil;
V.dropCham(a);
V.poolPurge(a);
V.fxDrop(a);
V.radarDrop(a);
V.labelsDrop(a);
end
;
V.clear=
function()
    for a in pairs(r.objects)do
        V.release(a);
    end
;
V.clearChams();
V.poolPurge();
V.fxClear();
if r.modelFolder then
    pcall(
        function()r.modelFolder:Destroy();
        end
);
r.modelFolder=nil;
end
;
V.placeUnbind();
V.radarClear();
V.labelsClear();
if r.gui then
    pcall(
        function()r.gui:Destroy();
        end
);
r.gui=nil;
end
;
table.clear(r.retryAt);
end
;
V.hideAll=
function()V.clearChams();
    for a in pairs(r.fx)do
        V.fxDrop(a);
    end
;
for a,x in pairs(r.objects)do
    V.hideSet(x,true);
    V.radarHide(a);
    V.labelsHide(a);
end
;
r.hidden=true;
end
;
V.prune=
function()
    local a={};
    for x,x in ipairs(B:GetPlayers())do
        a[x]=true;
    end
;
for x in pairs(r.objects)do
    if not a[x]then
        V.release(x);
    end
;
end
;
for x in pairs(r.highlights)do
    if not a[x]then
        V.dropCham(x);
    end
;
end
;
for x in pairs(r.radar)do
    if not a[x]then
        V.radarDrop(x);
    end
;
end
;
for x in pairs(r.labels)do
    if not a[x]then
        V.labelsDrop(x);
    end
;
end
;
for x in pairs(r.fx)do
    if not a[x]then
        V.fxDrop(x);
    end
;
end
;
end

V.ck=
function(a)
    return math.floor(a.R*255+0.5)*65536+math.floor(a.G*255+0.5)*256+math.floor(a.B*255+0.5);
end
;
V.tone=
function(a)
    local x,S=(V.brightness or 100)/100,(V.saturation or 100)/100;
    if x==1 and S==1 then
        return a;
    end
;
local k=r.toneCache;
if not k or r.toneB~=x or r.toneS~=S then
    k={};
    r.toneCache,r.toneB,r.toneS,r.toneN=k,x,S,0;
end
;
local y=V.ck(a);
local Q=k[y];
if Q then
    return Q;
end
;
local Q,E,I=a:ToHSV();
local a=I*x;
local x=Color3.fromHSV(Q,math.clamp(E*S,0,1),math.clamp(a,0,1));
if a>1 then
    x=x:Lerp(_,math.clamp((a-1)*0.6,0,0.6));
end
;
r.toneN=(r.toneN or 0)+1;
if r.toneN>4096 then
    r.toneCache=nil;
end
;
k[y]=x;
return x;
end
;
V.ink=
function(a,x,S)
    if a=="Custom"then
        return V.tone(x or _);
    end
;
if a=="White"then
    return V.tone(_);
end
;
if a=='Light'then
    return S:Lerp(_,0.45);
end
;
if a=='Dark'then
    return S:Lerp(q,0.5);
end
;
return S;
end
;

end

V.upper=
function(a)
    local x=r.upperCache;
    if not x or(r.upperN or 0)>3000 then
        x={};
        r.upperCache,r.upperN=x,0;
    end
;
local S=x[a];
if S then
    return S;
end
;
local S=V.upperRaw(a);
x[a]=S;
r.upperN=(r.upperN or 0)+1;
return S;
end

V.upperRaw=
function(a)
    local x=string.upper(a);
    if not string.find(x,'[\xFF\xFF]')then
        return x;
    end
;
local a={};
for S,S in utf8.codes(x)do
    if S>=1072 and S<=1103 then
        S-=32;
    elseif S==1105 then
            S=1025;
        end
    ;
    a[#a+1]=utf8.char(S);
end
;
return table.concat(a);
end

end
;
return a;
end

V.distText=
function(a)
    local x=math.max(tonumber(a)or 0,0);
    local a;
    if V.distUnit=='Meters'then
        local S=x*0.28;
        a=S<10 and-(math.floor(S*10+0.5)+1)or math.floor(S+0.5)+1000000;
    else
        a=math.floor(x+0.5);
    end
;
local S=r.distCache;
if not S or(r.distN or 0)>4000 then
    S={};
    r.distCache,r.distN=S,0;
end
;
local k=S[a];
if k then
    return k;
end
;
local k=V.distTextRaw(x);
S[a]=k;
r.distN=(r.distN or 0)+1;
return k;
end

function(a)
    if V.distUnit=='Meters'then

        end
    ;
    return tostring(math.floor(x+0.5))..' m';
end
;
return tostring(math.floor(math.max(a,0)+0.5)).." st";
end

V.COLOR_MODES={'Role','Rainbow',"Custom","Distance","Visibility"};
V.color=
function(a,x,S,S,S)
    local k=V.roleBase(a);
    local a=V.colorMode;
    if a=='Rainbow'then
        k=Color3.fromHSV(os.clock()*0.09*(V.rainbowSpeed or 1)%1,math.clamp((V.rainbowSat or 65)/100,0,1),1);
    elseif a=="Custom"then
            k=V.customColour;
        elseif a=="Distance"then
                k=V.nearColour:Lerp(V.farColour,math.clamp((S or 0)/math.max(V.maxDist,1),0,1));
            elseif a=="Visibility"then
                    k=x and V.seenColour or V.hiddenColour;
                end
            ;
            if V.visCheck and V.dimHidden and not x and V.hiddenStyle=='Grey'then
                k=V.hiddenColour;
            end
        ;
        return V.tone(k);
    end
;
V.alpha=
function(a,x)
    local S=V.visCheck and V.dimHidden and not x and V.hiddenStyle~='Grey'and 0.72 or 1;
    if V.fade then
        local x=V.maxDist*math.clamp(V.fadeFrom,10,95)/100;
        if a>x then
            S=S*math.clamp(1-(a-x)/math.max(V.maxDist-x,1),0.45,1);
        end
    ;
end
;
return S*math.clamp((V.opacity or 100)/100,0.05,1);
end

V.boundsOf=
function(a,x)
    local S=r.bounds[a];
    local k=os.clock();
    if not S or k-S.at>0.15 then
        local y,Q;
        local E=r.partKinds;
        for I,I in ipairs(a:GetChildren())do
            local C=I.ClassName;
            local H=E[C];
            if H==nil then
                H=I:IsA('BasePart');
                E[C]=H;
            end
        ;
        if H then
            local E=I.Size.Y*0.5;
            local C=I.Position.Y;
            local I,H=C+E,C-E;
            if y==nil or I>y then
                y=I;
            end
        ;
        if Q==nil or H<Q then
            Q=H;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local E=x.Position.Y;
S={at=k,top=(y or E+3)-E,bottom=(Q or E-3)-E};
r.bounds[a]=S;
end
;
return S.top,S.bottom;
end

V.project=
function(a,x)
    local S,k=V.boundsOf(a,x);
    local a=x.Position;
    local x=V.vpt(Vector3.new(a.X,a.Y+S+0.12,a.Z));
    local S=V.vpt(Vector3.new(a.X,a.Y+k-0.08,a.Z));
    if x.Z<=0.08 or S.Z<=0.08 then
        return nil;
    end
;
local a=W.ViewportSize;
local k=math.abs(S.Y-x.Y);
if k<2 or k>a.Y*4 then
    return nil;
end
;
local y=k*math.clamp((V.boxWidth or 50)/100,0.2,1);
local Q=(x.X+S.X)*0.5-y*0.5;
local E=math.min(x.Y,S.Y);
if Q+y<0 or Q>a.X or E+k<0 or E>a.Y then
    return nil;
end
;
if y<12 then
    Q,y=Q-(12-y)*0.5,12;
end
;
if k<22 then
    E,k=E-(22-k)*0.5,22;
end
;
return{x=Q,y=E,w=y,h=k};
end

V.smoothRect=
function(a,x,S,k)
    local y=math.clamp(V.smooth,0,95)/100;
    local Q=y>0 and 1-y^(math.clamp(S or 0.016666666666666666,0.001,0.1)*60)or 1;
    k=k or Vector2.new(x.x+x.w*0.5,x.y+x.h*0.5);
    local S={x=x.x-k.X,y=x.y-k.Y,w=x.w,h=x.h};
    local x=a.rect and a.rel;
    if x then
        local y=math.abs(S.x-x.x)+math.abs(S.y-x.y)+math.abs(S.w-x.w)+math.abs(S.h-x.h);
        if y<math.max(W.ViewportSize.X,W.ViewportSize.Y)*0.35 then
            S.x=x.x+(S.x-x.x)*Q;
            S.y=x.y+(S.y-x.y)*Q;
            S.w=x.w+(S.w-x.w)*Q;
            S.h=x.h+(S.h-x.h)*Q;
        end
    ;
end
;
a.rel=S;
local x={x=k.X+S.x,y=k.Y+S.y,w=S.w,h=S.h};
a.rect=x;
return{x=math.floor(x.x+0.5),y=math.floor(x.y+0.5),w=math.max(1,math.floor(x.w+0.5)),h=math.max(1,math.floor(x.h+0.5))};
end

        a.styleColour,a.styleTr=E,n;

l(H,"Position",S,k);
l(H,'Size',y,Q);
h(H,"Visible",true);

        local E=math.max(1,math.floor((V.outlineSize or 2)*0.5+0.5));
        l(x,"Position",S-E,k-E);
        l(x,"Size",y+E*2,Q+E*2);

end

V.drawBox=
function(a,x,S,k,y,Q)
    local E=V.boxStyle or"Corners";

        E=V.murdBox;
    end
;
local I=V.box==true and not a.boxOff;

local H=I and not C;
local n=V.boxGlow==true or Q==true;
local O=H and E~="Double"and V.outline==true and V.outlineInner==true;
if not I or not C then
    V.segHide(a,1);
end

if a.inner and not(H and(E=='Double'or O))then
    h(a.inner,"Visible",false);
end
;
h(a.box,'Visible',I);
h(a.glow,'Visible',H and n);
h(a.outer,'Visible',H and V.outline);
if not I then
    return;
end

local I,N=V.boxAnimK(y);
if N>0 then
    local y=math.floor(N*2+0.5);

    end
;
end

end

    h(a.outer,'Position',N);
    h(a.outer,"Size",z);
    h(a.outerStroke,"Color",V.outlineCol or q);
    h(a.outerStroke,"Thickness",I+(V.outlineSize or 2));
    h(a.outerStroke,'Transparency',s(1-y*math.clamp((V.outlineAlpha or 65)/100,0,1)));
end
;
h(a.box,"BackgroundColor3",_);
h(a.box,"BackgroundTransparency",V.boxFill and s(1-math.clamp(V.boxFillAlpha/100,0,1)*y)or 1);
if V.boxFill then
    local b=V.ink(V.fillColMode,V.fillCol,k);
    local Z=V.gradient and S or b;
    local P=(V.gradient and 1 or 2)*1000000000000000+V.ck(b)*16777216+V.ck(Z);
    if a.fillKey~=P or a.fillGS~=V.boxGradStyle then
        a.fillKey,a.fillGS=P,V.boxGradStyle;
        a.fillGradient.Color=V.gradient and V.boxSeq(b,Z)or ColorSequence.new(b);
    end
;
local b=V.fillStyle or'Solid';
if a.fillStyleOn~=b then
    a.fillStyleOn=b;
    a.fillGradient.Transparency=V.FILL_SEQ[b]or V.FILL_SEQ.Solid;
    a.fillGradient.Rotation=90;
end
;
end
;
if H then
    local b=V.ck(k)*16777216+V.ck(S);
    if a.edgeKey~=b or a.edgeGS~=V.boxGradStyle or a.edgeG~=V.gradient then
        a.edgeKey,a.edgeGS,a.edgeG=b,V.boxGradStyle,V.gradient;
        a.edgeGradient.Color=V.gradient and V.boxSeq(k,S)or ColorSequence.new(k);
        if a.innerGrad then
            a.innerGrad.Color=a.edgeGradient.Color;
        end
    ;
end

                                                                                                                    if L.loading then
                                                                                                                        return;
                                                                                                                    end
                                                                                                                ;

                                                                                        function L.tpMethods(G)
                                                                                            local T=game.PlaceId;
                                                                                            return{
                                                                                                function()K:TeleportToPlaceInstance(T,G,J);
                                                                                                end
                                                                                            ,

                                                                                            end

                                                                            end
                                                                        ;
                                                                        function L.join(G)
                                                                            if L.joining then
                                                                                return;
                                                                            end
                                                                        ;
                                                                        if(tonumber(G.n)or 0)>=(tonumber(G.m)or 0)then
                                                                            x(F.tr('Server is full'),nil,'warning');
                                                                            return;
                                                                        end
                                                                    ;
                                                                    L.joining=true;
                                                                    L.lastJob=G.job;
                                                                    L.tpStarted,L.tpFailed,L.tpWhy=false,nil,nil;
                                                                    local T={};
                                                                    L.joinTok=T;
                                                                    local f=L.info[G.uid];
                                                                    x(F.tr("Teleporting"),f and f.dn or nil,"info");
                                                                    task.spawn(
                                                                        function()
                                                                            local f=L.tpMethods(G.job);
                                                                            for X,U in ipairs(f)do
                                                                                if L.joinTok~=T or not A[1][A[3]]()then
                                                                                    return;
                                                                                end
                                                                            ;
                                                                            L.tpFailed=nil;
                                                                            local f,M=pcall(U);
                                                                            if not f then
                                                                                L.tpFailed="error";
                                                                                L.tpWhy=tostring(M);
                                                                            end
                                                                        ;
                                                                        local f=os.clock()+(X==1 and 7 or 6);
                                                                        while os.clock()<f and L.joinTok==T and not L.tpStarted and not L.tpFailed do
                                                                            task.wait(0.2);
                                                                        end
                                                                    ;
                                                                    if L.joinTok~=T or L.tpStarted or L.tpFailed=='final'then
                                                                        return;
                                                                    end
                                                                ;
                                                            end
                                                        ;
                                                        if L.joinTok~=T then
                                                            return;
                                                        end
                                                    ;
                                                    L.joinTok=nil;
                                                    L.joining=false;
                                                    local f="https://www.roblox.com/games/start?placeId="..tostring(game.PlaceId)..'&gameInstanceId='..tostring(G.job);
                                                    local G=false;
                                                    pcall(
                                                        function()
                                                            local X=setclipboard or toclipboard or set_clipboard;
                                                            if type(X)=='function'then
                                                                    X(f);
                                                                    G=true;
                                                                end
                                                            ;
                                                        end
                                                );
                                            local f=L.tpWhy and F.tr("Roblox replied")..": "..L.tpWhy or F.tr("Roblox did not respond to the teleport");
                                            x(F.tr("Couldn't join this server"),f..(G and'. '..F.tr("Join link copied, open it in your browser")or""),'warning',12);
                                        end
                                );
                            task.delay(45,
                                function()
                                    if L.joinTok==T then
                                        L.joinTok=nil;
                                        L.joining=false;
                                    end
                                ;
                            end
                    );
            end
        ;
        t(J.OnTeleport,
            function(G)
                if not L.joining then
                    return;
                end
            ;
            if G==Enum.TeleportState.Started or G==Enum.TeleportState.InProgress or G==Enum.TeleportState.WaitingForServer then
                L.tpStarted=true;
            elseif G==Enum.TeleportState.Failed then
                    L.tpStarted=false;
                    L.tpFailed=L.tpFailed or'failed';
                    L.tpWhy=L.tpWhy or"TeleportState.Failed";
                end
            ;
        end
);
t(K.TeleportInitFailed,
    function(G,G,T)
        if not L.joining then
            return;
        end
    ;
    if G==Enum.TeleportResult.IsTeleporting then
        return;
    end

local
function V(r)
    local _=F.CurrentCamera;
    local q=r.MoveDirection;
    local r=B;
    local u=Vector3.new(0,0,-1.0);
    if _ then
        local s=_.CFrame;
        local _=s.LookVector;
        local h=Vector3.new(_.X,0,_.Z);
        if h.Magnitude>0.01 then
            u=h.Unit;
        end
    ;
    if q.Magnitude>0 then
        local h=s.RightVector;
        local s=Vector3.new(h.X,0,h.Z);
        if s.Magnitude>0.01 then
            s=s.Unit;
        else
            s=Vector3.new(1,0,0);
        end
    ;
    r=_*q:Dot(u)+s*q:Dot(s);
end
;
end
;
local _=0;
if c or os.clock()-w<0.15 then
    _=_+1;
end
;
if K then
    _=_-1;
end
;
return r,_,u;
end

function c(K)

                function()W.bv:Destroy();

        );

w.Parent=K;

end

end

local
function K(w,r,_)W.states=W.states or{};
    local
    function q(u)
        if W.states[u]~=nil then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local s,h=pcall(
        function()
            return w:GetStateEnabled(u);
        end
);
W.states[u]=not(s and h==false);
end
;
for u,u in ipairs(r)do
    q(u);
    pcall(
        function()w:SetStateEnabled(u,false);
        end
);
end
;
if _ then
    q(_);
    pcall(
        function()w:SetStateEnabled(_,true);
        end
);
end
;
end

local
function w(r,_)
    local q,u=pcall(
        function()
            return r:GetState();
        end
);
if q and u~=_ then
    pcall(
        function()r:ChangeState(_);
        end
);
end
;
end

local
function r()
    local _,q=W.hum,W.states;
    W.states=nil;
    if not(_ and q)then
        return;
    end
;

    pcall(
        function()_:SetStateEnabled(u,s);
        end
);
end
;

        function()_:ChangeState(M.Freefall);
        end
);
end
;
end

local
function q(u,s,h,Y,l,x)
    local S=Vector3.new(s.X,0,s.Z);
    local s=Vector3.new(h.X,0,h.Z);
    local h=S.Magnitude>0.01 and S.Unit or(s.Magnitude>0.5 and s.Unit or Y);
    local s=u.Position;
    local u=CFrame.lookAt(s,s+h);
    if x then
        u=u*x;
    end
;
W.gyroCF=W.gyroCF and W.gyroCF:Lerp(u,math.min(1,8*l))or u;
W.gyro.CFrame=W.gyroCF;
end

function u(s,h)

        return h.Size.Y/2+2;

;

end

function f.sweep()
    local c={};
    for K,K in ipairs(t)do
        for w in pairs(K)do
            c[#c+1]=w;
            c[#c+1]=K;
        end
    ;
end
;
local K={};
local w=os.clock();
for L=1,#c,2 do
    local W,V=c[L],c[L+1];
    if V[W]~=nil then
        local c,L=pcall(U,W,K);
        if c and L then
            B[W]=nil;
        elseif B[W]then
                V[W]=nil;
                B[W]=nil;
            else
                B[W]=true;
            end
        ;
    end
;
if os.clock()-w>0.001 then
    task.wait();
    w=os.clock();
    K={};
end
;
end
;
end
;
function f.regCount()
    local B=0;
    for U,U in ipairs(t)do
        for t in pairs(U)do
            B+=1;
        end
    ;
end
;
return B;
end
;
function f.startSweep()
    if f.sweeping then
        return;
    end
;
f.sweeping=true;
task.spawn(
    function()
        while true do
            task.wait(15);
            local t=false;
            for B,B in ipairs(T.Windows)do
                if not B.Destroyed then
                    t=true;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    f.sweep();
    if not t then
        f.sweeping=false;
        return;
    end
;
end
;
end
);
end

function f.new(B,U,c)
    local K=Instance.new(B);
    local w;
    for L,W in pairs(U or{})do
        if L=="Parent"then
            w=W;
        else
            K[L]=W;
        end
    ;
end
;
for U,U in ipairs(c or{})do
    U.Parent=K;
end
;
if t[B]then
    local t=K.FontFace;
    local U=K.TextSize;
    f.textReg[K]={weight=t.Weight,style=t.Style,size=U};
    if f.textScale~=1 then
        K.TextSize=math.max(8,math.floor(U*f.textScale+0.5));
    end
;
elseif B=='UICorner'then
        local t=K.CornerRadius;
        f.cornerReg[K]=t;
        if f.radiusMult~=1 and t.Scale==0 then
            K.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,math.floor(t.Offset*f.radiusMult+0.5));
        end
    ;
end
;
if w then
    K.Parent=w;
end
;
return K;
end
;

    local U=f.textReg[t];
    if U then
        U.size=B;
    end
;

end

end
;
function f.radiusOne(t)
    local B=f.cornerReg[t];
    if B and B.Scale==0 then
        t.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,math.floor(B.Offset*f.radiusMult+0.5));
    end
;
end

        function()
            for t in pairs(f.cornerReg)do
                if t.Parent then
                    f.radiusOne(t);
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
);
end

function f.list(t,B,U,c,K)
    return f.new('UIListLayout',{Padding=UDim.new(0,B or 0),FillDirection=U or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,HorizontalAlignment=c or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,VerticalAlignment=K or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,Parent=t});
end

function f.shadow(t,B,U,c,K)
    local w,L=pcall(
        function()
            return f.new("UIShadow",{Color=Color3.new(0,0,0),Transparency=B or 0.5,BlurRadius=UDim.new(0,U or 12),Offset=UDim2.fromOffset(0,c or 2),Spread=UDim2.fromOffset(K or 0,K or 0),Parent=t});
        end
);
return w and L or nil;
end
;
function f.clamp(t,B,U)
    if t<B then
        return B;
    end
;
if t>U then
    return U;
end
;
return t;
end
;
function f.round(t,B)
    local U=10^(B or 0);
    return math.floor(t*U+0.5)/U;
end
;
function f.fmt(t,B)B=B or 0;
    if B<=0 then
        return tostring(math.floor(t+0.5));
    end
;
return string.format('%.'..B.."f",t);
end

function f.textWidth(t,B,U)
    local c,K=pcall(
        function()
            local w=Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams");
            w.Text=tostring(t);
            w.Font=B;
            w.Size=U;
            w.Width=10000;
            return R:GetTextBoundsAsync(w);
        end
);
if c and K then
    return K.X;
end
;
return#tostring(t)*U*0.5;
end

function f.darken(t,R)

end

    local R=X.MouseLeave:Connect(t);
    X.InputEnded:Connect(
        function(X)

                task.delay(0.12,t);
            end
        ;
    end
);
return R;
end

    end

    function J()

function f.run(X,t,R)f.gen+=1;
    f.names[X]=(f.names[X]or 0)+1;
    local B=f.names[X];
    local U=J();
    if#U==0 then
        if R then
            R();
        end
    ;
    return;
end
;
f.busy+=1;
task.spawn(
    function()
        local J=os.clock();
        for R,R in ipairs(U)do
            local U=R:GetDescendants();
            for R=1,#U do
                if f.names[X]~=B then
                    f.busy-=1;
                    return;
                end
            ;
            t(U[R]);
            if R%40==0 and os.clock()-J>f.budget then
                task.wait();
                J=os.clock();
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
f.busy-=1;
end
);
end
;
function f.sync(J)
    if not J then
        return;
    end
;
local X=J:GetDescendants();
X[#X+1]=J;
for J,J in ipairs(f.full)do
    for f=1,#X do
        J(X[f]);
    end
;
end
;
end
;
end

local
function X(t)
    local R=#t;
    local B={"RIFF",string.pack("<I4",36+R*2),"WAVE",'fmt ',string.pack("<I4I2I2I4I4I2I2",16,1,1,22050,44100,2,16),'data',string.pack("<I4",R*2)};
    local U=table.create(R);
    for M=1,R do
        local R=math.floor(J(t[M])*32767);
        U[M]=string.pack("<i2",R);
    end
;
return table.concat(B)..table.concat(U);
end
;
local
function J(t)
    local R=t.dur;
    local B=math.floor(22050*R);
    local U=table.create(B);
    local M={};
    for c=1,B do
        local B=(c-1)/22050;
        local K=B/R;
        local R=0;
        for w,L in ipairs(t.tones)do
            local W=L.f0+(L.f1-L.f0)*math.min(1,K/(L.glide or 1));
            M[w]=(M[w]or 0)+6.283185307179586*W/22050;
            local K=math.exp(-B*(L.decay or 30))*math.min(1,B/(L.attack or 0.002));
            if L.start and B<L.start then
                K=0;
            end
        ;
        if L.start and B>=L.start then
            K=math.exp(-(B-L.start)*(L.decay or 30))*math.min(1,(B-L.start)/(L.attack or 0.002));
        end
    ;
    R=R+math.sin(M[w])*K*(L.amp or 0.5);
end
;
if t.noise then
    R=R+(math.random()*2-1)*t.noise*math.exp(-B*90);
end
;
U[c]=R;
end
;
return U;
end

function f.asset(t)
    if f.cache[t]~=nil then
        return f.cache[t];
    end
;
f.cache[t]=false;
local R,B=pcall(
    function()
        if not(writefile and getcustomasset)then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    if isfolder and makefolder then
        if not isfolder('PulseHub')then
            makefolder('PulseHub');
        end
    ;
    if not isfolder(f.folder)then
        makefolder(f.folder);
    end
;
end
;
local U=f.folder..'/'..t..'.wav';
if not(isfile and isfile(U))then
    writefile(U,X(J(f.specs[t])));
end
;
return getcustomasset(U);
end
);
if R and B then
    f.cache[t]=B;
end
;
return f.cache[t];
end
;
function f.play(J,X)
    if not f.enabled or f.volume<=0 then
        return;
    end
;
local t=f.asset(J);
if not t then
    return;
end
;
local J=f.host;
if not J then
    return;
end
;
local R=Instance.new("Sound");
R.SoundId=t;
R.Volume=f.volume*(X or 1);
R.Parent=J;
R:Play();
task.delay(1,
    function()R:Destroy();
    end
);
end
;
function f.preload()task.spawn(
        function()
            for J in pairs(f.specs)do
                pcall(f.asset,J);
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
;
end
;
do
    local f={};
    T.Store=f;
    local J=T.Services.HttpService;
    function f.new(f)
        local X={path=f,data={},dirty=false};
        pcall(
            function()
                if f and isfile and readfile and isfile(f)then
                    local t=J:JSONDecode(readfile(f));
                    if type(t)=='table'then
                        X.data=t;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
    end
);
function X.get(t,R)
    local B=X.data[t];
    if B==nil then
        return R;
    end
;
return B;
end
;
function X.set(t,R)
    if X.data[t]==R then
        return;
    end
;
X.data[t]=R;
X.save();
end
;
function X.save()
    if X.dirty then
        return;
    end
;
X.dirty=true;
task.delay(0.6,
    function()X.dirty=false;
        pcall(
            function()
                if not(f and writefile)then
                    return;
                end
            ;
            if isfolder and makefolder then
                if not isfolder("PulseHub")then
                    makefolder("PulseHub");
                end
            ;
            if not isfolder("PulseHub/nova")then
                makefolder('PulseHub/nova');
            end
        ;
    end
;
writefile(f,J:JSONEncode(X.data));
end
);
end
);
end
;
return X;
end
;
end

do
    local f=T.Refresh;

        function(J)T.Theme.applyOne(J);
        end

table.insert(f.full,T.U.radiusOne);
table.insert(f.full,T.Font.fontOne);

;
do
    local f={cache={},folder="PulseHub/nova/tex",version='v7'};
    T.Tex=f;
    local J;
    local
    function X(t)
        if not J then
            J=table.create(256);
            for R=0,255 do
                local B=R;
                for U=1,8 do
                    if bit32.band(B,1)==1 then
                        B=bit32.bxor(3988292384,bit32.rshift(B,1));
                    else
                        B=bit32.rshift(B,1);
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
        J[R]=B;
    end
;
end
;
local R=buffer.fromstring(t);
local t=4294967295;
for B=0,buffer.len(R)-1 do
    t=bit32.bxor(J[bit32.band(bit32.bxor(t,buffer.readu8(R,B)),255)],bit32.rshift(t,8));
end
;
return bit32.bxor(t,4294967295);
end
;
local
function J(t,R)
    return string.pack('>I4',#R)..t..R..string.pack(">I4",X(t..R));
end
;
function f.encode(X,t,R)
    local B=X*4+1;
    local U=buffer.create(B*t);
    local B=0;
    for M=0,t-1 do
        buffer.writeu8(U,B,0);
        B+=1;
        for c=0,X-1 do
            local K,w,L,W=R(c,M);
            buffer.writeu8(U,B,math.clamp(math.floor(K+0.5),0,255));
            buffer.writeu8(U,B+1,math.clamp(math.floor(w+0.5),0,255));
            buffer.writeu8(U,B+2,math.clamp(math.floor(L+0.5),0,255));
            buffer.writeu8(U,B+3,math.clamp(math.floor(W+0.5),0,255));
            B+=4;
        end
    ;
end
;
local R=buffer.len(U);
local B,M=1,0;
for c=0,R-1 do
    B=(B+buffer.readu8(U,c))%65521;
    M=(M+B)%65521;
end
;
local c={"x\x01"};
local K=0;
while K<R do
    local w=math.min(65535,R-K);
    local L=K+w>=R and 1 or 0;
    table.insert(c,string.char(L)..string.pack('<I2I2',w,bit32.bxor(w,65535)));
    table.insert(c,buffer.readstring(U,K,w));
    K+=w;
end
;
table.insert(c,string.pack(">I4",M*65536+B));
local R=string.pack(">I4I4",X,t)..'\x08\x06\x00\x00\x00';
return"\xFFPNG\x0D\n\x1A\n"..J("IHDR",R)..J("IDAT",table.concat(c))..J("IEND",'');
end
;
local
function J(X,t,R)
    local B=math.clamp((R-X)/(t-X),0,1);
    return B*B*(3-2*B);
end
;
local
function X(t,R,B,U,M,c,K)
    local w=math.abs(t-B)-(M-K);
    local t=math.abs(R-U)-(c-K);
    local R,B=math.max(w,0),math.max(t,0);
    return math.sqrt(R*R+B*B)+math.min(math.max(w,t),0)-K;
end
;
local
function t(R)
    return math.clamp(0.5-R,0,1);
end
;
local
function R(B,U,M)
    local c=math.sin(B*127.1+U*311.7+M*74.7)*43758.5453;
    return c-math.floor(c);
end
;
local
function B(U)
    return
    function(M,c)
        local K=0;
        for w,w in ipairs(U)do
            local U,L=(M-w[1])/w[3],(c-w[2])/w[4];
            K+=w[5]*math.exp(-(U*U+L*L));
        end
    ;
    return K;
end
;
end
;

        ;
    end

    end

end
},grid={w=40,h=40,tile=true,px=
function()

local R={3,5,7,9,12,15,19,24,30,38};
local B={rim9=14,gloss9=14,tile9=15,plate9=14};
f.buckets=R;
f.kinds=B;
f.tracked=T.U.newReg();
local
function U(M,c)
    local K=c+4;
    local w=math.max(64,2*K+24);
    local L=w/2;
    local W=w/64;
    local V;
    if M=='rim9'then
        V=
        function()
            return
            function(r,_)
                local q,u=r+0.5,_+0.5;
                local r=X(q,u,L,L,L-0.6,L-0.6,c);
                local _=math.clamp(1-math.abs(r+0.5)/1.05,0,1);
                local r=0.95-0.86*J(0,w,u);
                local u=0.75+0.25*(1-math.abs(q-L)/L);
                return 255,255,255,255*_*r*u;
            end
        ;
    end
;
elseif M=="gloss9"then
        V=
        function()
            return
            function(r,_)
                local q,u=r+0.5,_+0.5;
                local r=X(q,u,L,L,L,L,c);
                local _=t(r);
                local q=1-J(0,34*W,u);
                local s=(1-J(0,2.4,-r))*(1-J(0,34*W,u));
                local W=0.2*q+0.16*s;
                return 255,255,255,255*W*_;
            end
        ;
    end
;
elseif M=="tile9"then
        V=
        function()
            return
            function(M,W)
                local r,_=M+0.5,W+0.5;
                local M=X(r,_,L,L,L,L,c);
                local W=t(M);
                local r=1-0.24*J(0,w,_);
                r=math.min(1,r+0.16*(1-J(0,3.2,_)));
                r=r*(1-0.1*(1-J(0,3,-M))*J(w*0.47,w,_));
                return 255*r,255*r,255*r,255*W;
            end
        ;
    end
;
else
    V=
    function()
        return
        function(M,W)
            local r,_=M+0.5,W+0.5;
            local M=X(r,_,L,L,L,L,c);
            local X=t(M);
            local t=1-0.1*J(0,w,_);
            return 255*t,255*t,255*t,255*X;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
return{w=w,h=w,slice=Rect.new(K,K,w-K,w-K),px=V};
end
;
function f.resolve(J,X)
    local t=X*T.U.radiusMult;
    local X,M=R[1],math.huge;
    for c,c in ipairs(R)do
        local K=math.abs(math.log(math.max(t,0.5)/c));
        if K<M then
            X,M=c,K;
        end
    ;
end
;
return J..'@'..X,math.max(t/X,0.3);
end
;
function f.cleanup()pcall(
        function()
            if not(listfiles and delfile and isfolder and isfolder(f.folder))then
                return;
            end
        ;
        for J,J in ipairs(listfiles(f.folder))do
            if J:match("_v%d+%.png$")and not J:match('_'..f.version..'%.png$')then
                pcall(delfile,J);
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
);
end
;
function f.get(J)
    local X=f.cache[J];
    if X~=nil then
        return X or nil;
    end
;
f.cache[J]=false;
local X=f.specs[J];
if not X then
    local t,M=string.match(J,"^(%a+%d)@(%d+)$");
    if t and B[t]then
        X=U(t,tonumber(M));
        f.specs[J]=X;
    end
;
end
;
if not X then
    return nil;
end
;
local t,U=pcall(
    function()
        if not(writefile and getcustomasset and buffer)then
            return nil;
        end
    ;
    if isfolder and makefolder then
        if not isfolder("PulseHub")then
            makefolder("PulseHub");
        end
    ;
    if not isfolder("PulseHub/nova")then
        makefolder('PulseHub/nova');
    end
;
if not isfolder(f.folder)then
    makefolder(f.folder);
end
;
end
;
local M=f.folder.."/"..string.gsub(J,'@','_r').."_"..f.version..".png";
if not(isfile and isfile(M))then
    writefile(M,f.encode(X.w,X.h,X.px()));
end
;
return getcustomasset(M);
end
);
if t and U then
    f.cache[J]=U;
end
;
return f.cache[J]or nil;
end
;
function f.image(J,X,t)t=t or{};
    local U=B[X]and X or nil;
    local M,c,K;
    if U then
        M=B[U]*(t.SliceScale or 0.5);
        c,K=f.resolve(U,M);
    else
        c=X;
    end
;
local w=f.get(c);
if not w then
    return nil;
end
;
local L=f.specs[c];
local c=Instance.new("ImageLabel");
c.Name=t.Name or"Tex_"..X;
c.BackgroundTransparency=1;
c.BorderSizePixel=0;
c.Image=w;
if L.slice then
    c.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Slice;
    c.SliceCenter=L.slice;
    c.SliceScale=K or t.SliceScale or 0.5;
elseif L.tile then
        c.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Tile;
        c.TileSize=UDim2.fromOffset(L.w,L.h);
    end
;
for X,K in pairs(t)do
    if X~="Name"and X~="SliceScale"and X~="Parent"then
        c[X]=K;
    end
;
end
;
c.Parent=J;
if U then
    f.tracked[c]={kind=U,base=M};
end
;
return c;
end
;
function f.retarget(J)
    local X=f.tracked[J];
    if not X then
        return;
    end
;
local t,U=f.resolve(X.kind,X.base);
local X=f.get(t);
local M=f.specs[t];
if X and M then
    J.Image=X;
    J.SliceCenter=M.slice;
    J.SliceScale=U;
end
;
end
;
function f.setRadius()T.Refresh.run('texradius',f.retarget,
        function()
            for J in pairs(f.tracked)do
                f.retarget(J);
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
;
table.insert(T.Refresh.full,f.retarget);
function f.preload()
    if f.preloading then
        return;
    end
;
f.preloading=true;
f.cleanup();
task.spawn(
    function()
        for J in pairs(f.specs)do
            pcall(f.get,J);
            task.wait();
        end
    ;
    for J in pairs(B)do
        for X,X in ipairs(R)do
            pcall(f.get,J..'@'..X);
            task.wait();
        end
    ;
end
;
end
);
end
;
end

    end

function V(r)
    local _=M('ImageLabel',{BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(r.Size or 18,r.Size or 18),Position=r.Pos or UDim2.new(),AnchorPoint=r.Anchor or Vector2.zero,Visible=false,ZIndex=r.Z or 1,Name=r.Name or"Icon",Parent=r.Parent});

    R.apply(_,r.Icon);
    return _;
end

T.icon=V;
function T.tile(r,_)
    local q=U.image(r,_.Tex or"tile9",{Name=_.Name or"Tile",Size=_.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),Position=_.Pos or UDim2.new(),AnchorPoint=_.Anchor or Vector2.zero,SliceScale=_.SliceScale or 0.5,ImageTransparency=_.Alpha or 0,ZIndex=_.Z or 1});
    if q then
        K(q,'ImageColor3',_.Color or'Accent');
        return q,true;
    end
;
local q=M('Frame',{Name=_.Name or'Tile',Size=_.Size or UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),Position=_.Pos or UDim2.new(),AnchorPoint=_.Anchor or Vector2.zero,BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundTransparency=_.Alpha or 0,ZIndex=_.Z or 1,Parent=r});
f.corner(q,_.Radius or math.floor(15*(_.SliceScale or 0.5)+0.5));
K(q,'BackgroundColor3',_.Color or'Accent');
return q,false;
end

function T:CreateWindow(r)r=r or{};
    local _=setmetatable({},L);
    _.Tabs,_.TabList,_.Groups={},{},{};
    _.Conns={};
    _.Popups,_.Floats={},{};
    _.Key=r.Key or Enum.KeyCode.RightControl;
    _.Size=r.Size or Vector2.new(860,620);
