function L:_buildBackdrop()
    local R=self.Win;
    local r=M('Frame',{Name='Backdrop',Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=0,Parent=R});
    self.Backdrop=r;
    local R={};
    R.meshA=U.image(r,'meshA',{Name='MeshA',AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.25,0.18),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1.5,1.5),ImageTransparency=0.84,ZIndex=0});
    if R.meshA then
        K(R.meshA,"ImageColor3","Accent");
    end
;
R.meshB=U.image(r,'meshB',{Name='MeshB',AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.85,0.9),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1.4,1.4),ImageTransparency=0.9,ZIndex=0});
if R.meshB then
    K(R.meshB,"ImageColor3",
        function(_)
            return _.Accent:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(80,110,255),0.55);
        end
);
end
;
R.auraA=U.image(r,"glow",{Name='AuraA',AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(640,540),ImageTransparency=0.84,ZIndex=0});
if R.auraA then
    K(R.auraA,"ImageColor3","Accent");
end
;
R.auraB=U.image(r,"glow",{Name="AuraB",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,40,1,60),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(660,480),ImageTransparency=0.9,ZIndex=0});
if R.auraB then
    K(R.auraB,"ImageColor3",'Accent');
end
;
R.pattern=M('ImageLabel',{Name="Pattern",BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ImageTransparency=1,ZIndex=0,Parent=r});
K(R.pattern,'ImageColor3',"Glass");
R.vignette=U.image(r,'vignette',{Name='Vignette',Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ImageTransparency=0.3,ZIndex=0});
R.grain=U.image(r,"grain",{Name='Grain',Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ImageTransparency=0.82,ZIndex=0});
self.BgLayers=R;
task.spawn(
    function()
        local r=0;
        while not self.Destroyed do
            task.wait(0.08);
            if self.IsOpen and J.enabled and self.BgStyle=='Aurora'then
                r+=0.08;
                if R.auraA then
                    R.auraA.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(60+math.sin(r*0.35)*34,10+math.cos(r*0.27)*22);
                end
            ;
            if R.auraB then
                R.auraB.Position=UDim2.new(1,40+math.cos(r*0.22)*38,1,60+math.sin(r*0.31)*24);
            end
        ;
        if R.meshA then
            R.meshA.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.25+math.sin(r*0.11)*0.06,0.18+math.cos(r*0.09)*0.05);
        end
    ;
    if R.meshB then
        R.meshB.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.85+math.cos(r*0.1)*0.06,0.9+math.sin(r*0.12)*0.05);
    end
;
end
;
end
;
end
);
end
;
local R={Grid={tex='grid',alpha=0.955},Dots={tex='dots',alpha=0.9},Diagonal={tex="diag",alpha=0.965},Crosses={tex="crosses",alpha=0.93},Scanlines={tex='scan',alpha=0.955}};
function L:_applyBackground()
    local r=self.BgLayers;
    if not r then
        return;
    end
;
local _,q=self.BgStyle,self.BgIntensity;
local
function u(s)
    return math.clamp(1-(1-s)*q,0,1);
end
;
local q=_=="Aurora";
if r.meshA then
    r.meshA.ImageTransparency=u(q and 0.84 or 0.965);
end
;
if r.meshB then
    r.meshB.ImageTransparency=u(q and 0.9 or 0.975);
end
;
if r.auraA then
    r.auraA.ImageTransparency=u(q and 0.84 or 0.9);
end
;
if r.auraB then
    r.auraB.ImageTransparency=u(q and 0.9 or 0.94);
end
;
local q=R[_];
if q then
    local R=U.get(q.tex);
    if R then
        r.pattern.Image=R;
        r.pattern.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Tile;
        local R=U.specs[q.tex];
        r.pattern.TileSize=UDim2.fromOffset(R.w,R.h);
        r.pattern.ImageTransparency=u(q.alpha);
    end
;
else
    r.pattern.ImageTransparency=1;
end
;
if r.grain then
    r.grain.ImageTransparency=u(_=="Noise"and 0.55 or 0.82);
end
;
end
;
function L:SetBackground(R)T.trace("SetBackground");
    for r,r in ipairs(L.BackgroundStyles)do
        if r==R then
            self.BgStyle=R;
            self.State.set("bgStyle",R);
            self:_applyBackground();
            return;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
function L:SetBackgroundIntensity(R)T.trace("SetBackgroundIntensity");
    self.BgIntensity=math.clamp(tonumber(R)or 1,0,1.5);
    self.State.set("bgIntensity",self.BgIntensity);
    self:_applyBackground();
end
;
function L:SetOpacity(R)T.trace('SetOpacity');
    self.Opacity=math.clamp(tonumber(R)or 1,0.5,1);
    self.State.set("opacity",self.Opacity);
    self.Win.BackgroundTransparency=1-self.Opacity;
    if self.Sidebar then
        self.Sidebar.BackgroundTransparency=0.3+(1-self.Opacity)*0.7;
    end
;
end
;
function L:SetCornerRadius(R)T.trace('SetCornerRadius');
    R=math.clamp(tonumber(R)or 1,0,2);
    self.State.set('radius',R);
    f.setRadius(R);
    U.setRadius();
end
;
function L:SetFont(R)T.trace("SetFont");
    if t.setFamily(R)then
        self.State.set("font",t.name);
    end
;
end
;
function L:SetTextScale(R)T.trace("SetTextScale");
    R=math.clamp(tonumber(R)or 1,0.8,1.3);
    self.State.set("textScale",R);
    t.setScale(R);
end
;
function L:SetSounds(R)B.enabled=R and true or false;
    self.State.set('sounds',B.enabled);
end
;
function L:SetVolume(R)B.volume=math.clamp(tonumber(R)or 0.5,0,1);
    self.State.set('volume',B.volume);
end
;
function L:SetMotion(R)J.enabled=R and true or false;
    self.State.set("motion",J.enabled);
end
;
function L:SetTooltips(R)self.TooltipsOn=R and true or false;
    self.State.set('tooltips',self.TooltipsOn);
    if not self.TooltipsOn then
        self:HideTip();
    end
;
end
;
function L:SetLauncher(R)self.LauncherOn=R and true or false;
    self.State.set('launcher',self.LauncherOn);
    if self.Launcher then
        self.Launcher.Visible=self.LauncherOn and not(self.IsTouch and self.IsOpen);
    end
;
end
;
function L:SetAccent(R)T.trace("SetAccent");
    if typeof(R)~="Color3"then
        return;
    end
;
X.set("Accent",R);
self.State.set('accent',R:ToHex());
end

function L:_syncFooter()
    local R=T.keyName and T.keyName(self.Key)or self.Key.Name;
    if self.FooterKey then
        self.FooterKey.Text=R;
    end
;
if self.LauncherParts and self.LauncherParts.key then
    self.LauncherParts.key.Text=R;
end
;
if self.SidebarCollapsed and self.FooterText then
    self.FooterText.TextTransparency=1;
    self.FooterChip.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5);
    self.FooterChip.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,1);
end
;
end

function L:SetBase(R)T.trace('SetBase');
    if X.setBase(R)then
        self.State.set('base',R);
        self.State.set('panel',nil);
        self.PanelColor=nil;
    end
;
end

function L:SetPanelColor(R)T.trace("SetPanelColor");
    if typeof(R)~="Color3"then
        return;
    end
;
self.PanelColor=R;
self.State.set("panel",R:ToHex());
X.base='Custom';
if self._panelQueued then
    return;
end
;
self._panelQueued=true;
task.delay(0.06,
    function()self._panelQueued=false;
        if self.PanelColor and not self.Destroyed then
            X.setMany(X.panelFrom(self.PanelColor));
            X.base='Custom';
        end
    ;
end
);
end

function L:OnKeyChanged(R)self.KeyListeners=self.KeyListeners or{};
    table.insert(self.KeyListeners,R);
end
;
function L:SetKey(R)
    if typeof(R)=="EnumItem"and R.EnumType==Enum.KeyCode then
        self.Key=R;
        self.State.set('menuKey',R.Name);
        self:_syncFooter();
        for r,r in ipairs(self.KeyListeners or{})do
            task.spawn(pcall,r,R);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
function L:SetTitle(R,r)
    if R then
        self.TitleLabel.Text=R;
    end
;
if r then
    self.SubtitleLabel.Text=r;
end
;
end

function L:ResetAppearance()
    for R,R in ipairs({"accent",'radius',"font",'textScale','scale','autoFit',"blur","bgStyle","bgIntensity","opacity",'tooltips','launcher',"base","cardStyle",'density','watermark',"keybindList","sidebarWidth","panel"})do
        self.State.data[R]=nil;
    end
;
self.State.save();
self.PanelColor=nil;
local R=self.StateDefaults;
if type(R)=='table'then
    if R.base then
        self:SetBase(R.base);
    end
;
if R.panel then
    pcall(
        function()self:SetPanelColor(Color3.fromHex(R.panel));
        end
);
end
;
if R.accent then
    pcall(
        function()self:SetAccent(Color3.fromHex(R.accent));
        end
);
end
;
self:SetCornerRadius(tonumber(R.radius)or 1);
if R.font then
    self:SetFont(R.font);
end
;
self:SetTextScale(tonumber(R.textScale)or 1);
self:SetScale(tonumber(R.scale)or self.DefaultScale);
self:SetAutoFit(R.autoFit~=false);
self:SetBlur(R.blur==true);
if R.bgStyle then
    self:SetBackground(R.bgStyle);
end
;
self:SetBackgroundIntensity(tonumber(R.bgIntensity)or 1);
if R.cardStyle then
    self:SetCardStyle(R.cardStyle);
end
;
if R.density then
    self:SetDensity(R.density);
end
;
self:SetSidebarWidth(tonumber(R.sidebarWidth)or self.DefaultSidebarWidth);
self:SetOpacity(tonumber(R.opacity)or 1);
if R.groupLabels~=nil and self.SetGroupLabels then
    self:SetGroupLabels(R.groupLabels);
end
;
if self.SetTooltips then
    self:SetTooltips(R.tooltips~=false);
end
;
if R.launcher~=nil and self.SetLauncher then
    self:SetLauncher(R.launcher);
end
;
self.State.save();
if self.OnReset then
    pcall(self.OnReset);
end
;
return;
end
;
X.setBase("Midnight");
X.set('Accent',X.Presets.Crimson);
self:SetCornerRadius(1);
self:SetFont("Builder Sans");
self:SetTextScale(1);
self:SetScale(self.DefaultScale);
self:SetAutoFit(true);
self:SetBlur(false);
self:SetBackground('Aurora');
self:SetBackgroundIntensity(1);
self:SetCardStyle("Glass");
self:SetDensity("Comfortable");
self:SetSidebarWidth(self.DefaultSidebarWidth);
self:SetOpacity(1);
self.State.data.accent=nil;
self.State.data.radius=nil;
self.State.data.font=nil;
self.State.data.textScale=nil;
self.State.data.scale=nil;
self.State.data.blur=nil;
self.State.data.bgStyle=nil;
self.State.data.bgIntensity=nil;
self.State.data.opacity=nil;
self.State.save();
if self.OnReset then
    pcall(self.OnReset);
end
;
end

function L:_buildClose(R)

        K(_,'ImageColor3',"Danger");
    end

local s=U.image(r,'rim9',{Name="Rim",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),SliceScale=0.64,ImageTransparency=0.72,ZIndex=7});

    function()c(q,"Quick",{[h]=X.resolve("Danger")});
        c(s,"Quick",{ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)});
        if _ then
            c(_,'Quick',{ImageTransparency=0.72});
        end
    ;

    self:ShowTip("Close");

    end
);

        self:Close();
    end
);
self.CloseButton=r;

    r.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(42,42);
    r.Position=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,31);
    s.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(19,19);
    if _ then
        _.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(70,70);
    end

_.MouseButton1Down:Connect(
    function()c(R,'Quick',{Scale=0.9});
    end
);
_.MouseButton1Up:Connect(
    function()c(R,'PopSmall',{Scale=1});
    end
);

        self:HideTip();
        self:Close();
    end
);
end
;
X.onChange(
    function(R)
        if R=='Elevated'or R=="Danger"then
            pcall(

                end
        );

;
self.HeaderButtons=self.HeaderButtons or{};
local _=#self.HeaderButtons+1;

local l=M("TextButton",{Name=R.Name or'HeaderButton',Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundTransparency=1,AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0.5),Position=UDim2.new(1,-(h+s*_),0,31),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(u,u),ZIndex=5,Parent=r});

;
function L:_drag(X)
    if typeof(X)~="Instance"then
        return;
    end
;
local R,r,_,q;
X.InputBegan:Connect(
    function(X)
        if not f.isClick(X)then
            return;
        end
    ;
    R,r,_,q=true,X.Position,self.Root.Position,X;
    local u;
    u=X.Changed:Connect(
        function()
            if X.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.End then
                R=false;
                u:Disconnect();
                self:_savePos();
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
);
f.connect(w.InputChanged,
    function(X)
        if R and f.sameMove(X,q)then
            local R=X.Position-r;
            self.Root.Position=UDim2.new(_.X.Scale,_.X.Offset+R.X,_.Y.Scale,_.Y.Offset+R.Y);
        end
    ;
end
,self.Conns);
end
;
function L:_savePos()
    if not(self.State and self.Root)then
        return;
    end
;
local X=self.Root.Position;
if math.abs(X.X.Scale-0.5)>0.001 or math.abs(X.Y.Scale-0.5)>0.001 then
    return;
end
;
pcall(self.State.set,self.IsTouch and'touchPos'or'winPos',{math.floor(X.X.Offset+0.5),math.floor(X.Y.Offset+0.5)});
end
;
function L:_resize(X)
    local R,r,_,q,u;
    X.InputBegan:Connect(
        function(X)
            if not f.isClick(X)then
                return;
            end
        ;
        R,r,_,q,u=true,X.Position,self.Root.AbsoluteSize/math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1),self.Root.Position,X;
        local s;
        s=X.Changed:Connect(
            function()
                if X.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    R=false;
                    s:Disconnect();
                    if self.IsTouch then
                        self.TouchSize=self.Size;
                        if self.State then
                            pcall(self.State.set,'touchSize',{math.floor(self.Size.X+0.5),math.floor(self.Size.Y+0.5)});
                        end
                    ;
                elseif self.State then
                        pcall(self.State.set,'size',{math.floor(self.Size.X+0.5),math.floor(self.Size.Y+0.5)});
                    end
                ;
                self:_savePos();
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
);
f.connect(w.InputChanged,
    function(X)
        if R and f.sameMove(X,u)then
            local R=(X.Position-r)/math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1);
            local X,r=self.MinSize.X,self.MinSize.Y;
            if self.IsTouch then
                local u=workspace.CurrentCamera;
                local s=u and u.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720);
                local u=math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1);
                X,r=360,240;
                R=Vector2.new(math.min(R.X,(s.X-16)/u-_.X),math.min(R.Y,(s.Y-16)/u-_.Y));
            end
        ;
        local u=math.max(X,_.X+R.X);
        local X=math.max(r,_.Y+R.Y);
        self.Size=Vector2.new(u,X);
        self.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(u,X);
        local R=self.Scale.Scale;
        self.Root.Position=UDim2.new(q.X.Scale,q.X.Offset+(u-_.X)*R/2,q.Y.Scale,q.Y.Offset+(X-_.Y)*R/2);
    end
;
end
,self.Conns);
end
;
function L:_syncLayers()
    local X=math.max((self.AutoScale or 1)*self.UserScale,0.1);
    for R,R in ipairs({{self.FloatLayer,self.FloatScale},{self.PopLayer,self.PopScale}})do
        R[2].Scale=X;
        R[1].Size=UDim2.fromScale(1/X,1/X);
    end
;
end
;
function T.screenFactor(X)
    if not X then
        local R=workspace.CurrentCamera;
        X=R and R.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920,1000);
    end
;
local R=math.min(X.X/1920,X.Y/1000);
if math.abs(R-1)<0.04 then
    R=1;
end
;
return f.clamp(R,0.5,1.3);
end
;
function L:_placeOnScreen(X)
    local R=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local r=R and R.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720);
    X=X or self.Root.Position;
    local R=(self.AutoScale or 1)*self.UserScale;
    local _=Vector2.new(self.Root.Size.X.Offset,self.Root.Size.Y.Offset)*R;
    local R=X.X.Scale*r.X+X.X.Offset;
    local q=X.Y.Scale*r.Y+X.Y.Offset;
    local u,s,h=_.X/2,_.Y/2,8;
    local Y=_.X+h*2>=r.X and r.X/2 or math.clamp(R,u+h,r.X-u-h);
    local u=_.Y+h*2>=r.Y and r.Y/2 or math.clamp(q,s+h,r.Y-s-h);
    if math.abs(Y-R)<0.5 and math.abs(u-q)<0.5 then
        return X;
    end
;
return UDim2.new(X.X.Scale,math.floor(X.X.Offset+(Y-R)+0.5),X.Y.Scale,math.floor(X.Y.Offset+(u-q)+0.5));
end
;
function L:OnScreenScale(X)table.insert(self.ScaleHooks,X);
    local R=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local r,_=pcall(X,self.OverlayScale or 1,R and R.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720));
    if r and _==false then
        local R=table.find(self.ScaleHooks,X);
        if R then
            table.remove(self.ScaleHooks,R);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
function L:SetAutoFit(X)T.trace("SetAutoFit");
    self.AutoFit=X and true or false;
    self.State.set("autoFit",self.AutoFit);
    if not self.AutoFit and not self.IsTouch then
        self.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(self.Size.X,self.Size.Y);
    end
;
if self._applyScale then
    self._applyScale(true);
end
;
end
;
function L:_autoScale()
    local X=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local
    function R(r)
        local r=X and X.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720);
        local _=self.AutoFit and T.screenFactor(r)or 1;
        self.ScreenFactor=_;
        self.OverlayScale=self.AutoFit and f.clamp(_,0.6,1.2)or 1;
        if self.IsTouch then
            local q=f.clamp((r.Y-16)/440,0.55,1);
            local u=f.clamp(q*self.UserScale/math.max(self.DefaultScale or 1,0.1),0.45,1.3);
            local q=math.floor(math.min(self.BaseSize.X,(r.X-16)/u));
            local s=math.floor(math.min(self.BaseSize.Y,(r.Y-16)/u));
            local h=self.TouchSize;
            local Y,l;
            if h then
                Y=math.floor(f.clamp(h.X,math.min(360,q),q));
                l=math.floor(f.clamp(h.Y,math.min(240,s),s));
            else
                Y=math.min(q,math.floor(r.X*0.72/u));
                l=math.min(s,math.floor(r.Y*0.86/u));
            end
        ;
        if self.Size.X~=Y or self.Size.Y~=l then
            self.Size=Vector2.new(Y,l);
            self.Root.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(Y,l);
        end
    ;
    self.AutoScale=u/math.max(self.UserScale,0.1);
elseif self.AutoFit then
        local q=math.max(self.UserScale,0.1);
        local u=math.max(q*_,math.min(0.6,q));
        local _,s=r.X-24,r.Y-24;
        local h,Y=self.Size.X,self.Size.Y;
        h=math.max(math.min(self.MinSize.X,h),math.min(h,math.floor(_/u)));
        Y=math.max(math.min(self.MinSize.Y,Y),math.min(Y,math.floor(s/u)));
        local l=math.min(1,_/(h*u),s/(Y*u));
        local _=UDim2.fromOffset(h,Y);
        if self.Root.Size~=_ then
            self.Root.Size=_;
        end
    ;
    self.AutoScale=f.clamp(u*l,0.3,1.8)/q;
else
    local _=math.min(1,(r.X-30)/self.Size.X,(r.Y-30)/self.Size.Y);
    self.AutoScale=f.clamp(_,0.45,1);
end
;
self.Scale.Scale=self.AutoScale*self.UserScale;
self.ToastScale.Scale=f.clamp(math.min(self.OverlayScale,r.X/900),0.55,1.2);
self:_syncLayers();
if not self.Scaling and not self.HomePos then
    local _=self:_placeOnScreen(self.Root.Position);
    if _~=self.Root.Position then
        self.Root.Position=_;
    end
;
end
;
for _=#self.ScaleHooks,1,-1.0 do
    local q,u=pcall(self.ScaleHooks[_],self.OverlayScale,r);
    if q and u==false then
        table.remove(self.ScaleHooks,_);
    end
;
end
;
end
;
R();
if X then
    f.connect(X:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"),R,self.Conns);
end
;
self._applyScale=R;
end
;
function L:SetScale(X)T.trace('SetScale');
    self.UserScale=f.clamp(tonumber(X)or 1,0.6,1.5);
    self.State.set("scale",self.UserScale);
    if self._applyScale then
        self._applyScale(true);
    end
;
end

local Y=V({Parent=X,Icon="chevron-down",Size=15,Pos=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Anchor=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Color="Muted",Z=30});
self.LauncherParts={btn=r,card=u,orb=X,orbStroke=W,chev=Y,glow=s,rim=h,key=x,scale=_,shadow=q};
local
function X()
    local W=math.max(_.Scale,0.1);
    local V=math.ceil(u.AbsoluteSize.X/W);
    if V>0 and r.Size.X.Offset~=V then
        r.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(V,42);
    end
;
end
;
u:GetPropertyChangedSignal('AbsoluteSize'):Connect(X);
task.defer(X);
local X=TweenInfo.new(0.1,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out);
local W=TweenInfo.new(0.34,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out);
local V,u,s,x,S=false,false,nil,nil,nil;
r.InputBegan:Connect(
    function(k)
        if not f.isClick(k)then
            return;
        end
    ;
    u,V,s,x,S=true,false,k.Position,r.Position,k;
    c(_,X,{Scale=self.LauncherBase*0.95});
end
);
f.connect(w.InputChanged,
    function(X)
        if u and f.sameMove(X,S)then
            local k=X.Position-s;
            if k.Magnitude>6 then
                V=true;
            end
        ;
        if V then
            local X=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize;
            local s=math.clamp(x.X.Offset+k.X,4,math.max(4,X.X-r.AbsoluteSize.X-4));
            local y=math.clamp(x.Y.Offset+k.Y,4,math.max(4,X.Y-r.AbsoluteSize.Y-4));
            r.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(s,y);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
,self.Conns);
f.connect(w.InputEnded,
    function(X)
        if u and f.sameEnd(X,S)then
            u=false;
            c(_,W,{Scale=self.LauncherBase});
            if V then
                R.set("launcherPos",{math.floor(r.Position.X.Offset),math.floor(r.Position.Y.Offset)});
            else
                B.play('click');
                self:Toggle();
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
,self.Conns);
r.MouseEnter:Connect(
    function()
        if h then
            c(h,"Quick",{ImageTransparency=0.2});
        end
    ;
    if q then
        c(q,"Quick",{ImageTransparency=0.35});
    end

if not u then

function L:_acrylicStep()
    local X,R,w=self.AcrylicPart,self.AcrylicMesh,workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not(X and R and w)then
        return;
    end
;
if X.Parent~=w then
    X.Parent=w;
end
;
local W=self.Root;
local V,r=W.AbsolutePosition,W.AbsoluteSize;
if not W.Visible or r.X<8 or r.Y<8 then
    R.Scale=Vector3.zero;
    return;
end
;
local W=math.floor(14*(f.radiusMult or 1)*math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1)*0.3+0.5)+2;
local
function _(q,u)
    local s=w:ScreenPointToRay(q,u);
    return s.Origin+s.Direction*0.001;
end
;
local q=_(V.X+W,V.Y+W);
local u=_(V.X+r.X-W,V.Y+W);
local s=_(V.X+r.X-W,V.Y+r.Y-W);
local W=w.CFrame;
X.CFrame=CFrame.fromMatrix((q+s)/2,W.XVector,W.YVector,W.ZVector);
R.Scale=Vector3.new((u-q).Magnitude,(u-s).Magnitude,0);
end

function L:_blur(X)
    local R=T.Services.RunService;
    self.AcrylicToken=(self.AcrylicToken or 0)+1;
    local w=self.AcrylicToken;
    if X and self.BlurEnabled and not self.Destroyed then
        local X=workspace.CurrentCamera;
        if not X then
            return;
        end
    ;
    if not(self.AcrylicDof and self.AcrylicDof.Parent)then
        self.AcrylicDof=M("DepthOfFieldEffect",{Name="NovaDepth",FarIntensity=0,FocusDistance=51.6,InFocusRadius=50,NearIntensity=0,Parent=T.Services.Lighting});
    end
;
if not(self.AcrylicPart and self.AcrylicPart.Parent)then
    local W=Instance.new('Part');
    W.Name='NovaGlass';
    W.Material=Enum.Material.Glass;
    W.Transparency=0.98;
    W.Color=Color3.new(0,0,0);
    W.Anchored=true;
    W.CanCollide=false;
    W.CanQuery=false;
    W.CanTouch=false;
    W.CastShadow=false;
    W.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,0);
    local V=Instance.new('SpecialMesh');
    V.MeshType=Enum.MeshType.Brick;
    V.Scale=Vector3.zero;
    V.Parent=W;
    W.Parent=X;
    self.AcrylicPart,self.AcrylicMesh=W,V;
end
;
if not self.AcrylicBound then
    self.AcrylicBound="NovaAcrylic_"..tostring(self.Gui and self.Gui.Name or'Nova');
    pcall(
        function()R:UnbindFromRenderStep(self.AcrylicBound);
        end
);
R:BindToRenderStep(self.AcrylicBound,Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+1,
    function()self:_acrylicStep();
    end
);
end
;
c(self.AcrylicDof,"Slow",{NearIntensity=1});
return;
end
;
if self.AcrylicDof then
    c(self.AcrylicDof,'Quick',{NearIntensity=0});
end
;
local
function X()
    if self.AcrylicToken~=w then
        return;
    end
;
if self.AcrylicBound then
    local w=self.AcrylicBound;
    self.AcrylicBound=nil;
    pcall(
        function()R:UnbindFromRenderStep(w);
        end
);
end
;
if self.AcrylicPart then
    pcall(
        function()self.AcrylicPart:Destroy();
        end
);
self.AcrylicPart,self.AcrylicMesh=nil,nil;
end
;
if self.AcrylicDof then
    pcall(
        function()self.AcrylicDof:Destroy();
        end
);
self.AcrylicDof=nil;
end
;
end
;
if self.Destroyed then
    X();
else
    task.delay(0.22,X);
end
;
end

function L:Open()T.trace("Open");
    if self.Destroyed or self.IsOpen then
        return;
    end
;
self.IsOpen=true;
self.OpenToken=(self.OpenToken or 0)+1;
local J=self.OpenToken;
self:_stopGenie();
local V=self:_placeOnScreen(self.HomePos or self.Root.Position);
self.HomePos=nil;
self.Root.Position=V;
local r=self.GenieAnim and self:_launcherPoint()or nil;
if self.IsTouch and self.Launcher then
    self.Launcher.Visible=false;
end
;
local _=self.AutoScale*self.UserScale;
self.Win.GroupTransparency=1;
if r then
    self.Scaling=true;
    self.Root.Position=r;
    self.Scale.Scale=_*0.12;
    self:_syncLayers();
    self.Root.Visible=true;
    self.FloatLayer.Visible=true;
    self.GeniePos=c(self.Root,X,{Position=V});
    self.GenieScale=c(self.Scale,X,{Scale=_});
    c(self.Win,w,{GroupTransparency=0});
    task.delay(X.Time+0.03,
        function()
            if self.OpenToken==J then
                self:_endScaling();
            end
        ;
    end
);
else
    self:_endScaling();
    self.Scale.Scale=_;
    self:_syncLayers();
    self.Root.Visible=true;
    self.FloatLayer.Visible=true;
    c(self.Win,w,{GroupTransparency=0});
end
;
if self.WindowShadow then
    self.WindowShadow.ImageTransparency=1;
    c(self.WindowShadow,'Slow',{ImageTransparency=0.45});
end
;
self:_blur(true);
self:_launcherState(true);
B.play("open");
if not self.Current and self.TabList[1]then
    self:SelectTab(self.TabList[1]);
end
;
task.defer(
    function()self:_layoutTabs(false);
    end
);
end
;
function L:Close()T.trace("Close");
    if self.Destroyed or not self.IsOpen then
        return;
    end
;
self.IsOpen=false;
self.OpenToken=(self.OpenToken or 0)+1;
local J=self.OpenToken;
self:ClosePopups();
self:HideTip();
self:_stopGenie();
if self.Launcher then
    self.Launcher.Visible=self.LauncherOn;
end
;
local X=self.AutoScale*self.UserScale;
local w=self.GenieAnim and self:_launcherPoint()or nil;
local V=0.2;
if w then
    self.Scaling=true;
    self.HomePos=self.Root.Position;
    self.GeniePos=c(self.Root,R,{Position=w});
    self.GenieScale=c(self.Scale,R,{Scale=X*0.12});
    c(self.Win,W,{GroupTransparency=1});
    V=R.Time+0.03;
    local R=self.LauncherParts;
    if R then
        task.delay(0.24,
            function()
                if self.OpenToken~=J then
                    return;
                end
            ;
            c(R.scale,TweenInfo.new(0.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Scale=self.LauncherBase*1.08});
            task.delay(0.12,
                function()c(R.scale,TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Scale=self.LauncherBase});
                end
        );
end
);
end
;
else
    c(self.Win,"Exit",{GroupTransparency=1});
end
;
if self.WindowShadow then
    c(self.WindowShadow,'Exit',{ImageTransparency=1});
end
;
self:_blur(false);
self:_launcherState(false);
B.play('close');
task.delay(V,
    function()
        if self.IsOpen or self.OpenToken~=J then
            return;
        end
    ;
    self:_stopGenie();
    self.Root.Visible=false;
    if self.HomePos then
        self.Root.Position=self.HomePos;
        self.HomePos=nil;
    end
;
self.Scale.Scale=X;
task.defer(
    function()
        if not self.IsOpen and self.OpenToken==J then
            self:_endScaling();
        end
    ;
end
);
end
);
end

    local J=M("CanvasGroup",{Name="Popup",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BorderSizePixel=0,GroupTransparency=1,ZIndex=2,Parent=R});

function L:PopupPlace(J,X,R,U)
    local w=math.max(self.PopScale.Scale,0.1);
    local W=self.PopLayer.AbsolutePosition;
    local V=(J.AbsolutePosition-W)/w;
    local W=J.AbsoluteSize/w;
    local J=self.PopLayer.AbsoluteSize/w;
    local w=U=='left'and V.X or V.X+W.X-X;
    w=math.clamp(w,8,math.max(8,J.X-X-8));
    local X=V.Y+W.Y+6;
    local W=false;
    if X+R>J.Y-8 then
        X=math.max(8,V.Y-R-6);
        W=true;
    end
;
return w,X,U=="left"and 0 or 1,W and 1 or 0;
end

L.Densities={'Comfortable','Compact'};
function L.applyDensity(n)
    if n.Density=='Compact'then
        n.RowH,n.CapH,n.TileS,n.LabelX=31,22,22,36;
    else
        n.Density="Comfortable";
        n.RowH,n.CapH,n.TileS,n.LabelX=s,l,30,46;
    end
;
end

;
function L:_ensureGroup()
    if self.CurGroup then
        return self.CurGroup;
    end
;
local X={Key="_",Tabs={},Collapsed=false};
table.insert(self.Groups,X);
self.CurGroup=X;
return X;
end
;
function L:TabGroup(X)X=tostring(X or"");
    local W=self.State.get('groups',{});
    local s={Key=X,Tabs={},Collapsed=type(W)=='table'and W[X]==true};
    local W=U("Frame",{Name="Group_"..X,Size=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,self.CapH),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Parent=self.TabCanvas});
    local l=U("TextButton",{Name="Hit",Text="",AutoButtonColor=false,BackgroundTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),ZIndex=4,Parent=W});
    s.Row=W;
    s.Label=K({Parent=W,Text=X,Font=t.Bold(),Size=11,Pos=UDim2.fromOffset(10,2),Box=UDim2.new(1,-36.0,1,-2.0),Color='Faint',Z=2,Name="Caption"});
    s.Chev=w({Parent=W,Icon='chevron-down',Size=13,Pos=UDim2.new(1,-10.0,0.5,1),Anchor=Vector2.new(1,0.5),Color='Faint',Z=2});
    s.Line=U("Frame",{Name='Divider',AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(22,2),BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundTransparency=1,Parent=W});
    c(s.Line,'BackgroundColor3','Glass');
    f.corner(s.Line,UDim.new(1,0));
    if s.Collapsed then
        s.Chev.Rotation=-90.0;
    end
;
l.MouseEnter:Connect(
    function()Q(s.Label,"TextColor3",'Muted',"Quick");
        Q(s.Chev,"ImageColor3","Muted",'Quick');
    end
);
f.leave(l,
    function()Q(s.Label,"TextColor3","Faint","Quick");
        Q(s.Chev,'ImageColor3','Faint',"Quick");
    end
);
l.MouseButton1Click:Connect(
    function()
        if self.SidebarCollapsed then
            return;
        end
    ;
    R.play('tick');
    self:SetGroupCollapsed(s,not s.Collapsed);
end
);
table.insert(self.Groups,s);
self.CurGroup=s;
if self.SidebarCollapsed then
    s.Label.TextTransparency,s.Chev.ImageTransparency,s.Line.BackgroundTransparency=1,1,C(self)==s and 1 or 0.88;
end
;
self:_layoutTabs(false);
return s.Label;
end
;
function L:SetGroupCollapsed(X,W)
    if type(X)=='string'then
        for s,s in ipairs(self.Groups)do
            if s.Key==X then
                X=s;
                break;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
if type(X)~='table'then
    return;
end
;
X.Collapsed=W and true or false;
local W=self.State.get('groups',{});
if type(W)~='table'then
    W={};
end
;
W[X.Key]=X.Collapsed or nil;
self.State.data.groups=W;
self.State.save();
if X.Chev then
    M(X.Chev,"Base",{Rotation=X.Collapsed and-90.0 or 0});
end
;
self:_layoutTabs(true);
end
;
local
function X(W,s)
    if type(W)~="table"then
        return math.huge;
    end
;
for l,n in ipairs(W)do
    if n==s then
        return l;
    end
;
end
;
return math.huge;
end
;
function L:_addTabRow(W,s)
    local l=self:_ensureGroup();
    W.Group=l;
    local n=self.SidebarCollapsed;
    local O=n and h or self.RowH;
    local N=U('CanvasGroup',{Name=W.Name,Size=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,O),Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,0),BackgroundTransparency=1,Parent=self.TabCanvas});
    W.Row=N;

function L:_styleTab(X,W,s)
    if not X.Row then
        return;
    end
;
local l=s and'Base'or TweenInfo.new(0);
local s,E=X.TileProp,X.TileAlphaProp;
if W then
    Q(X.Tile,s,"Accent",l);
    M(X.Tile,l,{[E]=0});
    Q(X.IconImg,'ImageColor3','OnAccent',l);
    Q(X.Label,"TextColor3","Text",l);
    local W=self.SidebarCollapsed;
    M(X.Bg,l,{BackgroundTransparency=W and 1 or 0.42});
    Q(X.BgStroke,"Color",'Accent',l);
    M(X.BgStroke,l,{Transparency=W and 1 or 0.72});
    if X.Glow then
        M(X.Glow,l,{ImageTransparency=0.5});
    end
;
else
    Q(X.Tile,s,"Elevated",l);
    M(X.Tile,l,{[E]=H(self,X.Hover)});
    Q(X.IconImg,"ImageColor3",X.Hover and'Text'or'Muted',l);
    Q(X.Label,"TextColor3",X.Hover and"Text"or"Muted",l);
    M(X.Bg,l,{BackgroundTransparency=X.Hover and 0.6 or 1});
    M(X.BgStroke,l,{Transparency=1});
    if X.Glow then
        M(X.Glow,l,{ImageTransparency=1});
    end
;
end
;
end

local
function X(W,s,l,E,H)
    local n=W.Row;
    W.TargetY=s;
    W.RowToken=(W.RowToken or 0)+1;
    local O=W.RowToken;
    local N=UDim2.fromOffset(8,s);
    local s=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,H);
    if not E then
        n.Position,n.Size=N,s;
        n.GroupTransparency=l and 1 or 0;
        n.Visible=not l;
        return;
    end
;
if not l then
    n.Visible=true;
end
;
M(n,y,{Position=N,Size=s,GroupTransparency=l and 1 or 0});
if l then
    task.delay(0.36,
        function()
            if W.RowToken==O then
                n.Visible=false;
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
;
end

function L:_layoutTabs(W)
    if not self.TabCanvas then
        return;
    end
;
if not J.enabled then
    W=false;
end
;
local J=self.SidebarCollapsed;
local s=J and h or self.RowH;
local l=self.GroupLabels~=false;
local E=4;
for H,H in ipairs(self.Groups)do
    if H.Row and not l then
        H.Row.Visible=false;
        H.Row.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,E);
        H.Row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,0);
    elseif H.Row then
            H.Row.Visible=true;
            local n=J and(H==C(self)and 6 or x)or self.CapH;
            H.Row.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,E);
            if W then
                M(H.Row,y,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,E),Size=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,n)});
            else
                H.Row.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16.0,0,n);
            end
        ;
        E+=n;
    end
;
local x=H.Collapsed and not J and l;
local J=E;
for y,y in ipairs(H.Tabs)do
    if y~=self.DraggingTab then
        X(y,x and J or E,x,W,s);
    end
;
if not x then
    E+=s+Y;
end
;
end
;
if#H.Tabs>0 and not x and l then
    E+=4;
end
;
end
;
self.TabCanvas.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,E+6);
end
;
function L:SetGroupLabels(J)J=J~=false;
    if J==(self.GroupLabels~=false)then
        return;
    end
;
self.GroupLabels=J;
self.State.set('groupLabels',J);
if J and not self.SidebarCollapsed then
    for X,X in ipairs(self.Groups)do
        if X.Row then
            X.Label.TextTransparency,X.Chev.ImageTransparency=1,1;
            M(X.Label,"Base",{TextTransparency=0});
            M(X.Chev,"Base",{ImageTransparency=0});
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
self:_layoutTabs(true);
if self.OnGroupLabels then
    pcall(self.OnGroupLabels,J);
end
;
end

function L:_revealTab(J)
    local X,W=self.TabScroll,J and J.Row;
    if not X or not W then
        return;
    end
;
local J=W.Position.Y.Offset;
local s=J+W.Size.Y.Offset;
local W=X.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y/math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1);
local l=X.CanvasPosition.Y;
local x=l;
if J-6<l then
    x=math.max(0,J-6);
elseif s+6>l+W then
        x=s+6-W;
    end
;
if math.abs(x-l)<1 then
    return;
end
;
M(X,"Base",{CanvasPosition=Vector2.new(0,x)});
end

    end

self.SidebarCollapsed=J;
self.State.set("sidebarCollapsed",J);
local W=J and _ or self.ExpandedWidth;

local s=X and TweenInfo.new(0)or TweenInfo.new(0.38,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out);

        self.State.set("sidebarWidth",math.floor(J+0.5));
    end

    pcall(self.OnSidebarWidth,J);

    return;

local
function J(X)
    return(f.at(X.PressInput).Y-X.TabCanvas.AbsolutePosition.Y)/math.max(X.Scale.Scale,0.1);

;
function L:_reorderMove()
    local X=self.PressTab;
    if not X and not self.DraggingTab then
        return;
    end
;
if not self.DraggingTab then
    local W=f.at(self.PressInput);
    if self.IsTouch and os.clock()-(self.PressTime or 0)<0.35 then
        if(W-self.PressAt).Magnitude>=9 then
            self.PressTab=nil;
        end
    ;
    return;
end
;
if(W-self.PressAt).Magnitude<9 then
    return;
end
;
self.DraggingTab=X;
self.DragOffset=J(self)-(X.TargetY or 0);
X.Row.ZIndex=10;
self:HideTip();
M(X.Bg,"Quick",{BackgroundTransparency=0.25});
Q(X.BgStroke,"Color",'Accent',"Quick");
M(X.BgStroke,"Quick",{Transparency=0.35});
if X.Glow then
    M(X.Glow,'Quick',{ImageTransparency=0.5});
end
;
R.play('tick');
end
;
local X=self.DraggingTab;
if not X then
    return;
end
;
self:_tabPopFeedback(X);
local W=X.Group;
local r=self.SidebarCollapsed and h or self.RowH;
local _=W.Tabs[1]and W.Tabs[1].TargetY or 0;
local q=_;
local u=_+math.max(0,#W.Tabs-1)*(r+Y);
local s=math.clamp(J(self)-self.DragOffset,q-8,u+8);
X.Row.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,s);
local J=s+r/2;
local q=1;
local u=_;
for _=1,#W.Tabs do
    if W.Tabs[_]~=X then
        if J>u+r/2 then
            q+=1;
        end
    ;
    u+=r+Y;
end
;
end
;
q=math.clamp(q,1,#W.Tabs);
local J;
for r,_ in ipairs(W.Tabs)do
    if _==X then
        J=r;
    end
;
end
;
if J and J~=q then
    table.remove(W.Tabs,J);
    table.insert(W.Tabs,q,X);
    self:_layoutTabs(true);
    R.play("tick",0.6);
end
;
end
;
function L:_tabPopFeedback(J)
    local X=f.at(self.PressInput);
    local W=self.Sidebar.AbsolutePosition.X+self.Sidebar.AbsoluteSize.X;
    local r=X.X>W+46*math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1)and#J.Sections>0;
    if not self.TabGhost then
        local W=U('CanvasGroup',{Name='TabGhost',AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,44),BorderSizePixel=0,GroupTransparency=1,Visible=false,ZIndex=400,Parent=self.FloatLayer});
        c(W,"BackgroundColor3","Elevated");
        f.corner(W,14);
        local U=B.image(W,"rim9",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),SliceScale=1,ImageTransparency=0.3,ZIndex=402});
        if U then
            c(U,'ImageColor3',"Accent");
        else
            c(f.stroke(W,V,1,0.4),'Color','Accent');
        end
    ;
    local U=B.image(self.FloatLayer,"shadow9",{Name="TabGhostShadow",AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,100),SliceScale=1,ImageTransparency=1,Visible=false,ZIndex=399});
    T.tile(W,{Name='Tile',Size=UDim2.fromOffset(28,28),Pos=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8),Color='Accent',Z=401});
    local B=w({Parent=W,Icon="layout-panel-top",Size=15,Pos=UDim2.fromOffset(22,22),Anchor=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Color='OnAccent',Z=403});
    local c=K({Parent=W,Text='',Font=t.Semi(),Size=13,Pos=UDim2.fromOffset(44,0),Box=UDim2.new(1,-52.0,1,0),Truncate=true,Z=403});
    self.TabGhost={Frame=W,Shadow=U,Icon=B,Label=c};
end
;
local t=self.TabGhost;
local B=math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale,0.1);
local U=(X-self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition)/B;
t.Frame.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(U.X+96,U.Y);
if t.Shadow then
    t.Shadow.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(U.X+96,U.Y+6);
end
;
if r~=self.TabPopIntent then
    self.TabPopIntent=r;
    t.Label.Text=J.Label and J.Label.Text or J.Name;
    if J.IconImg and J.IconImg.Image~=""then
        t.Icon.Image,t.Icon.ImageRectOffset,t.Icon.ImageRectSize=J.IconImg.Image,J.IconImg.ImageRectOffset,J.IconImg.ImageRectSize;
        t.Icon.Visible=true;
    end
;
if r then
    t.Frame.Visible=true;
    if t.Shadow then
        t.Shadow.Visible=true;
    end
;
R.play('click',0.7);
end
;
M(t.Frame,'Base',{GroupTransparency=r and 0 or 1});
if t.Shadow then
    M(t.Shadow,'Base',{ImageTransparency=r and 0.45 or 1});
end
;
M(J.Row,"Quick",{GroupTransparency=r and 0.45 or 0});
if not r then
    task.delay(0.2,
        function()
            if not self.TabPopIntent then
                t.Frame.Visible=false;
                if t.Shadow then
                    t.Shadow.Visible=false;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
);
end
;
end
;
end
;
function L:_reorderEnd()
    local J=self.DraggingTab;
    self.PressTab=nil;
    if not J then
        return;
    end
;
self.DraggingTab=nil;
self.LastDragEnd=os.clock();
if self.TabPopIntent then
    self.TabPopIntent=false;
    local X=self.TabGhost;
    if X then
        M(X.Frame,'Quick',{GroupTransparency=1});
        if X.Shadow then
            M(X.Shadow,"Quick",{ImageTransparency=1});
        end
    ;
    task.delay(0.2,
        function()X.Frame.Visible=false;
            if X.Shadow then
                X.Shadow.Visible=false;
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
;
M(J.Row,"Quick",{GroupTransparency=0});
local X=math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale,0.1);
local t=(f.at(self.PressInput)-self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition)/X;
self:FloatTab(J,t-Vector2.new(80,20));
end
;
J.Row.ZIndex=1;
self:_styleTab(J,self.Current==J,true);
self:_layoutTabs(true);
local f={};
for J,J in ipairs(self.Groups)do
    local X={};
    for t,t in ipairs(J.Tabs)do
        table.insert(X,t.Name);
    end
;
f[J.Key]=X;
end
;
self.State.data.tabOrder=f;
self.State.save();
if self.OnTabOrder then
    pcall(self.OnTabOrder,f);
end
;
end
;
end
;
do
    local f,J,X,t,R,R,B=T.U,T.Motion,T.Theme,T.Font,T.Icons,T.Sound,T.Tex;
    local U,M,c=f.new,J.tween,X.bind;
    local K,w,L=T.label,T.icon,T.paint;
    local W=T.WindowClass;
    local V=T.Services.UserInputService;
    local r=Color3.new(1,1,1);
    local _={};
    _.__index=_;
    T.TabClass=_;
    local q={};
    q.__index=q;
    T.SectionClass=q;
    local u=TweenInfo.new(0.32,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out);
    function W:Tab(s)
        if type(s)=="string"then
            s={Name=s};
        end
    ;
    s=s or{};
    local h=setmetatable({},_);
    h.Window=self;
    h.Name=s.Name or'Tab '..#self.TabList+1;
    h.Title=s.Title or h.Name;
    h.Desc=s.Desc or'';
    h.Icon=s.Icon;
    h.Rows,h.Sections,h.Pages,h.Loads={},{},{},{};
    h.Columns=s.Columns or 2;
    self.Tabs[h.Name]=h;
    table.insert(self.TabList,h);
    self:_addTabRow(h,s);
    local s=U('CanvasGroup',{Name=h.Name,Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,Parent=self.Parking or self.Body});
    h.Frame=s;
    h.RefreshGen=T.Refresh.gen;
    h.PageHost=U("Frame",{Name="Pages",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Parent=s});
    return h;
end
;
function _:_setActive(s)self.Window:_styleTab(self,s,true);
end
;
function W:SelectTab(s)T.trace("SelectTab");
    if type(s)=='string'then
        s=self.Tabs[s];
    end
;
if not s or s==self.Current then
    return;
end
;
local h=self.Current;
self.Current=s;
self:ClosePopups();
if s.Group and s.Group.Collapsed and not self.SidebarCollapsed then
    self:SetGroupCollapsed(s.Group,false);
end
;
if h then
    self:_styleTab(h,false,true);
    local Y=h.Frame;
    M(Y,'Quick',{GroupTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-14.0,0)});
    task.delay(0.16,
        function()
            if self.Current~=h then
                Y.Visible=false;
                if self.Parking then
                    Y.Parent=self.Parking;
                    h.RefreshGen=T.Refresh.gen;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
);
end
;
self:_styleTab(s,true,true);
self:_revealTab(s);
local h=s.Frame;
if h.Parent~=self.Body then
    h.Parent=self.Body;
    if s.RefreshGen~=T.Refresh.gen then
        T.Refresh.sync(h);
        s.RefreshGen=T.Refresh.gen;
    end
;
end
;
h.Visible=true;
h.GroupTransparency=1;
h.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,0);
M(h,'Base',{GroupTransparency=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)});
task.delay(0.2,
    function()
        if self.Current==s then
            s:_balanceActive();
        end
    ;
end
);
self.HeaderTitle.Text=s.Title;
self.HeaderDesc.Text=s.Desc or'';
if self.OnTabChanged then
    pcall(self.OnTabChanged,s);
end
;
end
;
local s,h,Y,l,x=46,7,40,360,"  ›  ";
local S={tab=30,sub=22,section=10,row=0};
local
function k(y)y=string.lower(tostring(y or""));
    y=string.gsub(y,"<[^>]->","");
    y=string.gsub(y,"\xFF([\xFF-\xFF])",
        function(Q)
            return'\xFF'..string.char(string.byte(Q)+32);
        end
);
y=string.gsub(y,"\xFF([\xFF-\xFF])",
    function(Q)
        return"\xFF"..string.char(string.byte(Q)-32);
    end
);
y=string.gsub(y,'\xFF([\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF])',
    function(Q)
        return'\xFF'..string.char(string.byte(Q)+16);
    end
);
return y;
end
;
local
function y(Q)
    return(string.gsub(tostring(Q or""),'<[^>]->',""));
end
;
local
function Q(E)E=string.gsub(E,"&",'&amp;');
    E=string.gsub(E,'<','&lt;');
    E=string.gsub(E,'>',"&gt;");
    return E;
end
;
local
function E(I,C,H)
    local n,O=string.find(k(I),C,1,true);
    if not n then
        return Q(I);
    end
;
return Q(string.sub(I,1,n-1))..'<font color="#'..H..'">'..Q(string.sub(I,n,O))..'</font>'..Q(string.sub(I,O+1));
end
;
function W:_searchSubLabel(I,C)
    local H=C and C.Key;
    if not H or H=="_"or not I.SubButtons then
        return nil;
    end
;
local C=I.SubButtons[H];
return y(C and C.Label and C.Label.Text or H);
end
;
function W:_searchCollect()
    local I={};
    for C,C in ipairs(self.TabList)do
        local H=y(C.Label and C.Label.Text or C.Name);
        local n=k(H.." "..tostring(C.Name));
        table.insert(I,{kind="tab",tab=C,title=H,path=T.tr('Tab'),hay=n,titleL=k(H)});
        if C.SubDefs and C.SubButtons then
            for O,O in ipairs(C.SubDefs)do
                local N=C.SubButtons[O.key];
                local z=y(N and N.Label and N.Label.Text or O.label or O.key);
                table.insert(I,{kind="sub",tab=C,sub=O.key,title=z,path=H,hay=k(z.." "..tostring(O.key)).." "..n,titleL=k(z)});
            end
        ;
    end
;
for n,n in ipairs(C.Sections)do
    if not n.Hidden and n.TitleLabel and not n.ParentSection then
        local O=self:_searchSubLabel(C,n.Page);
        local N=y(n.TitleLabel.Text);
        local z=O and H..x..O or H;
        table.insert(I,{kind='section',tab=C,sec=n,title=N,path=z,hay=k(N..' '..tostring(n.Key)..' '..z),titleL=k(N)});
    end
;
end
;
for n,n in ipairs(C.Rows)do
    local O=n.row;
    if O and O.Title and not O.selfHidden and not O.parentHidden and O.Frame and O.Frame.Parent then
        local N,z,D=n.sec,{},true;
        while N and N.ParentSection do
            if N.OwnerRow and(N.OwnerRow.selfHidden or N.OwnerRow.parentHidden)then
                D=false;
            end
        ;
        table.insert(z,N);
        N=N.ParentSection;
    end
;
local n=y(O.Title.Text);
if D and N and not N.Hidden and n~=''then
    local D={H};
    local H=self:_searchSubLabel(C,N.Page);
    if H then
        table.insert(D,H);
    end
;
if N.TitleLabel then
    table.insert(D,y(N.TitleLabel.Text));
end
;
for H=#z,1,-1.0 do
    local b=z[H].OwnerRow;
    if b and b.Title then
        table.insert(D,y(b.Title.Text));
    end
;
end
;
local y=table.concat(D,x);
local x=(O.Desc and O.Desc.Text or'').." "..tostring(O.Opts and O.Opts.Text or"");
if O.SearchOptions then
    local H,D=pcall(O.SearchOptions);
    if H and type(D)=="string"then
        x=x.." "..D;
    end
;
end
;
table.insert(I,{kind='row',tab=C,sec=N,row=O,chain=z,title=n,path=y,hay=k(n.." "..x..' '..y),titleL=k(n)});
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
return I;
end
;
function W:_searchRank(x)
    local y=k(x);
    y=string.gsub(y,"^%s+",'');
    y=string.gsub(y,"%s+$","");
    if y==''then
        return{},y;
    end
;
local x={};
for k in string.gmatch(y,'%S+')do
    table.insert(x,k);
end
;
local k,I={},{};
for C,C in ipairs(self:_searchCollect())do
    local H=0;
    local n=string.find(C.titleL,y,1,true);
    if n==1 then
        H=120;
    elseif n then
            H=70;
        end
    ;
    local O,N=true,n~=nil;
    for n,n in ipairs(x)do
        if string.find(C.titleL,n,1,true)then
            H+=18;
            N=true;
        elseif string.find(C.hay,n,1,true)then
                H+=4;
            else
                O=false;
                break;
            end
        ;
    end
;
if O and(N or C.kind~="row")then
    local x=C.kind.."|"..C.title.."|"..C.path;
    if not I[x]then
        I[x]=true;
        C.score=H+S[C.kind]-#C.titleL/40;
        table.insert(k,C);
    end
;
end
;
end
;
table.sort(k,
    function(x,S)
        return x.score>S.score;
    end
);
while#k>Y do
    table.remove(k);
end
;
return k,y;
end

self.SearchPop=nil;
self:PopupConceal(Y.Frame,Y.Shell);
task.delay(0.18,

            end
    );
end
);
end

    local k=l[S].OwnerToggle;

        k:SetDrawer(true);
    end
;

        if self.Destroyed or not l or not l.Parent then
            return;
        end
    ;
    self:_searchScroll(x,l);
    task.delay(0.35,
        function()self:_searchFlash(S);
        end
);
end
);
end

function W:Search(Y)T.trace("Search");
    if self.Query~=''then
        for l,l in ipairs(self.TabList)do
            for x,x in ipairs(l.Rows)do
                if x.searchHidden then
                    x.searchHidden=false;
                    x.refresh();
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    for x,x in ipairs(l.Sections)do
        x:_refreshVisibility();
    end
;
if l.Label and not self.SidebarCollapsed then
    M(l.Label,'Quick',{TextTransparency=0});
end
;
if l.IconImg then
    M(l.IconImg,"Quick",{ImageTransparency=0});
end
;
end
;
end
;
self.Query="";
local l=tostring(Y or'');
if not string.find(l,'%S')then
    self:_searchClose();
    return;
end
;
local Y,x=self:_searchRank(l);
local l=#Y==0 and 56 or math.min(#Y,h)*(s+2)+8;
self:_searchOpen(l);
self:_searchRender(Y,x);
end

            L(x,"TextColor3",'Muted',"Quick");

;
function _:_queueFitSubs()
    if self.FitQueued then
        return;
    end
;
self.FitQueued=true;
task.delay(0.06,
    function()self.FitQueued=false;
        local s=self.Window;
        if not s or s.Destroyed then
            return;
        end
    ;
    if s.Scaling then
        s:_scalingDefer(
            function()self:_queueFitSubs();
            end
    );
return;
end
;
pcall(self._fitSubs,self);
end
);
end
;
function _:_fitSubs()
    local s,h=self.SubBar,self.SubPill;
    local Y=h and h.Parent;
    if not(s and Y and self.SubButtons)then
        return;
    end
;
local h=Y.AbsoluteSize.Y/36;
if h<=0.01 then
    return;
end
;
local l=s.AbsoluteSize.X/h;
if l<60 then
    return;
end
;
if not self.SubFitAvail or math.abs(self.SubFitAvail-l)>2 then
    self.SubFitAdj=1;
end
;
self.SubFitAvail=l;
local x=self.SubFitAdj or 1;
local S,k=0,0;
for y,y in pairs(self.SubButtons)do
    local Q=y.Label.TextSize;
    if Q<=0 then
        return;
    end
;
S+=1;
k+=y.Label.AbsoluteSize.X/h*(y.Base*f.textScale)/Q;
end
;
if S==0 or k<=0 then
    return;
end
;
k=k/x;
local h=(S-1)*2+6;
local x,y,Q=22,15,1;
if k+S*30+h+44>l then
    x=10;
    y=math.floor((l-x*2-h-k)/(2*S));
    if y>=6 then
        y=math.min(y,15);
    else
        y=6;
        Q=(l-x*2-h-S*12)/k;
        if Q<0.75 then
            y,x=3,4;
            Q=(l-x*2-h-S*6)/k;
        end
    ;
    Q=math.clamp(Q,0.6,1);
end
;
end
;
local h=false;
if Y.Position.X.Offset~=x then
    Y.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,6);
    h=true;
end
;
for l,l in pairs(self.SubButtons)do
    if l.Pad and l.Pad.PaddingLeft.Offset~=y then
        l.Pad.PaddingLeft,l.Pad.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,y),UDim.new(0,y);
        h=true;
    end
;
local S=math.max(8,math.floor(l.Base*Q+0.5));
local k=f.textReg[l.Label];
if k and k.size~=S then
    k.size=S;
    t.sizeOne(l.Label);
    h=true;
end
;
end
;
self.SubFit={margin=x,pad=y,f=Q};
if h then
    task.defer(
        function()self:_placePill(true);
        end
);
end
;
task.delay(0.08,
    function()
        if not(Y.Parent and s.Parent)then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local h=Y.AbsoluteSize.Y/36;
    if h<=0.01 then
        return;
    end
;
local l=(Y.AbsolutePosition.X+Y.AbsoluteSize.X-s.AbsolutePosition.X)/h;
if l>s.AbsoluteSize.X/h-2 and(self.SubFitAdj or 1)>0.8 then
    self.SubFitAdj=(self.SubFitAdj or 1)-0.04;
    pcall(self._fitSubs,self);
end
;
end
);
end
;
function _:_placePill(s)
    local h=self.SubButtons and self.SubButtons[self.ActiveSub];
    if not h or not self.SubPill or not self.SubPill.Parent then
        return;
    end
;
local Y=self.SubPill.Parent;
local l=Y.AbsoluteSize.Y/36;
if l<=0.01 then
    return;
end
;
local x=(h.Button.AbsolutePosition.X-Y.AbsolutePosition.X)/l;
local Y=h.Button.AbsoluteSize.X/l;
if Y<=1 then
    return;
end
;
local h={Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,3),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(Y,30)};
if s then
    self.SubPill.Position,self.SubPill.Size=h.Position,h.Size;
else
    M(self.SubPill,TweenInfo.new(0.34,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),h);
end
;
for h,Y in pairs(self.SubButtons)do
    L(Y.Label,"TextColor3",h==self.ActiveSub and"Text"or"Muted",s and TweenInfo.new(0)or"Quick");
end
;
end

function _:SelectSub(s)
    if not self.SubButtons or not self.SubButtons[s]or s==self.ActiveSub then
        return;
    end
;
local h=self.ActiveSub;

    Y.Root.Visible=false;
end
;
h.Root.Visible=true;
h.Root.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,48);
M(h.Root,"Base",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,48)});

    function()

        end
    ;
end

if self.OnSubChanged then
    pcall(self.OnSubChanged,s);
end
;
end

function _:_balance(s,h)
    if not s or s.One or self.Columns==1 then
        return;
    end
;
local Y=self.Window;
if Y.Destroyed or not s.Root.Visible then
    return;
end
;
if Y.Scaling then
    if(h or 0)<12 then
        task.delay(0.25,
            function()self:_balance(s,(h or 0)+1);
            end
    );
end
;
return;
end
;
local l=math.max(Y.Scale.Scale,0.1);
local Y,x={},0;
for S,k in ipairs(self.Sections)do
    if k.Page==s and not k.ParentSection and k.Wrap and k.Wrap.Parent then
        table.insert(Y,{sec=k,k=S});
        if not k.Pinned and not k.Floating then
            x+=1;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
if x==0 then
    return;
end
;
local x={};
for S,S in ipairs(Y)do
    local k=S.sec;
    local S=0;
    if k.Floating then
        S=k.Slot and k.Slot.Visible and k.Slot.AbsoluteSize.Y/l or 0;
    elseif not k.Hidden and k.Wrap.Visible then
            S=k.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.Y/l;
            if S<2 then
                if(h or 0)<12 then
                    task.delay(0.25,
                        function()self:_balance(s,(h or 0)+1);
                        end
                );
        end
    ;
    return;
end
;
end
;
x[k]=S;
end
;
local h={0,0};
for l,l in ipairs(Y)do
    local S=l.sec;
    local k;
    if S.Pinned or S.Floating then
        k=S.Side or 1;
    else
        k=h[1]<=h[2]+1 and 1 or 2;
        local y=k==1 and s.Left or s.Right;
        if S.Wrap.Parent~=y then
            S.Wrap.Parent=y;
        end
    ;
    S.Side=k;
end
;
local y=S.Floating and S.Slot or S.Wrap;
if y then
    y.LayoutOrder=l.k;
end
;
if x[S]>0 then
    h[k]+=x[S]+16;
end
;
end
;
s.BalancedCount=#Y;
end
;
function _:_balanceActive(s)
    local h=self.Pages[self.ActiveSub or'_']or self.Pages._;
    if not h then
        return;
    end
;
local Y=0;
for l,l in ipairs(self.Sections)do
    if l.Page==h and not l.ParentSection then
        Y+=1;
    end
;
end
;
if not s and h.BalancedCount==Y then
    return;
end
;
self:_balance(h);
end
;
function _:_queueBalance(s)
    if s.BalanceQueued then
        return;
    end
;
s.BalanceQueued=true;
task.delay(0.4,
    function()s.BalanceQueued=false;
        if self.Window.Current==self and s.Root.Visible then
            self:_balanceActive();
        end
    ;
end
);
end

W.CardStyles={'Glass',"Frosted",'Tinted',"Flat"};
function W:_applyCardStyle(J)
    local _=self.CardStyle or'Glass';
    local q=J.Card;
    if not q then
        return;
    end
;
local u=X.resolve('Accent');
if _=="Flat"then
    q.BackgroundTransparency=0;
    J.CardGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(r);
    if J.Gloss then
        J.Gloss.ImageTransparency=1;
    end
;
if J.Grain then
    J.Grain.ImageTransparency=1;
end
;
elseif _=="Frosted"then
        q.BackgroundTransparency=0.32;
        J.CardGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(r,Color3.fromRGB(220,222,230));
        if J.Gloss then
            J.Gloss.ImageTransparency=0.72;
        end
    ;
    if J.Grain then
        J.Grain.ImageTransparency=0.9;
    end
;
elseif _=='Tinted'then
        q.BackgroundTransparency=0.03;
        J.CardGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(r:Lerp(u,0.05),r:Lerp(u,0.34));
        if J.Gloss then
            J.Gloss.ImageTransparency=0.88;
        end
    ;
    if J.Grain then
        J.Grain.ImageTransparency=0.94;
    end
;
else
    q.BackgroundTransparency=0.03;
    J.CardGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(r,Color3.fromRGB(208,210,218));
    if J.Gloss then
        J.Gloss.ImageTransparency=0.9;
    end
;
if J.Grain then
    J.Grain.ImageTransparency=0.94;
end
;
end
;
end
;
function W:SetCardStyle(J)T.trace('SetCardStyle');
    for X,X in ipairs(W.CardStyles)do
        if X==J then
            self.CardStyle=J;
            self.State.set('cardStyle',J);
            for J,J in ipairs(self.TabList)do
                for X,X in ipairs(J.Sections)do
                    self:_applyCardStyle(X);
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    return;
end
;
end
;
end

function W:_initCards()f.connect(V.InputChanged,
        function(J)
            if self.CardPress and f.sameMove(J,self.CardPress.input)then
                self:_cardMove();
            end
        ;
    end
,self.Conns);
f.connect(V.InputEnded,
    function(J)
        if f.sameEnd(J,self.CardPress and self.CardPress.input)then
            self:_cardEnd();
        end
    ;
end
,self.Conns);
end

function W:_cardPress(J,X)self.CardPress={sec=J,at=f.at(X),t=os.clock(),input=X};
    if J.Floating then
        J.Wrap.ZIndex=self:_nextZ();
    end
;
end

function W:_cardMove()
    local J=self.CardPress;
    if not J then
        return;
    end
;
local X=J.sec;
local V=f.at(J.input);
local _=math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale,0.1);
if not self.CardDrag then
    local q=(V-J.at).Magnitude;
    if X.Floating then
        if q<4 then
            return;
        end
    ;
else
    if self.IsTouch and os.clock()-J.t<0.35 then
        if q>=10 then
            self.CardPress=nil;
        end
    ;
    return;
end
;
if q<12 or os.clock()-J.t<0.08 then
    return;
end
;
local J=(X.Card.AbsolutePosition-self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition)/_;
self:FloatSection(X,J);
R.play('click',0.8);
end
;
local J=(X.Wrap.AbsolutePosition-self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition)/_;
self.CardDrag={sec=X,grab=(V-self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition)/_-J,fresh=not X.WasFloating};
self:HideTip();
M(X.Shadow,"Quick",{ImageTransparency=0.25});
end
;
local J=self.CardDrag;
local q=(V-self.FloatLayer.AbsolutePosition)/_-J.grab;
local J=self.FloatLayer.AbsoluteSize/_;
local V=X.Wrap.AbsoluteSize/_;
q=Vector2.new(math.clamp(q.X,8-V.X+80,J.X-80),math.clamp(q.Y,4,J.Y-40));
X.Wrap.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(q.X,q.Y);
if X.Slot and X.SlotStroke then
    local J=X.Slot.AbsolutePosition+X.Slot.AbsoluteSize/2;
    local V=X.Wrap.AbsolutePosition+Vector2.new(X.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.X/2,math.min(X.Wrap.AbsoluteSize.Y/2,40));
    local q=self.IsOpen and X.Tab==self.Current and(J-V).Magnitude<110*_;
    if q~=X.NearSlot then
        X.NearSlot=q;
        M(X.SlotStroke,'Quick',{Transparency=q and 0.2 or 0.86});
        if X.SlotGlow then
            M(X.SlotGlow,"Quick",{ImageTransparency=q and 0.7 or 1});
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
function W:_cardEnd()
    local J=self.CardPress;
    self.CardPress=nil;
    local J=self.CardDrag;
    if not J then
        return;
    end
;
self.CardDrag=nil;
self.LastCardDrag=os.clock();
local X=J.sec;
M(X.Shadow,"Base",{ImageTransparency=0.3});
if X.NearSlot then
    X.NearSlot=false;
    self:DockSection(X);
    return;
end
;
local J=X.Wrap.Position;
local V=self.State.get('floats',{});
if type(V)~="table"then
    V={};
end
;
V[X.Key]={math.floor(J.X.Offset),math.floor(J.Y.Offset)};
self.State.data.floats=V;
self.State.save();
end

function W:FloatTab(J,X)T.trace('FloatTab');
    if type(J)=='string'then
        J=self.Tabs[J];
    end
;
if not J or self.Destroyed then
    return;
end
;
local L=math.max(self.FloatScale.Scale,0.1);
local V=self.FloatLayer.AbsoluteSize/L;
local L=Vector2.new(math.max(12,X.X),math.max(12,X.Y));
local X=self.Parking and J.Frame.Parent==self.Parking;
if X then
    J.Frame.Visible=false;
    J.Frame.Parent=self.Body;
    if J.RefreshGen~=T.Refresh.gen then
        T.Refresh.sync(J.Frame);
        J.RefreshGen=T.Refresh.gen;
    end
;
end
;
local r,_,q=L.X,L.Y,0;
local u=math.min(L.X+640,V.X-24);
for s,s in ipairs(J.Sections)do
    if not s.Floating and not s.Hidden then
        local h=s.Wrap.AbsoluteSize/math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1);
        if r+h.X>u and r>L.X then
            r=L.X;
            _+=q+14;
            q=0;
        end
    ;
    self:FloatSection(s,Vector2.new(math.clamp(r,8,math.max(8,V.X-h.X-8)),math.clamp(_,8,math.max(8,V.Y-80))));
    r+=h.X+14;
    q=math.max(q,h.Y);
end
;
end
;
if X and self.Current~=J then
    J.Frame.Parent=self.Parking;
end
;
self:_refreshTabState(J);
end

function W:DockSection(f)T.trace('DockSection');
    if not f.Floating then
        return;
    end
;
f.Floating=false;
for J,X in ipairs(self.Floats)do
    if X==f then
        table.remove(self.Floats,J);
        break;
    end
;
end
;
local J=f.Wrap;
local X=f.Slot;
if X and X.Parent then
    J.LayoutOrder=X.LayoutOrder;
    J.Parent=X.Parent;
    X:Destroy();
end
;
f.Slot,f.SlotStroke,f.SlotGlow=nil,nil,nil;
J.Position=UDim2.new();
J.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,J.AbsoluteSize.Y/math.max(self.Scale.Scale,0.1));
J.ZIndex=1;
if f.DockButton then
    f.DockButton:Destroy();
    f.DockButton=nil;
end
;
if f.Shadow then
    M(f.Shadow,'Base',{ImageTransparency=0.62});
end
;
if f.Rim then
    f.Rim.ImageTransparency=0.5;
end
;
task.defer(
    function()
        if f._sync then
            f._sync();
        end
    ;
end
);
f:_refreshVisibility();
local J=self.State.get("floats",{});
if type(J)=='table'then
    J[f.Key]=nil;
    self.State.data.floats=J;
    self.State.save();
end
;
self:_refreshTabState(f.Tab);
end
;
end

local
function X(r,...)
    if type(r)~='function'then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local _,q=pcall(r,...);
    if not _ then
        warn("[Nova] "..tostring(q));
    end
;
end
;
T.safe=X;
local
function r(_)
    if typeof(_)~='EnumItem'then
        return'None';
    end
;
if _.EnumType==Enum.UserInputType then
    if _==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        return"MB1";
    end
;
if _==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
    return"MB2";
end
;
if _==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 then
    return"MB3";
end
;
return"None";
end
;
local q={LeftShift="LShift",RightShift="RShift",LeftControl="LCtrl",RightControl="RCtrl",LeftAlt="LAlt",RightAlt="RAlt",Backquote="`",Return="Enter",F13="MB4",F14='MB5'};
return q[_.Name]or _.Name;
end
;
T.keyName=r;
function T.keyHeld(_)
    if typeof(_)~="EnumItem"then
        return false;
    end
;
local q,u=pcall(
    function()
        if _.EnumType==Enum.UserInputType then
            return w:IsMouseButtonPressed(_);
        end
    ;
    return w:IsKeyDown(_);
end
);
return q and u or false;
end
;
function T.bindHit(_,q,u,s)
    if typeof(u)~="EnumItem"then
        return false;
    end
;
if u.EnumType==Enum.UserInputType then
    if q.UserInputType~=u or s then
        return false;
    end
;
if _ and _.PointerOverUI and _:PointerOverUI()then
    return false;
end
;
return true;
end
;
return q.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and q.KeyCode==u;
end

end

function W(r)

                h=f.clamp((r.X-o.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(o.AbsoluteSize.X,1),0,1);
            end
        ;
        n(true);
    end

;
function L:SyncAppearance()
    local f=self.AppearanceRefs;
    if not f then
        return;
    end
;
local R=self.State;
f.scale:SetSilent(self.UserScale);
if f.autofit then
    f.autofit:SetSilent(self.AutoFit);
end
;
f.radius:SetSilent(tonumber(R.get("radius",1))or 1);
f.textScale:SetSilent(tonumber(R.get('textScale',1))or 1);
f.font:SetSilent(t.name);
f.opacity:SetSilent(self.Opacity);
f.density:SetSilent(self.Density);
f.sbWidth:SetSilent(self.ExpandedWidth);
f.compact:SetSilent(self.SidebarCollapsed==true);
if f.groupLabels then
    f.groupLabels:SetSilent(self.GroupLabels~=false);
end
;
f.palette:Set(nil,true);
for t,U in pairs(X.Presets)do
    if U:ToHex()==X.tokens.Accent:ToHex()then
        f.palette:Set(t,true);
    end
;
end
;
f.accent:SetSilent(X.tokens.Accent);
f.base:SetSilent(X.base);
f.panel:SetSilent(self.PanelColor or X.tokens.Background);
f.cards:SetSilent(self.CardStyle);
f.bg:SetSilent(self.BgStyle);
f.bgInt:SetSilent(self.BgIntensity);
f.blur:SetSilent(self.BlurEnabled);
f.motion:SetSilent(J.enabled);
f.sounds:SetSilent(B.enabled);
f.volume:SetSilent(B.volume);
f.tips:SetSilent(self.TooltipsOn);
f.launcher:SetSilent(self.LauncherOn);
if f.watermark then
    f.watermark:SetSilent(R.get('watermark',false)==true);
end
;
if f.kblist then
    f.kblist:SetSilent(R.get("keybindList",false)==true);
end
;
end
;
end

do
    local f,J,X,t,R,R,B=T.U,T.Motion,T.Theme,T.Font,T.Icons,T.Sound,T.Tex;
    local U,M,c=f.new,J.tween,X.bind;

    function r(_,q,u,s)
        local h=U("Frame",{Name=q,Position=u,Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,30),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,BackgroundTransparency=1,Visible=false,ZIndex=6,Parent=_.Gui});

        if u then
            c(u,"ImageColor3","Glass");
        else
            c(f.stroke(q,V,1,0.85),"Color","Glass");
        end
    ;
    local B=U("UIScale",{Parent=h});
    local
    function V()
        if not h.Parent then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local u=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize;
    local s,Y=h.Position,h.AbsoluteSize;
    if Y.X<=0 or Y.Y<=0 then
        return;
    end
;
local l=math.clamp(s.X.Offset,4,math.max(4,u.X-Y.X-4));
local x=math.clamp(s.Y.Offset,4,math.max(4,u.Y-Y.Y-4));
if l~=s.X.Offset or x~=s.Y.Offset then
    h.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(l,x);
end
;
end

    ;
end

            return false;
        end
    ;
    B.Scale=_;
    task.defer(V);
end
);
return h,q;
end
;
local
function B(V,_,q,u)
    local s,h,Y,l=false,nil,nil,nil;
    _.InputBegan:Connect(
        function(_)
            if not f.isClick(_)then
                return;
            end
        ;
        s,h,Y,l=true,_.Position,q.Position,_;
        local x;
        x=_.Changed:Connect(
            function()
                if _.UserInputState==Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    s=false;
                    x:Disconnect();
                    local _=q.Position;
                    V.State.data[u]={math.floor(_.X.Offset),math.floor(_.Y.Offset)};
                    V.State.save();
                end
            ;
        end
);
end
);
f.connect(L.InputChanged,
    function(_)
        if s and f.sameMove(_,l)then
            local u=_.Position-h;
            local _=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize;
            local s=math.clamp(Y.X.Offset+u.X,4,math.max(4,_.X-q.AbsoluteSize.X-4));
            local h=math.clamp(Y.Y.Offset+u.Y,4,math.max(4,_.Y-q.AbsoluteSize.Y-4));
            q.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(s,h);
        end
    ;
end
,V.Conns);
end
;
local
function V(_,q,u)
    local s=_.State.get(q,nil);
    if type(s)=='table'and tonumber(s[1])and tonumber(s[2])then
        return UDim2.fromOffset(s[1],s[2]);
    end
;
return u;
end
;
function w:SetWatermark(_)T.trace("SetWatermark");
    _=_ and true or false;
    self.State.set('watermark',_);
    if _ then
        if not self.WatermarkFrame then
            self:_buildWatermark();
        end
    ;
    self.WatermarkFrame.Visible=true;
elseif self.WatermarkFrame then
        self.WatermarkFrame.Visible=false;
    end
;
end
;
function w:SetWatermarkTitle(_)self.WatermarkTitleText=_;
    local q=self.WatermarkTitle;
    if not q then
        return;
    end
;
if _ then
    if q.AutomaticSize~=Enum.AutomaticSize.None then
        q.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.None;
        q.Size=UDim2.new(0,38,1,0);
        q.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;
    end
;
if q.Text~=_ then
    q.Text=_;
end
;
else
    local _=tostring(self.TitleLabel and self.TitleLabel.Text or"Nova");
    if q.AutomaticSize~=Enum.AutomaticSize.X then
        q.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0);
        q.AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X;
        q.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
    end
;
if q.Text~=_ then
    q.Text=_;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local
function _(q,u,s,h)
    if h then
        if q<=u then
            return"Success";
        elseif q<=s then
                return'Warning';
            end
        ;
        return'Danger';
    end
;
if q>=u then
    return"Success";
elseif q>=s then
        return"Warning";
    end
;
return"Danger";
end
;
local
function q()
    local u;
    pcall(
        function()u=T.Services.Players.LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()*1000;
        end
);
if not u then
    pcall(
        function()u=game:GetService('Stats').Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue();
        end
);
end
;
return u;
end
;
function w:_buildWatermark()
    local u,s=r(self,"Watermark",V(self,"watermarkPos",UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)),true);
    u.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,34);
    f.corner(s,12);
    local h=U('Frame',{Name="Row",Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0),AutomaticSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.X,BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=7,Parent=s});
    f.pad(h,0,12,0,8);
    f.list(h,10,Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center);

function L.badge()
    local WM,VM=U.Badge,U.BadgeLabel;
    if not(WM and VM)then
        return;
    end

    VM.Text=_M;

    U.BadgeWidth=VM;

        WM.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(VM,18);
    end
;
end
;
end

function L.status()
    local WM,VM;
    if L.state=="ok"then
        WM,VM='Success',tostring(math.max(L.online,1))..' '..F.tr('online');
    elseif L.state=="off"then
            WM,VM='Danger',F.tr('No connection');
        else
            WM,VM=D.meta,F.tr("Connecting").."…";
        end
    ;
    e.Text=VM;
    K(aM,"BackgroundColor3",WM,"Quick");
    K(e,"TextColor3",L.state=='off'and'Danger'or D.meta,'Quick');
end
;

function L.faces()
    local e,GM={},{};
    for aM=#L.msgs,1,-1.0 do
        local WM=L.msgs[aM].uid;
        if not e[WM]then
            e[WM]=true;
            GM[#GM+1]=WM;
            if#GM>=5 then
                break;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
for e=1,5 do
    local aM,WM=GM[e],v[e];
    if aM then
        if not WM then
            WM=T('ImageLabel',{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(30,30),BorderSizePixel=0,LayoutOrder=10-e,ZIndex=10-e},j);
            A(WM,15);
            M(WM,"BackgroundColor3",D.bub);
            local j=T("UIStroke",{Thickness=2,ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border},WM);
            M(j,'Color',D.board);
            v[e]=WM;
        end
    ;
    local j=q(aM);
    if WM.Image~=j then
        WM.Image=j;
        M(WM,"BackgroundColor3",u(aM));
    end
;
WM.Visible=true;
elseif WM then
        WM.Visible=false;
    end
;
end
;
end

end

        qM.frame.Visible=false;

function L.openPicker(h,qM,uM)L.closePicker();
    local sM=rM[h]or _M(h);
    local rM=N();
    local _M,hM=o.AbsolutePosition,o.AbsoluteSize;
    local YM,lM=qM.AbsolutePosition,qM.AbsoluteSize;
    local qM;
    if h=="insert"then
        qM=(YM.X-_M.X)/rM;
    else
        qM=(YM.X+lM.X-_M.X)/rM-sM.w;
    end
;
local xM=(YM.Y+lM.Y-_M.Y)/rM+6;
local lM=hM.Y/rM-(H+20);
if h=='insert'or xM+sM.h>lM then
    xM=(YM.Y-_M.Y)/rM-sM.h-8;
end
;
qM=math.clamp(qM,8,math.max(8,hM.X/rM-sM.w-8));
xM=math.max(8,xM);
sM.frame.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(qM),math.floor(xM));
sM.scale.Scale=0.88;
sM.frame.Visible=true;
VM.Visible=true;
c(sM.scale,TweenInfo.new(0.16,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Scale=1});
L.pick={mode=h,m=uM};
end

    end

;
function L.add(s,l)
    if L.rows[s.id]then
        return;
    end
;
local k=L.msgs[#L.msgs];
local I;
if k==nil or GM(k.ts)~=GM(s.ts)then
    L.order+=1;
    I=h(s.ts,L.order);
end
;
local h=k~=nil and I==nil and k.uid==s.uid and not k.failed and not s.rp and s.ts-k.ts<180;
s.ui=aM(s,h,l);
s.ui.div=I;
L.msgs[#L.msgs+1]=s;
L.rows[s.id]=s;
while#L.msgs>150 do
    local s=table.remove(L.msgs,1);
    L.rows[s.id]=nil;
    pcall(
        function()s.ui.frame:Destroy();
            if s.ui.div then
                s.ui.div:Destroy();
            end
        ;
    end
);
end
;
FM.Visible=false;
end
;
function L.rebuild()
    for s,s in ipairs(L.msgs)do
        pcall(
            function()s.ui.frame:Destroy();
                if s.ui.div then
                    s.ui.div:Destroy();
                end
            ;
        end
);
end
;
local s=L.msgs;
L.msgs,L.rows={},{};
for h,h in ipairs(s)do
    L.add(h,false);
end
;
FM.Visible=#L.msgs==0;
L.faces();
end
;
function L.drop(s)
    for h,l in ipairs(L.msgs)do
        if l==s then
            table.remove(L.msgs,h);
            break;
        end
    ;
end
;
L.rows[s.id]=nil;
pcall(
    function()s.ui.frame:Destroy();
        if s.ui.div then
            s.ui.div:Destroy();
        end
    ;
end
);
FM.Visible=#L.msgs==0;
end
;
local
function s(h)
    local l={};
    for k in pairs(h)do
        l[#l+1]=k;
    end
;
table.sort(l);
local k={};
for I,I in ipairs(l)do
    local l={};
    for C,C in ipairs(h[I])do
        l[#l+1]=C;
    end
;
table.sort(l);
k[#k+1]=I..':'..table.concat(l,',');
end
;
return table.concat(k,'|');
end
;
function L.setRx(h,l)
    if s(l)==s(h.rx)then
        return;
    end
;
local s={};

    if#I>#(h.rx[k]or{})then
        s[k]=true;
    end
;
end
;
h.rx=l;
if h.ui and h.ui.renderR then
    h.ui.renderR(s);
end
;
end

function L.bind(s,h)
    if L.rows[h.id]and L.rows[h.id]~=s then
        L.drop(s);
        return;
    end
;
L.rows[s.id]=nil;
s.id,s.ts,s.pending=h.id,h.ts,false;
s.name,s.dn,s.role=h.name,h.dn,h.role;
s.rt,s.rp=h.rt,h.rp or s.rp;
L.rows[s.id]=s;
if h.role~=''then
    L.myRole=h.role;
end
;
if s.ui then
    if s.ui.text then
        c(s.ui.text,"Quick",{TextTransparency=0});
    end
;
if s.ui.time then
    c(s.ui.time,"Quick",{TextTransparency=s.ui.timeT or 0});
end

    s.ui.setTime(v(s.ts));
end
;
end
;
end

        end
    ;
end
);
end

local
function h(l,k)
    local I=l.rx[k];
    local C=false;
    if I then
        for n,b in ipairs(I)do
            if b==w then
                table.remove(I,n);
                C=true;
                break;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
if not C then
    I=I or{};
    I[#I+1]=w;
    l.rx[k]=I;
end
;
if l.rx[k]and#l.rx[k]==0 then
    l.rx[k]=nil;
end
;
if l.ui and l.ui.renderR then
    l.ui.renderR(not C and{[k]=true}or nil);
end
;
end

function L.react(l,k)
    if l.id<0 or l.failed then
        return;
    end
;
local I=os.clock();
if I-L.lastRx<0.2 then
    return;
end
;
L.lastRx=I;
h(l,k);

    function()
        local I=V('/pulse/chat/react',{uid=w,id=l.id,emoji=k});
        if type(I)=="table"and I.ok==true and type(I.r)=="table"then
            local C={};
            for n,b in pairs(I.r)do
                local Z={};
                for P,P in ipairs(type(b)=='table'and b or{})do
                    local b=tonumber(P);
                    if b then
                        Z[#Z+1]=b;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
        if#Z>0 then
            C[n]=Z;
        end
    ;
end
;
L.setRx(l,C);
else
    h(l,k);
    local h=type(I)=="table"and I.err or'net';
    J(F.tr("Reaction failed"),F.tr(s[h]or"Server unavailable"),"error");
end
;
end
);
end

local
function h(l)
    local k={};
    if type(l)~="table"then
        return k;
    end
;
for I,C in pairs(l)do
    if type(I)=='string'and type(C)=="table"then

        for n,n in ipairs(C)do
            local C=tonumber(n);
            if C then
                l[#l+1]=C;
            end
        ;
    end
;
if#l>0 then
    k[I]=l;
end
;
end
;
end
;
return k;
end

function L.apply(I)
    local C=LM();
    local n=not L.loaded;
    local b=L.stick;
    local Z=0;
    local P={};
    for i,i in ipairs(type(I.msgs)=='table'and I.msgs or{})do
        local m=l(i);
        if m then
            if m.id>L.last then
                L.last=m.id;
            end
        ;
        if not L.rows[m.id]then
            local i=m.uid==w and k(m.text);
            if i then
                L.bind(i,m);
                L.setRx(i,m.rx);
            else
                L.add(m,not n);
                Z+=1;
                if m.uid==w and m.role~=''then
                    L.myRole=m.role;
                end
            ;
            if not n and m.uid~=w then
                if not C then
                    L.unread+=1;
                end
            ;
            local k=L.pingKind(m);
            if k then
                if C then
                    if m.ui and m.ui.flash then
                        m.ui.flash();
                    end
                ;
            else
                P[#P+1]={m=m,kind=k};
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
