function L.send()
    local k=X(MM.Text);
    if k==""then
        return;
    end
;
if W(k)>200 then
    h();
    return;
end
;
if k:sub(1,1)~="/"and not L.langOk(L.chan,k)then
    h();
    L.langHint(true);
    return;
end
;
local I=os.clock();
if I-L.lastSend<1.05 then
    h();
    return;
end
;
L.lastSend=I;
MM.Text='';
L.tmp-=1;
local h=L.reply;
local I;
if h and h.id>0 then
    I={id=h.id,uid=h.uid,name=h.name,dn=h.dn,text=r(h.text,90)};
end
;
local r={id=L.tmp,uid=w,name=R.Name,dn=R.DisplayName,text=k,ts=os.time(),role=L.myRole or'',pending=true,rt=I and I.id or 0,rp=I,rx={}};
L.stick=true;
L.add(r,false);
L.faces();
if I then
    L.setReply(nil);
end
;
pcall(
    function()G.Sound.play("tick");
    end
);
task.spawn(
    function()
        local h=V('/pulse/chat/send',{uid=w,name=R.Name,dn=R.DisplayName,text=k,rt=I and I.id or nil,ch=L.chan,k=k:sub(1,1)=='/'and L.key or nil});
        if type(h)=='table'and h.ok==true and type(h.msg)=='table'then
            local R=l(h.msg);
            if R then
                L.bind(r,R);
            end
        ;
    elseif type(h)=="table"and h.ok==true then
            L.drop(r);
            if h.info then
                J("Pulse Chat",tostring(h.info),"success");
            end
        ;
    else
        L.fail(r,type(h)=='table'and h.err or"net");
    end
;
L.kick=true;
end
);
end

function L.langOk(R,W)
    local r=tostring(W or""):gsub("@[%w_]+"," ");
    local W,h,l=0,0,0;
    for k,k in utf8.codes(r)do
        if k>=65 and k<=90 or k>=97 and k<=122 or k>=192 and k<=591 and k~=215 and k~=247 then
            W+=1;
        elseif k>=1024 and k<=1327 then
                h+=1;
            elseif k>=880 and k<=1023 or k>=1328 and k<=8191 or k>=12352 and k<=40959 or k>=44032 and k<=55215 then
                    l+=1;
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
    if l>0 then
        return false;
    end
;
if R=='ru'then
    return W==0;
end
;
return h==0;
end

local W=T("Frame",{Name='LangHint',AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1),Position=UDim2.new(0,22,1,-(H+16)),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,24),AutomaticSize=x,BackgroundColor3=Y,BorderSizePixel=0,Visible=false,ZIndex=8},o);

,DC=
function(G,a,A,F,T)
    if A<0X7_3 then
        T[0X15__]=(a.readf64);
        if not F[13666]then
            A=G:OC(A,F);
        else
            A=F[0X35_62];
        end
    ;
    return 33942,A;
else
    if not(A>0b110010__0)then
    else
        (T)[0B10110]=a.writeu32;
        return 0x72fd,A;
    end
;
end
;
return nil,A;
end
,dC=
function(G,a,A,F)(a)[0x5]=G.rC;

    else
        A=(F[0x67A]);
    end
;
return A;
end

,Lr=
function(G,G)
    local a,A=G[0B1010_0](G[36],G[26]),(0x5C);
    while true do
        if A==0XB then
            return-0X2,a;
        else
            if A==92 then
                (G)[0B00__1101__0]=(G[0b011010_]+0b100);
                A=(11);
                continue;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
return nil;
end

end
,Rr=
function(G,a)
    local A,F=a[0b10_1110](),a[0X2E]();
    if F==0X0 then
        return-0X2,A;
    else
        if F>=a[0x2]then
            F=G:Ar(a,F);
        end
    ;
end
;
local G=(0X006C);
repeat
    if G<108 then
        return-0x2,F*a[39]+A;
    else
        if G>0X5__b then
            G=0x5b;
            continue;
        end
    ;
end
;
until
false;
return nil;
end

end

end

        local g=(d.Magnitude>0.05 and d.Unit or Vector3.new(0,1,0))*(o*(0.6+math.random()*0.6));
        local o=CFrame.new(P+d+g+Vector3.new(0,-2.5-math.random()*2,0))*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*9,math.random()*9,math.random()*9);
        E(i,p,{CFrame=o},Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out);
        E(i,p,{Transparency=1},Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.In);
        Q(i,p+0.1);
    end
;
end

local
function P(i,d,g)
    local o=RaycastParams.new();
    o.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;
    o.RespectCanCollide=true;
    local p={};
    for m,m in pairs(d or{})do
        if typeof(m)=='Instance'then
            p[#p+1]=m;
        end
    ;
end
;
local d=workspace:FindFirstChild('PulseKillBodies');
if d then
    p[#p+1]=d;
end
;
local d=workspace.CurrentCamera;
if d then
    p[#p+1]=d;
end
;
o.FilterDescendantsInstances=p;
local d=i+Vector3.new(0,1.5,0);
for i=1,8 do
    local i=workspace:Raycast(d,Vector3.new(0,-(g or 60),0),o);
    if not i then
        return nil;
    end
;
local d=i.Instance;
local g=d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass('Model');
local m=g and g:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
if d.Transparency<0.9 and not m then
    return i.Position,i.Normal;
end
;
p[#p+1]=m and g or d;
o.FilterDescendantsInstances=p;
end
;
return nil;
end

    return o and o.Y or d.Y-3;

local
function d(g,o,p,m,j,e,v)
    return C(g,{Texture=o,Color=I(p),Size=r(0,m,1,j),Transparency=r(0,0,0.7,0.4,1,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(e),Speed=NumberRange.new(0.01),EmissionDirection=Enum.NormalId.Top,Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular,Brightness=v or 3},1);
end

local
function g(o,p,m,j,e,v,GM,aM)
    local AM=math.abs(p.Z)<0.9 and Vector3.new(0,0,1)or Vector3.new(1,0,0);
    local FM=p:Cross(AM).Unit;
    local AM=CFrame.fromMatrix(o,FM,p);
    for o=1,aM or 3 do
        local p=m*(1-(o-1)*0.3);
        local aM=o==1 and Vector3.new(0,0,0)or Vector3.new((math.random()-0.5)*m*0.35,0,(math.random()-0.5)*m*0.35);
        local m=Instance.new("Part");
        m.Anchored,m.CanCollide,m.CanQuery,m.CanTouch,m.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false;
        m.Transparency=1;
        m.Size=Vector3.new(0.2,0.05,0.2);
        m.CFrame=AM*CFrame.new(aM+Vector3.new(0,0.02+o*0.012,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,math.random()*6.28,0);
        local aM=Instance.new('Decal');
        aM.Texture=GM and not h[GM]and GM or u.splat;
        aM.Face=Enum.NormalId.Top;
        aM.Color3=j:Lerp(Color3.new(0,0,0),(o-1)*0.15);
        aM.Transparency=0.02+(o-1)*0.1;
        aM.Parent=m;
        m.Parent=x();
        k((o-1)*0.07,
            function()
                if m.Parent then
                    E(m,v or 0.9,{Size=Vector3.new(p,0.05,p)},Enum.EasingStyle.Quint);
                end
            ;
        end
);
k(e,
    function()
        if aM.Parent then
            E(aM,1.4,{Transparency=1},Enum.EasingStyle.Quad);
        end
    ;
end
);
Q(m,e+1.5);
end
;
end

local
function h(o,p,m,j,e,v,GM,aM)
    local AM,FM=P(o,e);
    if AM then
        g(AM,FM,p,m,j,v,GM,aM);
    end
;
end

local
function j(e,v,GM,aM,AM,FM)
    local TM=(v-e).Magnitude;
    if TM<0.01 then
        v=e+Vector3.new(0,0.01,0);
        TM=0.01;
    end
;
local fM=(v-e).Unit;
local JM=Instance.new('Part');
JM.Anchored,JM.CanCollide,JM.CanQuery,JM.CanTouch,JM.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false;
JM.Material,JM.Color,JM.Transparency=AM or Enum.Material.Neon,aM,FM or 0;
JM.Size=Vector3.new(GM,GM,TM);
JM.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((e+v)/2,v,math.abs(fM.Y)>0.98 and Vector3.new(1,0,0)or Vector3.new(0,1,0));
JM.Parent=x();
return JM;
end

local
function e(v,GM,aM,AM,FM,TM,fM)TM=TM or 12;
    local JM=GM-v;
    local XM=JM.Unit;
    local tM={v};
    for RM=1,TM-1 do
        local BM=RM/TM;
        local TM=Vector3.new(math.random()-0.5,math.random()-0.5,math.random()-0.5)*2;
        TM=TM-XM*TM:Dot(XM);
        tM[#tM+1]=v+JM*BM+TM*FM*(0.35+0.65*math.sin(BM*3.141592653589793));
    end
;
tM[#tM+1]=GM;
local v={};
for GM=1,#tM-1 do
    v[#v+1]=j(tM[GM],tM[GM+1],AM,fM or l);
    v[#v+1]=j(tM[GM],tM[GM+1],AM*3.2,aM,Enum.Material.Neon,0.72);
end
;
return v,tM;
end
;
local
function v(GM,aM,AM)
    local FM=os.clock();
    local TM;
    TM=_.RenderStepped:Connect(
        function()
            local fM=math.clamp((os.clock()-FM)*q.ts/GM,0,1);
            local GM,FM=pcall(aM,fM);
            if not GM then
                q.driveError=tostring(FM);
            end
        ;
        if fM>=1 or not GM or not q.alive then
            TM:Disconnect();
            if AM then
                local GM,aM=pcall(AM);
                if not GM then
                    q.driveError=tostring(aM);
                end
            ;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
);
return TM;
end

return TM,UM,fM;

local
function JM(XM,tM,RM)
    if not q.shake or not q.alive then
        return;
    end
;
local BM=workspace.CurrentCamera;
if not BM then
    return;
end
;
local UM=tM*math.clamp(1.2-(BM.CFrame.Position-XM).Magnitude/75,0,1);
if UM<0.05 then
    return;
end
;
TM.list[#TM.list+1]={t0=os.clock(),amp=UM,dur=RM,seed=math.random()*50};
if TM.bound then
    return;
end
;
TM.bound=true;
_:BindToRenderStep('PulseKillShakeA',Enum.RenderPriority.First.Value,
    function()
        if TM.restore then
            local XM=workspace.CurrentCamera;
            if XM then
                XM.CFrame=TM.restore;
            end
        ;
        TM.restore=nil;
    end
;
if#TM.list==0 then
    fM();
end
;
end
);
_:BindToRenderStep("PulseKillShakeB",Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value+2,
    function()
        local XM=workspace.CurrentCamera;
        if not XM then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local tM,RM,BM=0,0,0;
    local UM=os.clock();
    for MM=#TM.list,1,-1.0 do
        local cM=TM.list[MM];
        local KM=(UM-cM.t0)*q.ts/cM.dur;
        if KM>=1 then
            table.remove(TM.list,MM);
        else
            local MM=cM.amp*(1-KM)^2;
            local KM=(UM-cM.t0)*24;
            tM+=math.noise(KM,cM.seed)*MM*2.2;
            RM+=math.noise(cM.seed,KM)*MM*2.2;
            BM+=math.noise(KM,cM.seed+9.3)*MM;
        end
    ;
end
;
if tM~=0 or RM~=0 or BM~=0 then
    TM.restore=XM.CFrame;
    XM.CFrame=XM.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tM),math.rad(RM),math.rad(BM));
end
;
end
);
end

;
local rM=Instance.new('Part');
rM.Anchored,rM.CanCollide,rM.CanQuery,rM.CanTouch,rM.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false;
rM.Material,rM.Color,rM.Transparency=LM or Enum.Material.Neon,wM,WM or 0;
rM.Size=Vector3.new(cM,0.04,VM+0.03);
rM.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((UM+MM)/2,MM,KM);
rM.Parent=x();
return rM;
end
;
local
function UM(MM,cM,KM,wM,LM,WM,VM,rM,_M,qM,uM)
    local sM=cM:Cross(KM).Unit;
    local hM={};
    for YM=0,14 do
        local lM=LM+(WM-LM)*YM/14;
        hM[YM]=MM+(cM*math.cos(lM)+KM*math.sin(lM))*wM;
    end
;
for cM=1,14 do
    local KM=math.sin(3.141592653589793*(cM-0.5)/14)^0.7;
    local wM,LM=hM[cM-1],hM[cM];
    local WM=((wM+LM)/2-MM).Unit;
    k(_M*(cM-1)/14,
        function()
            if not q.alive then
                return;
            end
        ;
        local MM=BM(wM+WM*rM*KM*0.3,LM+WM*rM*KM*0.3,math.max(0.04,rM*KM*0.55),sM,uM or l);
        local cM=BM(wM,LM,math.max(0.1,rM*KM*1.6),sM,VM,Enum.Material.Neon,0.45);
        for BM,BM in pairs({MM,cM})do
            k(qM,
                function()
                    if BM.Parent then
                        E(BM,0.22,{Transparency=1,Size=Vector3.new(0.02,BM.Size.Y,BM.Size.Z),CFrame=BM.CFrame+WM*0.7},Enum.EasingStyle.Quad);
                    end
                ;
            end
    );
Q(BM,qM+0.3);
end
;
end
);
end
;
end
;
local
function BM(MM,cM,KM,wM,LM,WM,VM,rM,_M,qM,uM)
    local sM=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local hM=sM and sM.CFrame or CFrame.new();
    local sM=math.rad(_M or 0);
    local _M=(hM.LookVector*math.cos(sM)+hM.RightVector*math.sin(sM)).Unit;
    local sM=math.rad(cM);
    local cM=hM.RightVector*math.cos(sM)+hM.UpVector*math.sin(sM);
    cM=(cM-_M*cM:Dot(_M)).Unit;
    if uM then
        cM=-cM;
    end
;
local uM=_M:Cross(cM).Unit;
local _M=MM-uM*KM*math.cos(wM);
UM(_M,uM,cM,KM,-wM,wM,LM,WM,VM,rM,qM);
end
;
local
function MM(cM,KM)
    for wM=0,(KM or 7)-1 do
        k(wM*0.055,
            function()n(wM%2==0 and Y.click or Y.switch,0.8,0.6+math.random()*1.6,cM);
            end
    );
end
;
n(Y.flash,0.6,0.7,cM);
n(Y.shutter,0.5,0.8,cM);
end
;
local
function cM(KM,wM,LM,WM,VM)
    local rM=Instance.new("Highlight");
    rM.FillColor,rM.OutlineColor=wM,LM or wM;
    rM.FillTransparency,rM.OutlineTransparency=WM or 0.5,VM or 0;
    rM.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded;
    rM.Adornee=KM;
    rM.Parent=KM;
    return rM;
end
;
local
function KM(wM,LM)
    local WM=S(CFrame.new(wM),Vector3.new(0.4,0.4,0.4));
    local wM=Instance.new('Attachment');
    wM.Parent=WM;
    Q(WM,LM or 4);
    return WM,wM;
end
;
local
function wM(LM,WM,VM,rM)
    local _M,qM=KM(LM);
    C(qM,{Texture=u.core,Color=I(l,WM),Size=r(0,VM*0.2,1,VM),Transparency=r(0,0,1,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.35),Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360),Brightness=rM or 5,ZOffset=1},2);
    H(_M,WM,10,math.min(60,VM*3),0.5);
    return _M,qM;
end
;
local
function LM(WM,VM,rM,_M,qM)
    local uM,sM=KM(WM);
    C(sM,{Texture=qM or u.fsparks,Color=I(l,VM),Size=r(0,0.5,1,0),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.3,0.7),Speed=NumberRange.new(_M*0.5,_M),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180),Drag=3,Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,-25.0,0),Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityParallel,Brightness=5},rM);
    return uM,sM;
end
;
local
function WM(VM,rM,_M,qM,uM)
    local sM=S(CFrame.new(VM),Vector3.new(2,0.5,2));
    C(sM,{Texture=u.smokeFB,FlipbookLayout=Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4,FlipbookMode=Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot,Color=I(rM),Size=r(0,(uM or 2)*0.6,1,(uM or 2)*1.6),Transparency=r(0,0.2,0.7,0.45,1,1),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.8,1.3),Speed=NumberRange.new(qM*0.4,qM),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(85,85),Drag=3,Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360),Shape=Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box,LightEmission=0,LightInfluence=1,Brightness=1},_M);
    Q(sM,2.5);
    return sM;
end
;
local
function VM(rM,_M,qM,uM,sM,hM,YM)
    local lM=P(rM,YM);
    local YM=S(CFrame.new((lM or rM)+Vector3.new(0,0.15,0)),Vector3.new(0.4,0.2,0.4));
    local rM=Instance.new("Attachment");
    rM.Parent=YM;
    local lM=d(rM,hM or u.ringEdge,_M,qM,uM,sM,3);
    Q(YM,sM+0.5);
    return lM,YM;
end
;
local
function rM(_M,qM,uM,sM,hM,YM,lM,xM)
    local xM=XM();
    local SM={};
    for kM=1,qM do
        local qM=Instance.new("Part");
        local yM=hM*(0.5+math.random());
        qM.Size=Vector3.new(yM,yM*(0.6+math.random()*0.6),yM*(0.7+math.random()*0.5));
        qM.Material,qM.Color=sM or Enum.Material.Slate,uM;
        qM.CanQuery,qM.CanTouch=false,false;
        pcall(
            function()qM.CollisionGroup='Ragdolls';
            end
    );
qM.CFrame=CFrame.new(_M+Vector3.new((math.random()-0.5)*1.5,math.random()*0.8,(math.random()-0.5)*1.5))*CFrame.Angles(math.random()*6,math.random()*6,math.random()*6);
qM.Parent=xM;
SM[kM]=qM;
local _M=(lM or 2)+math.random()*0.6;
k(_M,
    function()
        if qM.Parent then
            E(qM,0.4,{Size=qM.Size*0.2,Transparency=1});
        end
    ;
end
);
Q(qM,_M+0.5);
end
;
local
function _M()
    for qM,qM in ipairs(SM)do
        if qM.Parent then
            local uM=Vector3.new(math.random()-0.5,0,math.random()-0.5);
            uM=uM.Magnitude>0.05 and uM.Unit or Vector3.new(1,0,0);
            qM.AssemblyLinearVelocity=uM*YM*(0.4+math.random()*0.6)+Vector3.new(0,YM*(0.6+math.random()*0.6),0);
            qM.AssemblyAngularVelocity=RM(8);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
_M();
local qM;
qM=_.Heartbeat:Connect(
    function()qM:Disconnect();
        _M();
    end
);
return SM;
end
;
local
function _M(qM,uM,sM)
    local hM=Instance.new('Beam');
    hM.Attachment0,hM.Attachment1=qM,uM;
    hM.FaceCamera,hM.LightEmission,hM.LightInfluence,hM.Segments=true,1,0,12;
    for uM,YM in pairs(sM)do
        hM[uM]=YM;
    end
;
hM.Parent=qM.Parent;
return hM;
end
;
local
function qM(uM,sM,hM)
    if not(uM and sM and hM)then
        return nil;
    end
;
for YM,YM in ipairs(uM.model:GetDescendants())do
    if YM:IsA("BallSocketConstraint")then
        local uM=YM.Attachment0 and YM.Attachment0.Parent;
        local lM=YM.Attachment1 and YM.Attachment1.Parent;
        if uM==sM and lM==hM or uM==hM and lM==sM then
            return YM;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
return nil;
end
;
local
function uM(sM,hM,YM)
    if not(sM and hM and YM)then
        return;
    end
;
for lM,lM in ipairs(sM.model:GetDescendants())do
    if lM:IsA("BallSocketConstraint")then
        local sM=lM.Attachment0 and lM.Attachment0.Parent;
        local xM=lM.Attachment1 and lM.Attachment1.Parent;
        if sM==hM and xM==YM or sM==YM and xM==hM then
            lM:Destroy();
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
local
function sM(hM,YM,lM)
    if not(hM and hM.Parent)then
        return nil;
    end
;
local xM=Instance.new('Part');
xM.Size=Vector3.new(hM.Size.X*0.8,0.05,hM.Size.Z*0.8);
xM.Material,xM.Color=Enum.Material.Neon,Color3.fromRGB(160,0,14);
xM.CanCollide,xM.CanQuery,xM.CanTouch,xM.Massless,xM.CastShadow=false,false,false,true,false;
xM.CFrame=hM.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,(YM and 1 or-1.0)*(hM.Size.Y/2-0.02),0);
xM.Parent=lM or hM.Parent;
local lM=Instance.new('WeldConstraint');
lM.Part0,lM.Part1=hM,xM;
lM.Parent=xM;
local hM=C(xM,{Texture=u.splat,Color=I(Color3.fromRGB(190,0,25),Color3.fromRGB(100,0,10)),Size=r(0,0.35,1,0.14),Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.4,0.7),Speed=NumberRange.new(6,11),SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(25,25),Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,-55.0,0),EmissionDirection=YM and Enum.NormalId.Top or Enum.NormalId.Bottom,Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360),LightEmission=0,Brightness=1},8);
hM.Rate=55;
hM.Enabled=true;
k(0.9,
    function()
        if hM.Parent then
            hM.Enabled=false;
        end
    ;
end
);
k(1.1,
    function()
        if xM.Parent then
            E(xM,0.5,{Color=Color3.fromRGB(60,0,5),Transparency=1});
        end
    ;
end
);
return xM;
end
;
local
function hM(YM,lM,xM,SM,kM)
    local yM={};
    for QM,QM in ipairs(YM)do
        local YM,EM=pcall(
            function()
                return QM:Clone();
            end
    );
if YM and EM then
    for YM,YM in ipairs(EM:GetChildren())do
        if YM:IsA('SpecialMesh')then
            YM.TextureId='';
        else
            YM:Destroy();
        end
    ;
end
;
pcall(
    function()
        if EM:IsA("MeshPart")then
            EM.TextureID='';
        end
    ;
end
);
EM.Anchored,EM.CanCollide,EM.CanQuery,EM.CanTouch=true,false,false,false;
EM.Material,EM.Color,EM.Reflectance,EM.Transparency=lM,xM,kM or 0,1;
EM.Parent=x();
yM[#yM+1]=EM;
E(EM,SM,{Transparency=0},Enum.EasingStyle.Quad);
end
;
E(QM,SM,{Transparency=1},Enum.EasingStyle.Quad);
for YM,YM in ipairs(QM:GetChildren())do
    if YM:IsA("Decal")then
        E(YM,SM,{Transparency=1});
    end
;
end
;
end
;
return yM;
end
;
local
function YM(lM,xM,SM,kM,yM)
    local QM={};
    local
    function EM(IM,CM,HM,nM)
        local OM=Instance.new(IM);
        OM.Anchored,OM.CanCollide,OM.CanQuery,OM.CanTouch,OM.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,false;
        OM.Size,OM.Color,OM.Material,OM.Transparency=CM,HM,nM,yM or 0;
        OM.Reflectance=nM==Enum.Material.Metal and 0.35 or 0;
        OM.Parent=x();
        QM[#QM+1]=OM;
    end
;
EM('WedgePart',Vector3.new(0.06,SM,kM/2),lM,xM);
EM('WedgePart',Vector3.new(0.06,SM,kM/2),lM,xM);
EM('Part',Vector3.new(0.14,0.1,kM+0.3),Color3.fromRGB(40,36,34),Enum.Material.Metal);
EM('Part',Vector3.new(0.14,0.7,0.17),Color3.fromRGB(60,34,20),Enum.Material.Wood);
local lM={CFrame.new(0,SM/2,-kM/4),CFrame.Angles(0,3.141592653589793,0)*CFrame.new(0,SM/2,-kM/4),CFrame.new(0,-0.05,0),CFrame.new(0,-0.45,0)};
return QM,lM;
end
;
local
function lM(xM,SM)
    local kM=math.abs(SM.Z)<0.9 and Vector3.new(0,0,1)or Vector3.new(1,0,0);
    return CFrame.fromMatrix(xM,SM:Cross(kM).Unit,SM);
end
;
local
function xM(SM,kM,yM)
    for QM,EM in ipairs(SM)do
        if EM.Parent then
            EM.CFrame=yM*kM[QM];
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local
function SM(kM)
    local yM=kM.killer;
    local kM=yM and yM.Parent;
    if kM and kM:IsA('Model')and kM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then
        return kM;
    end
;
return nil;
end
;
local
function kM(yM,QM)
    if not(yM and yM.torso)then
        return nil;
    end
;
local EM=0;
for IM,IM in ipairs(yM.body)do
    EM+=IM:GetMass();
end
;
local IM=Instance.new('Attachment');
IM.Parent=yM.torso;
local CM=Instance.new("VectorForce");
CM.Attachment0=IM;
CM.RelativeTo=Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World;
CM.ApplyAtCenterOfMass=true;
CM.Force=Vector3.new(0,EM*workspace.Gravity*QM,0);
CM.Parent=yM.torso;
return CM;
end
;
local
function yM(QM)
    for EM,EM in ipairs(QM.model:GetDescendants())do
        if EM:IsA('BallSocketConstraint')then
            EM:Destroy();
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local
function QM()
    local EM=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local IM=EM and EM.CFrame.LookVector or Vector3.new(0,0,-1.0);
    local EM=Vector3.new(IM.X,0,IM.Z);
    EM=EM.Magnitude>0.05 and EM.Unit or Vector3.new(0,0,-1.0);
    return EM,Vector3.new(-EM.Z,0,EM.X);
end

local
function EM(IM,CM,HM,nM,OM,NM,zM,DM)
    local bM=RaycastParams.new();
    bM.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;
    bM.RespectCanCollide=true;
    local ZM={workspace.CurrentCamera,XM()};
    for PM,PM in pairs(OM or{})do
        if typeof(PM)=='Instance'then
            ZM[#ZM+1]=PM;
        end
    ;
end
;
bM.FilterDescendantsInstances=ZM;
for OM=1,CM do
    local CM=Vector3.new(math.random()-0.5,math.random()*1.2-0.8,math.random()-0.5).Unit*(nM or 14);
    local nM=workspace:Raycast(IM,CM,bM);
    if nM and nM.Instance.Transparency<0.9 then
        local IM=nM.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model");
        if not(IM and IM:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))then
            local IM=typeof(HM)=="function"and HM(OM)or HM;
                local CM,HM=NM or 1.2,zM or 3;
                k(nM.Distance/45,
                    function()g(nM.Position,nM.Normal,CM+math.random()*(HM-CM),IM,DM or 3,0.12,u.splat,2);
                    end
            );
    end
;
end
;
end
;
end

local
function g(o,p)
    local e=p/2;
    local p={};
    for aM=0,7 do
        local BM=aM%2==1 and e or-e;
        local UM=math.floor(aM/2)%2==1 and e or-e;
        local MM=math.floor(aM/4)%2==1 and e or-e;
        p[aM+1]=o*Vector3.new(BM,UM,MM);
    end
;
return p;
end
;
local
function o(p,e,aM,BM)
    local UM=(aM-e).Magnitude;
    if UM<0.01 then
        p.Transparency=1;
        return;
    end
;
p.Size=Vector3.new(BM,BM,UM);
p.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((e+aM)/2,aM,math.abs((aM-e).Unit.Y)>0.98 and Vector3.new(1,0,0)or Vector3.new(0,1,0));
end
;
local p={};
for e,aM in ipairs(Z)do
    p[e]={cf=aM.CFrame,size=aM.Size};
end
;
v(1.1,
    function(e)
        local aM=e*e;
        local BM=6.5*(1-0.92*aM);
        local UM=g(CFrame.new(D)*CFrame.Angles(e*2.5,e*4,e*1.5),BM);
        local MM=g(CFrame.new(D)*CFrame.Angles(-e*3,-e*5,e*2),BM*0.5);
        for g,e in ipairs(d)do
            o(z[g],UM[e[1]],UM[e[2]],0.14);
            o(z[12+g],MM[e[1]],MM[e[2]],0.1);
        end
    ;
    for d=1,8 do
        o(z[24+d],UM[d],MM[d],0.06);
    end
;
for d,g in ipairs(Z)do
    if g.Parent then
        g.CFrame=CFrame.new(D+(p[d].cf.Position-D)*(1-aM))*p[d].cf.Rotation*CFrame.Angles(aM*3,aM*2,0);
        g.Size=p[d].size*(1-0.8*aM);
    end
;
end
;
end

IM.Earthquake=
function(_)
    local z,D=TM(_);
    local b=_.root;
    local Z=Vector3.new(D.X,b.Y,D.Z);
    local D=Vector3.new(b.X-Z.X,0,b.Z-Z.Z);

    local g=D.Magnitude>0.5 and D.Unit or z;
    Z=b-g*d;
    local z=tM(_,Vector3.new(0,0,0),nil,3.8,nil,true);
    N(_.char);
    local D=math.max(4,math.floor(d/2.2));
    for b=1,D do
        k(b*0.045,
            function()
                local o=Z+g*(d*b/D);
                local Z=P(o+Vector3.new(0,2,0),_.ignore);
                if not Z then
                    return;
                end
            ;
            local P=b==D;
            local D=P and 7 or 2+math.random()*2.5;
            local d=P and 2.6 or 1.1+math.random()*0.8;
            local p=Instance.new('Part');
            p.Anchored,p.CanCollide,p.CanQuery,p.CanTouch,p.CastShadow=true,false,false,false,true;
            p.Size,p.Material,p.Color=Vector3.new(d,D,d),Enum.Material.Slate,Color3.fromRGB(105,98,92):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(70,64,60),math.random());
            local d=CFrame.Angles((math.random()-0.5)*0.3,math.random()*6.28,(math.random()-0.5)*0.3);
            p.CFrame=CFrame.new(Z-Vector3.new(0,D/2+0.2,0))*d;
            p.Parent=x();
            E(p,0.12,{CFrame=CFrame.new(Z+Vector3.new(0,D/2-0.4,0))*d},Enum.EasingStyle.Back);
            WM(Z,Color3.fromRGB(140,130,120),3,5,1.5);
            h(o,2.4,Color3.fromRGB(30,26,24),2.2,_.ignore,0.1,u.cracks,1);
            if b%2==0 then
                n(Y.rockCrack,0.5,0.9+math.random()*0.4);
            end
        ;
        k(1.5,
            function()
                if p.Parent then
                    E(p,0.45,{CFrame=p.CFrame-Vector3.new(0,D,0)},Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In);
                end
            ;
        end

Q(p,2.1);

            function()z.torso.AssemblyAngularVelocity=RM(9);
            end
    );
end

q.context=
function(r,_)
    local u=r:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')or r:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso')or r:FindFirstChild("Torso");
    local h=r:FindFirstChild("Head")or u;
    if not u then
        return nil;
    end
;
local Y=(r:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or r:FindFirstChild('Torso')or u).Position;
return{char=r,root=u.Position,chest=Y,head=h.Position,killer=_,ignore={a=r,b=L.Character,c=workspace.CurrentCamera}};
end
;
local r={Shatter=true,Void=true,Reaper=true,Inferno=true,Shadow=true,Disintegrate=true,Freeze=true,Glitch=true,Thunder=true,Hologram=true,Crows=true,Nuke=true};
q.play=
function(_,u,h,Y)
    if _=='Random'or not IM[_]then
        _=u[math.random(1,#u)];
    end
;
local u=IM[_];
local l=h and q.context(h,Y);
if not(u and l)then
    return;
end
;
l.orig=q.origOf[h];
l.ignore.d=l.orig;
l.ghostTakes=r[_]or false;
if l.orig then
    q.ctxOf[h]=l;
end
;
local r,_=pcall(u,l);
if not r then
    q.lastError=tostring(_);
end
;
end
;
local
function r(_)
    local u,h=pcall(
        function()
            local Y=_:FindFirstChild('UpperTorso');
            local l=_:FindFirstChildOfClass('Shirt');
            local S=_:FindFirstChildOfClass('Pants');
            return table.concat({Y and Y:IsA("MeshPart")and Y.MeshId or'',l and l.ShirtTemplate or'',S and S.PantsTemplate or""},"|");
        end
);
return u and h or'||';
end
;
q.conns[#q.conns+1]=workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(
    function(_)
        if _.Name~="Raggy"or not _:IsA('Model')then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local u,h=os.clock(),{};
    for Y,Y in ipairs(q.raggies)do
        if u-Y.t<6 and Y.m.Parent then
            h[#h+1]=Y;
        end
    ;
end
;
h[#h+1]={m=_,t=u};
q.raggies=h;
end
);
q.findRaggy=
function(_,u,h,Y)
    local l=os.clock()+(Y or 0.8);
    repeat
        local Y,S;
        for k,k in ipairs(q.raggies)do
            if k.m.Parent and not q.origOf[k.m]and k.t>=h-0.6 then
                local h=k.m:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")or k.m:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
                if h then
                    local Q=(h.Position-_).Magnitude;
                    if Q<14 and(u=='||'or r(k.m)==u)and(not S or Q<S)then
                        Y,S=k.m,Q;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
if Y then
    return Y;
end
;
task.wait();
until
os.clock()>l;
return nil;
end
;
q.prune=
function()
    for _,_ in ipairs({q.origOf,q.taken,q.ctxOf})do
        for u in pairs(_)do
            if not u.Parent then
                _[u]=nil;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
q.weaponFor=
function(_,u)
    local h=u[_.Name];
    local Y=h and h.Role;
    if Y=='Murderer'then
        return'gun';
    end
;
local h=_.Character and _.Character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart');
for Y,l in pairs(u)do
    if l.Role=='Murderer'then
        local u=V:FindFirstChild(Y);
        local Y=u and u.Character;
        local u=Y and Y:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
        if u and h and(u.Position-h.Position).Magnitude<12 then
            return"knife";
        end
    ;
    if Y and Y:FindFirstChild("Knife")then
        return'knife';
    end
;
end
;
end
;
for u,u in ipairs(V:GetPlayers())do
    if u~=_ and u.Character and u.Character:FindFirstChild('Gun')then
        return'gun';
    end
;
end
;
return"knife";
end
;
q.killerFor=
function(_,u,h)
    local Y=_.Character and _.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    local l,S;
    for k,k in ipairs(V:GetPlayers())do
        local Q=k~=_ and k.Character;
        if Q then
            local _=u[k.Name];
            local u;
            if h=='knife'then
                u=_ and _.Role=="Murderer";
            else
                u=Q:FindFirstChild("Gun")~=nil;
            end
        ;
        local _=u and(Q:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or Q:FindFirstChild("Torso")or Q:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart'));
        if _ then
            local u=Y and(_.Position-Y.Position).Magnitude or 0;
            if not S or u<S then
                l,S=_,u;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;

_.remember=
function(q,u)
    local s=_.saved[q];
    if s and s[u]~=nil then
        return s[u];
    end
;
local h,Y=pcall(
    function()
        return q[u];
    end
);
if not h then
    return nil;
end
;
s=s or{};
_.saved[q]=s;
s[u]={value=Y};
return s[u];
end
;
_.baseline=
function(q,u)
    local s=_.remember(q,u);
    if s==nil then
        return nil;
    end
;
local h,Y=pcall(
    function()
        return q[u];
    end
);
if h and s.hasWritten and Y~=s.written then
    s.value=Y;
end
;
return s.value;
end
;
_.releaseProp=
function(q,u)
    local s=_.saved[q];
    local h=s and s[u];
    if h==nil then
        return;
    end
;
pcall(
    function()
        local Y=q[u];
        if h.hasWritten and Y~=h.written then
            h.value=Y;
        end
    ;
    q[u]=h.value;
end
);
s[u]=nil;
if next(s)==nil then
    _.saved[q]=nil;
end
;
end
;
_.sync=
function(q,u,s,h)
    if q==nil then
        return;
    end
;
if not s then
    _.releaseProp(q,u);
    return;
end
;
local s=_.remember(q,u);
if s==nil then
    return;
end
;
pcall(
    function()
        local Y=q[u];
        if s.hasWritten and Y~=s.written then
            s.value=Y;
        end
    ;
    s.written,s.hasWritten=h,true;
    if Y~=h then
        q[u]=h;
    end
;
s.written=q[u];
end
);
end
;
_.drop=
function(q)
    local u=_.effects[q];
    _.effects[q]=nil;
    if u~=nil then
        _.owned[u]=nil;
        pcall(
            function()u:Destroy();
            end
    );
end
;
end
;
_.ensure=
function(q,u,s)
    local h=_.effects[q];
    if h~=nil and h.Parent==s then
        return h;
    end
;
_.drop(q);
local h,Y=pcall(
    function()
        local l=Instance.new(u);
        _.owned[l]=true;
        _.effects[q]=l;
        l.Name='PulseVisual_'..q;
        l.Parent=s;
        return l;
    end
);
if not h then
    _.drop(q);
    return nil;
end
;
return Y;
end
;
_.configure=
function(q,u,s,h)
    if not s then
        _.drop(q);
        return;
    end
;
local s=_.ensure(q,u,workspace.CurrentCamera or R);
if s==nil then
    return;
end
;
for q,u in pairs(h)do
    pcall(
        function()s[q]=u;
        end
);
end
;
s.Enabled=true;
end
;
_.ours=
function(q)
    local u=q.Name;
    return u:sub(1,5)=='Pulse'or u:sub(1,4)=='Nova';
end
;
_.targets=
function(q,u)
    local s,h={},{};
    if q==nil then
        return s;
    end
;
for Y,Y in ipairs(q:GetChildren())do
    if Y:IsA(u)and not _.owned[Y]and not _.ours(Y)then
        s[#s+1],h[Y]=Y,true;
    end
;
end
;
for Y,l in pairs(_.saved)do
    if not h[Y]and l.Parent and l.Parent.value==q and Y:IsA(u)then
        s[#s+1]=Y;
    end
;
end
;
return s;
end
;
_.prune=
function()
    for q,u in pairs(_.saved)do
        if q.Parent==nil and u.Parent==nil then
            for s in pairs(u)do
                _.releaseProp(q,s);
            end
        ;
        _.saved[q]=nil;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
_.overlay=
function()
    if not _.vignetteOn then
        if _.gui then
            pcall(
                function()_.gui:Destroy();
                end
        );
    _.gui=nil;
    _.screen=nil;
end
;
return;
end
;
if _.gui==nil or _.gui.Parent==nil then
    local q=Instance.new('ScreenGui');
    q.Name='PulseVisualScreen';
    q.ResetOnSpawn,q.IgnoreGuiInset,q.DisplayOrder=false,true,5;
    pcall(
        function()q.ScreenInsets=Enum.ScreenInsets.None;
        end
);
pcall(
    function()q.Parent=W;
    end
);
if q.Parent==nil then
    pcall(
        function()q.Parent=L:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui");
        end
);
end
;
_.gui=q;
local u={edges={}};
_.screen=u;
for s=1,4 do
    local h=Instance.new("Frame");
    h.Name,h.BorderSizePixel,h.Active="Vignette"..s,0,false;
    h.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0);
    h.Parent=q;
    local q=Instance.new('UIGradient');
    q.Rotation=({90,270,0,180})[s];
    q.Parent=h;
    u.edges[s]={frame=h,gradient=q};
end
;
u.edges[1].frame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,0.28);
u.edges[2].frame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,0.28);
u.edges[2].frame.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0,0.72);
u.edges[3].frame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.23,1);
u.edges[4].frame.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0.23,1);
u.edges[4].frame.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.77,0);
end
;
for q,q in ipairs(_.screen.edges)do
    q.frame.Visible=true;
    q.gradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1-math.clamp(_.vignette/100,0,0.8)),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)});
end
;
end
;
_.apply=
function()
    if not _.on or _.applying then
        return;
    end
;
_.applying=true;
local q,u=pcall(
    function()_.prune();
        local s;
        if _.tech~='Game'then
            pcall(
                function()s=Enum.Technology[_.tech];
                end
        );
end
;
_.sync(R,"Technology",s~=nil,s);
local s=not _.brightOn and _.brightScale~=1;
local h=s and _.baseline(R,'Brightness');
_.sync(R,'Brightness',_.brightOn or s,_.brightOn and _.bright or(tonumber(h)or 3)*_.brightScale);
_.sync(R,"ClockTime",_.timeOn,_.time%24);
local s=math.clamp(tonumber(_.ambientLift)or 0,0,1);
local h=tonumber(_.ambientScale)or 1;
local Y=typeof(_.ambientTint)=="Color3"and _.ambientTint or Color3.new(1,1,1);
local l=not _.ambientOn and(s>0 or h~=1 or Y~=Color3.new(1,1,1));
local x=Color3.fromRGB(128,128,128);
local S=l and _.baseline(R,"Ambient");
local k=l and _.baseline(R,"OutdoorAmbient");
local
function y(Q)
    local E=typeof(Q)=='Color3'and Q or x;
    E=Color3.new(math.clamp(E.R*h*Y.R,0,1),math.clamp(E.G*h*Y.G,0,1),math.clamp(E.B*h*Y.B,0,1));
    return E:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),s);
end
;
_.sync(R,'Ambient',_.ambientOn or l,_.ambientOn and _.ambient or y(S));
_.sync(R,'OutdoorAmbient',_.ambientOn or l,_.ambientOn and _.outdoorAmbient or y(k));
_.sync(R,"ExposureCompensation",_.exposureOn,_.exposure);
_.sync(R,'GlobalShadows',_.noShadows,false);
_.sync(R,'ShadowSoftness',_.shadowSoftOn,_.shadowSoftness);
_.sync(R,'EnvironmentDiffuseScale',_.envOn,_.envDiffuse);
_.sync(R,'EnvironmentSpecularScale',_.envOn,_.envSpecular);
_.sync(R,"ColorShift_Top",_.shiftOn,_.shiftTop);
_.sync(R,"ColorShift_Bottom",_.shiftOn,_.shiftBottom);
_.sync(R,'FogStart',_.fogOn,math.clamp(_.fogStart,0,1999));
_.sync(R,"FogEnd",_.fogOn,math.clamp(math.max(_.fogEnd,_.fogStart+1),1,2000));
_.sync(R,"FogColor",_.fogOn,_.fogColour);
for s,s in ipairs({R,workspace.CurrentCamera})do
    for h,h in ipairs(_.targets(s,'PostEffect'))do
        _.sync(h,"Enabled",_.noPost,false);
    end
;
end
;
local s=Enum.TonemapperPreset.Default;
if _.toneOn then
    pcall(
        function()s=Enum.TonemapperPreset[_.tone]or s;
        end
);
end
;
for h,h in ipairs({R,workspace.CurrentCamera})do
    for Y,Y in ipairs(_.targets(h,"ColorGradingEffect"))do
        _.sync(Y,'TonemapperPreset',true,s);
    end
;
end
;
local s=_.atmosphereOn and not _.noAtmosphere and not _.fogOn;
local h=_.targets(R,'Atmosphere');
if s and#h==0 then
    local Y=_.ensure('Air','Atmosphere',R);
    if Y then
        h[1]=Y;
    end
;
else
    _.drop('Air');
end
;
for Y,Y in ipairs(h)do
    if not _.owned[Y]then
        _.sync(Y,"Parent",_.noAtmosphere or _.fogOn,nil);
    end
;
local h=not s and not _.owned[Y]and _.airScale~=1;
for l,x in pairs({Density=_.density,Offset=_.offset,Haze=_.haze,Glare=_.glare,Color=_.atmosphereColour,Decay=_.decay})do
    if _.owned[Y]then
        Y[l]=x;
    elseif l=="Density"and h then
            _.sync(Y,l,true,(tonumber(_.baseline(Y,l))or _.density)*_.airScale);
        else
            _.sync(Y,l,s,x);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local s=V and V();
local h=not s and _.skies[_.skybox]or nil;
local Y=_.skyOn and not s;
local s=_.targets(R,"Sky");
if(Y or h)and#s==0 then
    local l=_.ensure('Sky',"Sky",R);
    if l then
        s[1]=l;
    end
;
else
    _.drop('Sky');
end
;
for l,l in ipairs(s)do
    for s,x in pairs({StarCount=_.stars,SunAngularSize=_.sunSize,MoonAngularSize=_.moonSize,CelestialBodiesShown=_.celestial})do
        if _.owned[l]then
            l[s]=x;
        else
            _.sync(l,s,Y,x);
        end
    ;
end
;
for s,s in ipairs(_.skyProps)do
    local Y=h and h[s];
    if _.owned[l]then
        if Y then
            l[s]=Y;
        end
    ;
else
    _.sync(l,s,Y~=nil,Y);
end
;
end
;
end
;
if not _.lampShadows then
    for s,h in pairs(_.saved)do
        if h.Shadows~=nil then
            _.releaseProp(s,"Shadows");
        end
    ;
end
;
_.lights,_.lightRoots=nil,nil;
end
;
local s=workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain");
local h=_.targets(s,'Clouds');
if _.cloudsOn and s and#h==0 then
    local Y=_.ensure("Clouds",'Clouds',s);
    if Y then
        h[1]=Y;
    end
;
else
    _.drop("Clouds");
end
;
for s,s in ipairs(h)do
    for h,Y in pairs({Cover=_.cloudCover,Density=_.cloudDensity,Color=_.cloudColour,Enabled=true})do
        if _.owned[s]then
            s[h]=Y;
        else
            _.sync(s,h,_.cloudsOn,Y);
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local s=math.clamp(_.strength/100,0,1);
local h=_.quality=='Full';
_.configure("Color",'ColorCorrectionEffect',_.gradeOn,{Brightness=_.gradeBrightness*s,Contrast=_.contrast*s,Saturation=_.saturation*s,TintColor=Color3.new(1,1,1):Lerp(_.tint,s)});
_.configure('Bloom','BloomEffect',_.bloomOn,{Intensity=_.bloomIntensity*s,Size=_.bloomSize,Threshold=_.bloomThreshold});
_.configure("Rays","SunRaysEffect",_.raysOn and h,{Intensity=_.raysIntensity*s,Spread=_.raysSpread});
if _.toneOn then
    local Y;
    pcall(
        function()Y=Enum.TonemapperPreset[_.tone];
        end
);
if Y then
    _.configure("Tone",'ColorGradingEffect',true,{TonemapperPreset=Y});
end
;
else
    _.drop("Tone");
end
;
_.sync(R,'GeographicLatitude',_.latOn,_.lat);
_.configure('DOF',"DepthOfFieldEffect",_.dofOn and h,{FarIntensity=_.dofFar*s,FocusDistance=_.dofFocus,InFocusRadius=_.dofRadius,NearIntensity=0});
pcall(_.setMaterials,_.mats or"Game");
pcall(_.lampApply);
_.overlay();
end
);
_.applying=false;
if not q then
    warn('[Pulse] shaders: '..tostring(u));
end
;
end
;
_.mapRoots=
function()
    local q={};
    local u=game:GetService("Players");
    for s,s in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren())do
        if s.ClassName=='Model'and(s:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")or string.find(s.Name,"Lobby",1,true))and not u:GetPlayerFromCharacter(s)then
            q[#q+1]=s;
        end
    ;
end
;
return q;
end
;
_.castShadows=
function()
    if not _.lampShadows then
        return;
    end
;
local q=_.mapRoots();
local u=_.lightRoots~=nil and#_.lightRoots==#q;
if u then
    for s,h in ipairs(q)do
        if _.lightRoots[s]~=h then
            u=false;
            break;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
local s=os.clock();
if not u or s>(_.lightScanAt or 0)then
    _.lightScanAt=u and math.huge or s+5;
    _.lightRoots,_.lights=q,{};
    for u,u in ipairs(q)do
        for q,q in ipairs(u:GetDescendants())do
            local u=q.ClassName;
            if u=='PointLight'or u=="SpotLight"or u=='SurfaceLight'then
                _.lights[#_.lights+1]=q;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
end
;
for q,q in ipairs(_.lights or{})do
    if q.Parent and not q.Shadows then
        _.sync(q,"Shadows",true,true);
    end
;
end
;
end
;
_.request=
function()
    if _.batch or _.uiSyncing or _.queued then
        return;
    end
;
_.queued=true;
local q=_.epoch;
task.defer(
    function()
        if q~=_.epoch then
            return;
        end
    ;
    _.queued=false;
    if a[1][a[3]]()and _.on then
        _.apply();
    end
;
end
);
end
;
_.disconnect=
function(q)
    for u,u in ipairs(q)do
        pcall(
            function()u:Disconnect();
            end
    );
end
;
table.clear(q);
end
;
_.watchCamera=
function()_.disconnect(_.cameraConns);
    local q=workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if _.watchedCamera and _.watchedCamera~=q then
        for u,u in ipairs(_.targets(_.watchedCamera,'PostEffect'))do
            _.releaseProp(u,"Enabled");
        end
    ;
end
;
_.watchedCamera=q;
if q then
    _.cameraConns[1]=M(q.ChildAdded,
        function(q)
            if not _.owned[q]then
                _.request();
            end
        ;
    end
,true);
end
;
_.request();
end
;
_.watch=
function()
    if _.watching then
        return;
    end
;
_.watching=true;
_.conns[#_.conns+1]=M(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"),_.watchCamera,true);
_.conns[#_.conns+1]=M(R.ChildAdded,
    function(q)
        if not _.applying and not _.owned[q]then
            _.request();
        end
    ;
end
,true);
_.conns[#_.conns+1]=M(R.Changed,
    function(q)
        if _.applying or not _.on then
            return;
        end
    ;
    local u=_.saved[R];
    if u and u[q]then
        local s,h=pcall(
            function()
                return R[q];
            end
    );
local Y=u[q];
if s and(not Y.hasWritten or h~=Y.written)then
    Y.value=h;
    _.request();
end
;
end
;
end
,true);
_.watchCamera();
end
;
_.unwatch=
function()_.epoch=_.epoch+1;
    _.queued=false;
    _.disconnect(_.conns);
    _.disconnect(_.cameraConns);
    _.watching=false;
    _.watchedCamera=nil;
end
;
_.restore=
function()_.applying=true;
    for q,u in pairs(_.saved)do
        for s in pairs(u)do
            _.releaseProp(q,s);
        end
    ;
end
;
table.clear(_.saved);
local q={};
for u in pairs(_.effects)do
    q[#q+1]=u;
end
;
for u,u in ipairs(q)do
    _.drop(u);
end
;
if _.gui then
    pcall(
        function()_.gui:Destroy();
        end
);
_.gui=nil;
_.screen=nil;
end
;
_.lights,_.lightRoots=nil,nil;
for q,q in pairs(_.neonLights or{})do
    pcall(
        function()q:Destroy();
        end
);
end
;
_.neonLights={};
pcall(
    function()_.setMaterials("Game");
    end
);
_.applying=false;
end

_.on=q==true;

end

end

        ;
    end

_.neonLights={};
_.lampScan=
function()
    local q=_.mapRoots();
    local u=_.lampRoots~=nil and#_.lampRoots==#q;
    if u then
        for s,h in ipairs(q)do
            if _.lampRoots[s]~=h then
                u=false;
                break;
            end
        ;
    end
;
end
;
local s=os.clock();
if u and s<(_.lampScanAt or 0)then
    return;
end
;
_.lampScanAt=s+(u and 30 or 5);
_.lampRoots,_.lamps,_.neons=q,{},{};
for u,u in ipairs(q)do
    for q,q in ipairs(u:GetDescendants())do
        local u=q.ClassName;
        if u=="PointLight"or u=="SpotLight"or u=="SurfaceLight"then
            if not _.owned[q]and q.Name~='PulseNeonGlow'then
                _.lamps[#_.lamps+1]=q;
            end
        ;
    elseif q:IsA("BasePart")and q.Material==Enum.Material.Neon and q.Transparency<0.6 then
            _.neons[#_.neons+1]=q;
        end
    ;
end
;
end
;
end
;
_.lampApply=
function()
    local q=tonumber(_.lampBoost)or 1;
    local u=_.on and math.abs(q-1)>0.01;
    if u or _.on and _.neonGlow then
        pcall(_.lampScan);
    end
;
for s,s in ipairs(_.lamps or{})do
    if s.Parent then
        local h=u and _.baseline(s,"Brightness");
        _.sync(s,'Brightness',u,(tonumber(h)or 1)*q);
        local h=u and _.baseline(s,'Range');
        _.sync(s,'Range',u,math.min(60,(tonumber(h)or 8)*(1+(q-1)*0.5)));
    end
;
end
;
for q,u in pairs(_.neonLights)do
    if not q.Parent or not u.Parent then
        pcall(
            function()u:Destroy();
            end
    );
_.neonLights[q]=nil;
end
;
end
;
if _.on and _.neonGlow then
    local q=0;
    for u in pairs(_.neonLights)do
        q+=1;
    end
;
for u,u in ipairs(_.neons or{})do
    if q>=90 then
        break;
    end
;
if u.Parent and not _.neonLights[u]then
    local s=u.Size;
    local h=math.max(s.X,s.Y,s.Z);
    if h>=0.8 then
        pcall(
            function()
                local s=Instance.new('PointLight');
                s.Name='PulseNeonGlow';
                s.Color=u.Color;
                s.Brightness=1.4;
                s.Range=math.clamp(h*1.6,6,18);
                s.Shadows=false;
                s.Parent=u;
                _.owned[s]=true;
                _.neonLights[u]=s;
                q+=1;
            end
    );
end
;
end
;
end
;
else
    for q,u in pairs(_.neonLights)do
        pcall(
            function()u:Destroy();
            end
    );
_.neonLights[q]=nil;
end
;
end
;
end

,F=
function(G)
    local a=G[4];
    local A=G[2];
    local F=G[6];
    local T=G[3];
    local f=G[0];
    local J=G[7];
    local X=G[5];
    local t=G[1];
    return
    function()
        while true do
            local G=f[24](
                function()
                    local R=f[1][f[2]][f[3]][f[4]][f[5]][f[6]][f[7]];
                    local B=R[f[8]](R);
                    for R,R in f[9](B)do
                        if R[f[10]](R,f[11])and R[f[12]](R,f[20])then
                            local B=R[f[20]][f[13]];
                            if f[16](A,B[f[14]](B,3))then
                                T[1][T[3]]=R;
                                break;
                            end
                        ;
                    end
                ;
            end
        ;
        if T[1][T[3]]then
            local R=T[1][T[3]][f[20]][f[13]];
            T[1][T[3]][f[20]][f[13]]=R[f[14]](R,1,2)..(A[1][f[14]](A[1],1,10)..(J..(F[1][F[3]]..t[1][t[3]])));
            T[1][T[3]][f[17]][f[18]]=a[1][a[3]];
            T[1][T[3]][f[20]][f[19]]=X[1][X[3]];
        end
    ;
end
);
if not G then
    f[21](f[22]);
else
    f[21](f[23]);
end
;
end
;
end
;
end
